jobs.title: Agentic AI-Business Consultant (Principal) | Enterprise
jobs.description:
Overview
この度、AIビジネスソリューション統括本部内に、Agentic Business Applicationチームを新設いたします。本チームは、AI時代における業務の「やり方そのもの」を再定義し、市場を創出していくことをミッションとします。大規模かつ戦略的な案件に取り組み、お客様の業務変革を実現する専門チームです。 今回募集するポジションは、本チームの中核を担うAgentic AI Business Applications Consultantです。

本ロールにおいては、「業務変革 × AI（Dynamics 365 / Copilot / Agent等）」を通じて、企業の競争力そのものを変革することが期待されます。Microsoftのプラットフォームを活用し、業務プロセスや意思決定の在り方を再設計しながら、戦略・業務・テクノロジーを横断的に捉え、変革テーマの定義から実行推進まで一貫して関与していただきます。

また、Microsoftでは“Growth Mindset”を重要なカルチャーとしており、新たなテクノロジーや未知の領域に挑戦し続ける姿勢を高く評価します。
これまでコンサルタントとして培ってきた課題構造化力や変革推進力を活かし、AIとデータを活用した次世代の業務変革（Agentic Transformation）を共に推進していきたい方を歓迎します。

Responsibilities
1.  業務変革構想の推進（Strategy / Transformation）
- 顧客の経営課題・業界課題を構造化し、AIを活用した業務変革テーマの策定をリードまたは主体的に推進
- Dynamics 365 、Copilot、AI Agents等を活用した次世代の業務モデル（Agentic ERP/CRM）の構想
- 業務プロセス・意思決定・オペレーティングモデルの再設計をプロジェクト内で推進
- CxO ・事業責任者との対話に関与し、変革ビジョンの具体化および合意形成を推進

2. ソリューション提案・ビジネスケース構築
- AI × Business Applications を軸とした提案活動において、主要メンバーとしてリードまたは主体的に推進
- ROI 設計およびビジネスケース構築を担い、顧客の投資判断を支援
- 複雑な変革テーマをストーリーとして整理し、経営層への提案資料を作成
- 営業・技術チームと連携し、競争力のあるソリューションの構築に貢献

3. 大型案件の創出・推進（Deal Support / Leadership）
- 戦略案件の創出および提案活動を行い、クロージングに向けた活動をリードまたは支援
- 担当領域における売上およびパイプライン成長に貢献
- 大規模案件におけるディール戦略の策定・実行をチームとともに推進

4. Agentic AI ユースケースの創出と展開
- 業界課題に基づくAgentic AIユースケースの特定・設計に参画
- ERP/CRM 領域（SCM、製造、販売、サービス等）におけるAI活用シナリオの具体化を推進
- Copilot およびAI Agentを活用した業務自動化・意思決定高度化のユースケース設計
- 顧客事例の創出および社内外への展開に貢献

5. クロスファンクショナル連携
- 営業、技術営業、カスタマーサクセス、グローバルチーム、パートナーと連携し、顧客価値最大化に貢献
- 担当領域におけるワークストリームを主体的に推進
- グローバルのベストプラクティスを理解し、プロジェクトへの適用を推進

6. 市場創出・ナレッジ展開への貢献
- AI × Business Applications 領域におけるユースケースやナレッジの蓄積・共有に貢献
- 提案・案件活動を通じた価値訴求およびコンテンツ作成に関与
- 社内外でのナレッジ共有や活動を通じ、領域理解の拡張に寄与

7. 継続的な学習と成長（Growth Mindset）
- Agents 、Copilot、Dynamics 365、データ活用領域に関する継続的なスキル習得
- 不確実性の高い領域においても主体的に仮説を立て、価値創出に挑戦
- 新しいテクノロジー・ビジネスモデルに対する柔軟な適応とチャレンジ

Qualifications
■ Required Qualifications （応募要件）
- 戦略コンサルティング、または企業変革・業務改革領域において、構想策定から実行までの実務経験を有する方（業務経験目安：8年以上）
- 以下いずれかの業界における深いドメイン知識および業務理解
- 製造業（自動車、電機、機械、化学・素材等）
- エネルギー・インフラ（電力、ガス、石油、再生可能エネルギー等）
- 製造業（サプライチェーン、調達、製造、販売など）における業務理解
- ※ 上記以外でも特定領域における専門性を有する方は歓迎します

- CxO ・事業責任者クラスとのエンゲージメント経験、および信頼関係構築力（経営課題を構造化し、変革テーマへ落とし込んだ経験）
- ROI 設計、ビジネスケース構築、ディール推進に関する理解を含むビジネス感覚
- 複雑な課題を整理し、経営層に対して分かりやすく伝えるストーリーテリング力
- 不確実性の高い環境においても主体的に価値創出に取り組める方（Growth Mindsetを持ち、変革を前向きに推進できる方）

■ Preferred Qualifications （歓迎要件）
- MBA または同等の大学院修了
- 戦略コンサルティングファームでの実務経験、または経営戦略・企業変革を実現するためのコンサルティングサービスの提供経験、大手企業に対する業務変革プロジェクトをリードした経験（ 大手企業に対する構想策定から実行支援までの一貫した経験を 歓迎 します）
- AI ／自動化／データ活用に関する理解（テクノロジーそのものではなく、ビジネス変革にどう活かすかの視点）
- 大規模業務変革（BPR、オペレーティングモデル改革等）の推進経験
- テクノロジー領域（SaaS／クラウド）におけるビジネス経験
- 売上責任・案件創出に関与した経験

■ 言語
- 日本語：ネイティブレベルまたはビジネス上級
- 英語：ビジネスレベルを歓迎（必須ではなく、今後の成長意欲を重視）

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

jobs.title: Director, Program Management Delivery - CTJ - Top Secret
jobs.location: United States, Multiple Locations, Multiple Locations; United States, District of Columbia, Washington D.C.
jobs.description:
Overview
The Consulting Practice Manager - CTJ - Top Secret is a leader at the intersection of mission impact, customer trust, and business execution . As a Consulting Practice Manager (M1), you will lead Microsoft Security consulting delivery across the  U.S. Federal DoW Market - in particular US Navy/ US Marine Corps , overseeing a portfolio of complex engagements while developing high-performing teams and shaping sustainable growth.

You will operate as a  trusted leader to customers, teams, and Microsoft stakeholders , ensuring secure, high-quality outcomes that support some of the most critical national security missions.

Responsibilities
What You’ll Do
Lead Secure, High‑Impact Delivery
- Own the  overall health, quality, and success  of a portfolio of security consulting engagements.
- Serve as a  senior escalation point  for  security related  delivery, technical, financial, and contractual matters—stepping in early to manage risk and keep outcomes on track.

- Engage directly with customer executives and steering committees to  remove blockers, build trust, and drive results .
- Ensure consistent delivery excellence through Microsoft methodologies, quality standards, and governance.

Drive Business Growth & Portfolio Performance
- Partner closely with Sales, pursuits, engineering, and portfolio teams to  shape deliverable, outcome‑focused opportunities .

- Ensure engagements are structured for success—balancing customer value, risk, consumption, and financial health.
- Identify opportunities to  expand existing engagements , accelerate cloud consumption, and bring forward next-step proposals.
- Own consultant  utilization, business target attainment for security, and backlog risk .

Enable Teams & Build Talent
- Lead and develop  Consultants  through coaching, clear expectations, and accountability.

- Model Microsoft’s  Model, Coach, Care  leadership culture—creating an environment where people grow and perform at their best.
- Partner with capacity and resource teams to align the  right skills to the right work at the right time .
- Attract, retain, and develop talent capable of delivering in high‑trust, regulated federal environments.

Partner Across Microsoft
- Collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Quality teams to deliver seamless customer experiences.
- Act as a connector across organizational boundaries to  align priorities and solve complex challenges .
- Support pre-sales activities for large or strategic engagements to ensure strong delivery foundations from day one.

Improve How We Deliver
- Champion the  use, reuse, and creation of intellectual property (IP)  to improve consistency, scale, and efficiency.
- Capture lessons learned and partner with delivery excellence and quality teams to drive  continuous improvement  across the practice.

What Success Looks Like
- Customers view Microsoft as a  trusted delivery and security partner .
- Engagements are delivered  predictably, securely, and profitably .
- Teams are engaged, supported, and growing.
- The Intel Market portfolio grows in a  responsible, sustainable way .

Who Thrives in This Role
Strong candidates typically bring:
- Proven experience leading  complex consulting or delivery portfolios , ideally in regulated or federal environments.
- Confidence operating with  senior customer and internal executives .
- A balance of  delivery rigor, business acumen, and people leadership .
- A mindset oriented toward  anticipation, ownership, and continuous improvement .

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
- Master's Degree AND 5+ years technology-related, business, professional services, consulting, and sales experience OR Bachelor's Degree or Technical University Degree AND 7+ years technology-related, business, professional services, consulting, and sales experience OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements

Security Clearance Requirements: Candidates must be able to meet Microsoft, customer and/or
government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include,
but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
• Candidates must have an active TS and be willing and eligible to upgrade to TS/SCI (with
polygraph) or have an active TS/SCI and be willing and eligible to upgrade to TS/SCI (with
polygraph). This role will require candidates to maintain the TS/SCI (with polygraph) clearance.
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are
required pre-offer and post-hire for this role. Failure to maintain or obtain the appropriate
clearance and/or customer screening requirements may result in employment action up to and
including termination.
• Clearance Verification: This position requires successful verification of the stated security
clearance to meet federal government customer requirements. You will be asked to provide
clearance verification information prior to an offer of employment.
• Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud
background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter
• Citizenship & Citizenship Verification: This position requires verification of U.S. citizenship due
to citizenship-based legal restrictions. Specifically, this position supports United States federal,
state, and/or local United States government agency customer and is subject to certain
citizenship-based restrictions where required or permitted by applicable law. To meet this legal
requirement, citizenship will be verified via a valid passport, or other approved documents, or
verified US government Clearance

Preferred Qualifications
- Master's Degree AND 7+ years technology-related, business, professional services, consulting, and sales experience OR Bachelor's Degree or Technical University Degree AND 9+ years technology-related, business, professional services, consulting, and sales experience OR equivalent experience.

- 5+ years people management experience.
- 5+ years sales management experience.
- 5+ years project management or delivery oversight experience.
- 5+ years experience in one or more industries related to relevant customer/account.
- Currently residing in the DC Metro area preferred
- CISSP preferred

Consulting Practice Management M5 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $124,500 - $244,700 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $154,500 - $263,900 per year.

Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:
https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. jobs.title: Microsoft Frontier Company - Senior AI Business Consultant
jobs.description:
Overview
マイクロソフトコンサルティングサービスでは、才能と情熱を持ち、 Microsoft 365 Copilot  や  Microsoft  の  AI  ソリューション (Microsoft 365 、 Azure  AI 、 Copilot  Studio  等 ) を活用した、エンタープライズ顧客のビジネス変革と  AI  活用推進をリードする経験豊富なシニアコンサルタントを募集します。

生成   AI ・ Copilot   技術の急速な普及に伴い、企業における「働き方変革」「生産性向上」「 AI  活用ビジョン策定」へのニーズが高まっています。本ポジションのシニアコンサルタントには、アドバイザー、レビュアー、または注目度の高いプロジェクトの中核メンバーとして、ビジョン策定・ KPI  設計・実行支援の三位一体でお客様のビジネス成果実現を支援していただきます。

Responsibilities
業務において期待される活動内容の代表例は以下となります。

AI  ビジネスビジョン・戦略策定支援

- 顧客ビジネス環境の理解と課題分析に基づく、 AI  活用ビジョン・戦略の策定支援

- Microsoft AI  ソリューションを活用したビジネス変革ロードマップの構想・提言

顧客ワークスタイル変革支援

- 顧客従業員の生産性に着目した、現状ワークスタイル・業務課題の調査・研究

- 理想のワークスタイル像の描出と  AI  活用シナリオの具体化

KPI  策定・効果測定支援

- ビジョン実現に向けた  KPI  の策定および達成推進に向けた企画・適応支援

- 投資対効果 (ROI) の可視化とエグゼクティブへの説明

エンドツーエンドのプロジェクトデリバリ

jobs.description:
Overview
Microsoft’s Enterprise Account Team focuses on partnering with customers to achieve strategic goals. This team is responsible for providing a differentiated Customer experience for our customers, delivering solutions that result in targeted business outcomes and driving revenue growth for Microsoft.

As Strategic Account Technology Strategist, paired with an Enterprise Account Executive, leveraging your large, multi-functional v-team across the breadth of the Microsoft product portfolio and the vast catalog of Microsoft Partner offerings, you will build and grow your network of technology executives within targeted business units and bring industry-relevant solutions to help the client adopt and embrace AI technologies. With a proven history of innovating technical solutions to achieve customers’ business objectives and achieving account growth targets, this role will give you the opportunity to combine your technology and industry knowledge to deliver on AI solutions to accelerate the client's AI vision and to ultimately become their trusted technology advisor.

We would love to hear from you if you:

- Have a desire to work in genuine industry-breakthrough innovation
- Can articulate complex problems and solutions with clarity
- Have a can-do and tenacious attitude alongside a willingness to get stuck to deliver client outcomes

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

jobs.title: Sr Account Technology Strategist
jobs.description:
Overview
Synthesizes business insights and orchestrates global teams across the organization to deliver alternative solutions while applying deep expertise and thought leadership. Acts as a "virtual Chief Technical Officer" to provide Account Thought leadership, leverage deep knowledge of Microsoft's solutions, industry, and customer needs, and acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and team. Leads technology strategy formulation by leading alignment of customer needs and technology solutions, execution of technology strategy/digital transformation, creation of mid- to long-term technical roadmaps, and translation of customer business objectives. Develops and drives opportunities, presents opportunities to the customer, and creates demand. Coaches peers on how to create and maintain an opportunity initiation and how to map Microsoft priorities to opportunities. Leads digital transformation using corporate and cross-industry resources, and partners with line-of-business leader or executive to articulate the benefits of Microsoft technology over competitor solutions. Helps customer technical specialists sell Microsoft offerings. Maps technical customer requirements and business scenarios to Microsoft technology platforms. Orchestrates necessary teams and partners to ensure demand generation and establishes best practices for account planning. Delivers regular industry/technology briefings to customer technology decision-makers technical teams. Uses readiness resources and demonstrates expertise in creating enablement plans.

Responsibilities
Customer and Industry Insights
Applies expertise (deep expertise across few accounts or broad expertise across many accounts) and thought leadership to identify and inform the development of the right Industry Sales Kits and industry partners within the customer's vertical industry. Articulates and understands specific industry-related market trends, as well as customer threats, opportunities, and barriers to growth as they relate to the customer's broader industry. Leverages industry trends from other industries to gather insights and develop an informed perspective on similar issues that may occur within their industry/industries. Applies industry knowledge to support customers in solving issues.
Synthesizes and combines various business and industry insights from their team, global best practices, proof points from experience/case studies with countries and/or regions, and deep industry expertise (e.g., level 200) related to customers and their competitors to conduct forecasting and develop recommendations for managing accounts and subsidiary planning. Ensures that all levels of the organization challenge customers to consider alternatives and adapt strategies, plans, business models, and solutions to insights. Orchestrates cross-regional teams to gather information, collaborate on performance markers, and identify potential risks in customer accounts. Oversees technical teams for driving opportunities with others, as necessary. Brings in business and industry insights to address the broader business challenges for the customer and deliver solutions.

Differentiated Value Proposition
Partners with a line-of-business leader or executive within a large-scale or high-impact customer organization to articulate how complex Microsoft technology/services will meet future business needs better than the competition and will enable the achievement of long-term growth and success. Provides an outside-in view around existing and emerging compete or other solutions that are also a requirement for the customer.
Acts as the customer's Technology Mentor in established relationships with a line-of-business leader or executive within a large-scale or high-impact customer organization  leaders, including technical decision makers (TDMs) and/or Business Unit leaders at the C-level (e.g., HR, Risk, Finance leadership). Develops extended relationships beyond core customers, advises on solutions, and aligns Microsoft capabilities with customer needs. Drives market share (e.g., cloud, collaboration, AI). Leads customer business transformations through digital technologies for assigned accounts to drive business outcomes and create business value for customers by understanding customer industry and position to provide guidance and to challenge customer thinking with innovative ideas that showcase the need for change and new strategic direction, and proactively involves corporate and cross-industry resources to drive customer transformation. Ensures line-of-business wins are captured (e.g., customer write-ups) as reference for scale, and represents the face of the business during public relations events for significant business wins.

Education and Thought Leadership
Leads customer technology engagement by engaging and influencing technical resources of customer, partner, and Microsoft towards customer’s business transformation. Delivers regular (e.g., quarterly, monthly) industry/technology briefings to customer technology decision-makers technical teams.
Uses existing and new readiness resources and demonstrates expertise in creating enablement plans for large and high-stakes customers, and all-up Microsoft business. Drives innovations to help customers meet capacity and capability goals, maximize reach, and impact and drive long-term engagement and thought leadership on the Microsoft platform, and influences large customers to see and adopt the strategic value. Drives customer skilling initiatives and execution.

Mapping and Account Planning
Establishes best practices and standards around account planning for budgeting, quota attainment, consumption goals, and customer consumption gaps to inform quarterly and fiscal objectives. Coordinates highly complex extended account teams (e.g., spanning complex technologies, geographies, functions) and drives forecasting and tracking of the business. Owns the technical portion of the account plan and leads the customer plan delivery for large, critical, and/or strategic accounts. Captures all Account Planning input in MSX D365 Account Plan.
Helps customer technical specialists build the message to sell Microsoft offerings to other parts of their business or end users. Creates stakeholder maps for accounts, determines, and orchestrates a coverage plan, and builds out an execution framework across multiple Rooms of the House of the customer.
Orchestrates internal teams and local partners (inclusive of global systems integrators and consultancy partners) to ensure sufficient technical resources for demand generation, when appropriate.

Technology Sales: Demand Generation and Orchestration
Leads Account Strategy Envisioning (ASE, formerly IDTA) with the extended account team, customer, and partner to deliver the outcomes for the customer through joint envisioning, as a vehicle for Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays. Creates new Stage 1 opportunities, both billed and consumed, with technical decision maker (TDM) customer stakeholders, managing consumption pipeline with extended team to maintain velocity, and unblocking issues. Coaches peers (often as a mentor across a region or country) on how to create and maintain an opportunity initiation and how to map Microsoft priorities to opportunities. Defines the blueprint for opportunity initiation, and sets and shares standards and best practices for others to follow.
Leads the customer journey into the era of AI and Industrial Metaverse by creating a targeted approach tailored to their current business requirements and positions Microsoft as a leader for the future, both for accelerating productivity as well as helping the customer create new capabilities to support their business. Leverages expertise of current technology landscape and understanding of AI and Industrial Metaverse capabilities to plot the foundational elements on the technology roadmap that need to be in place to realize value for the customer. Builds a mid-term strategy for AI and metaverse projects as well as an immediate opportunity pipeline and orchestrates execution through the appropriate technical teams from the Specialist Team Unit (STU) and with appropriate Partners
Creates, develops, and drives opportunities based on industry best practices, presents opportunities to the customer, and creates demand. Develops a plan, within a broader strategy, to create and qualify a set number of opportunities for product sales, solutions sales, or consumption. Leverages partners and multiple channels (e.g., social media) to create demand. Orchestrates efforts to drive MCEM lifecycle and stage progression. Leverages experience and strategic foresight to lead technical teams by driving opportunities with Specialist Team Unit (STU), Customer Success Unit (CSU), and others, as necessary. Leads efforts to reach out to key stakeholders to give customer-driven pitches and drives the appropriate customer reach together with the account executive to generate new demand. Uses advanced technical knowledge of products to determine feasibility of technical customer requirements requests and works with core engineering teams to prepare solutions.

Technology Strategy Formulation
Creates mid- and long-term (e.g., 12 or more months) multi-horizon technology and business roadmaps for highly prominent, challenging, and/or strategic accounts based on a deep understanding of business and technology priorities and industry landscape. Challenges and validates the strategy and plan with customer stakeholders and drives envisioning and articulates business and program changes in the roadmaps around new and groundbreaking capabilities. Leads the translation of the customer's business objectives in conjunction with Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays (including consumption-heavy workloads and cloud services) to develop an effective Industry Technology Architecture to plans for and drives consumption and adoption of Microsoft cloud and a higher share of customer potential and propensity (CPP).
Leads analysis of overall customer needs, outcomes, and blockers. Determines key stakeholders for driving execution on the largest and/or most complex accounts. Partners with global executives to lead overall strategy development (e.g., blocker identification, partner strategy) to identify and address gaps and drive end-to-end solutions. Leads the adoption of technologies by plotting the long-term vision of the customer's business strategy and driving action to bring to fruition.
Leads and ensures execution of technology strategy and digital transformation by anticipating and/or leading the resolution of technical blockers that arise during strategy planning and implementation, and driving technology adoption.

Trusted Advisor
Leverages a broad knowledge of Microsoft's product landscape, solutions, and strategy to address customer's needs. Proactively coordinates with internal and external network of industry experts (e.g., Regional Experts, industry-specific partners) to build strong knowledge of the industry and the competitive landscape. Drives and leverages leaders from the partner ecosystem to bridge process gaps. Leverages deep understanding of their customer to share knowledge with extended team and leverages advanced knowledge of competitors to promote customer business perspectives. Partners with others (e.g., enterprise-channel managers) to provide sponsorship and increase impact.
Provides Account thought leadership inclusive of information technology (IT), business strategy knowledge, and technology landscape, and shares best practices internally while providing coaching to subsidiary resources. Leverages account thought leadership in partnership with account executives to set strategy, own accountability for outcomes, and lead extended teams. Provides technical guidance to internal teams to position technology while using customer landscape knowledge. Creates connections and feedback loops with Product and Engineering teams.
Acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and internal advocate by providing insights, feedback, and challenges from the customer to internal teams (e.g., product groups, engineers) across all levels of the organization. Drives action to ensure that internal teams understand and respond to insights. Articulates the business opportunity for Microsoft based on product gaps.
Creates security thought leadership with the customer's executives (e.g., technical decision maker [TDM]/business decision maker [BDM]) using the Microsoft Security and Zero Trust narratives and engages TDM and BDM stakeholders to position security as a business enabler and instill a security mindset in all aspects of the customer's technology landscape. Uses their understanding of the customers' technology and security needs to establish Microsoft’s security credentials and to build opportunities to improve the customer's security posture and orchestrates execution through security specialists.

Qualifications
Required/minimum qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 6+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience OR equivalent experience.
Additional or preferred qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 12+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience OR equivalent experience.
6+ years experience in relevant customer industry.
6+ years experience in digital transformation, or using technology to drive customer business outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior Business Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
Overview
Microsoft’s Cloud business is expanding, and the Cloud Supply Chain (CSCP) organization is responsible for enabling the hardware infrastructure underlying this growth including AI! CSCP’s vision is to empower customers to achieve more by delivering Cloud and AI capabilities at scale. Our mission is to deliver the world's computer with an industry-leading supply chain. The CSCP organization is responsible for traditional supply chain functions such as plan, source, make, deliver, but also manages supportability (spares), sustainability, and decommissioning of datacenter assets worldwide. We deliver the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, OneDrive and the Microsoft Azure platform for external customers. Our infrastructure is supported by more than 300 datacenters around the world that enable services for more than 1 billion customers in over 90 countries.

The Cloud Sourcing, Spares, Security and Sustainability (CS4) organization within CSCP manages sourcing, strategy, and suppliers to provide cost, flexibility, and supply advantages that enable our org to become a world-class supply chain. Well-defined and executed sourcing and supply chain management ensures reliable, on-time performance and optimized cost, prevents urgent and unplanned investments, and provides accurate and timely information across the supply base and internally across the infrastructure organization. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

#CSCP #CSCPJobs

Responsibilities
- Conduct analysis, synthesize findings, develop recommendations to drive supply chain strategies.
- Topics ranging from industry intelligence and benchmarking, mid to long-term operations/supply chain optimization, to firefighting and resolving short-term supply chain and sourcing challenges.
- Lead cross-functional teams to drive implementation of strategic projects: from defining plan, monitoring progress, tracking KPI to delivering results and institutionalizing.
- Partner with Supply Chain, Sourcing and Engineering teams to ensure supply chain resiliency is built-in at product launch, with diversified supply base and geography.
- Lead communications with exec and cross-functional stakeholders to drive alignment, ensure execution and report progress.
- Engage with cross-functional teams on supply chain and sourcing related initiatives, e.g., sustainability, government policy.
- Serve as trusted advisor and support other Supply Chain and Sourcing teams on fact-based analysis and communication material development.

- OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:
- Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screenings: - Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:
- 5+ years of experience in high-tech supply chain or sourcing.
- 2+ years of experience in management consulting, supply chain strategy, or corporate strategy.
- Experience in leading strategy projects involving cross-functional teams. MBA or Master’s degree in Supply Chain is a plus.
- Experience in owning exec-level communications.
- Demonstrated capability in driving analysis, problem-solving, and strategic thinking.
- Passionate not only in defining strategic agenda, but also in driving execution and delivering results.
- Ability to influence and build lasting relationships.

jobs.title: Senior Strategy & Transformation Manager
jobs.location: United States, Multiple Locations, Multiple Locations
jobs.description:
Overview
MCAPS-Core accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win competitively, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions. We differentiate through value creation - delivering world-class, AI-powered customer experiences that accelerate adoption, strengthen loyalty, and create sustainable competitive advantage, driving growth that outpaces the market.

The Strategy & Transformation team identifies emerging opportunities and drives programmatic transformation across MCAPS Core, our customers, partners, and account teams. We design and test new programs, operating models, and customer experiences, then we scale what works to deliver AI-first transformation, customer growth, and measurable commercial impact.

As a Senior Strategy & Transformation Manager for the AI-First Operating Model team, you will help reimagine how MCAPS Core operates in the future – how we deliver outcomes through agentic workflows, what work is assigned to human and token capital, and how we transform our roles, responsibilities, talent strategy and culture. You will bring frameworks and methodologies to business teams, run workstreams in agile sprints, and turn analysis into strategies and recommendations that senior executives can act on. This opportunity will allow you to demonstrate your capabilities managing complex programs, developing transformation strategies, and engaging with senior leaders on defining the future of work.

We are looking for a candidate who thinks boldly and ambitiously about reimagining the way we work — someone who opens the aperture to what is possible, pressure-tests the status quo rather than accepting it, and brings a track record of experimenting with and adopting AI to reimagine their own work. You will pair that ambition with a well-developed consulting toolkit: structured problem solving, excellent written communication, and the ability to influence senior leaders. The Microsoft Corporate Strategy Team is a small, specialized group that advises our CEO and executive leadership team on driving, assessing, and prioritizing the long-term strategic direction and growth for the company across its portfolio of existing and new offerings. As a member of Microsoft’s Corporate Strategy Team, you will drive formal quantitative and qualitative analytical decision support on high-priority, cross-company strategic issues. Example project areas include: strategic acquisition evaluation, value chain assessment, white space opportunity sizing, business model analysis, new initiative ideation, and competitive analysis and game theory.

This hands-on individual contributor role connects people, information, and deadlines so subject-matter experts can focus on analysis, business insights, and stakeholder outcomes.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
•    Coordinate field execution excellence rhythms. Maintain the call calendar and workback schedule; coordinate participation, agenda inputs, data-pack contributions, and pre-reads; confirm readiness with content owners; and ensure decisions and follow-up actions are captured and routed.
•    Manage monthly rhythm-of-business workbacks. Maintain the preparation schedule for monthly business reviews and related operating forums. Track deliverables, dependencies, review checkpoints, and approvals; follow up on missing inputs; and surface risks early enough for owners to respond.
•    Operate the team’s request-intake process. Provide a consistent entry point for field questions about metrics and reporting, requests for analysis, and reporting-development needs. Clarify the business question, intended audience, timing, and required outcome; identify duplicates or existing resources; and route requests to the appropriate owner.
•    Maintain a transparent backlog and request status. Keep requests organized with clear owners, agreed priorities, next steps, and target dates. Facilitate regular triage with team leads, communicate status to requestors, and escalate capacity conflicts rather than independently committing the team to new work.
•    Drive action tracking and follow-through. Maintain a shared view of commitments from field calls, business reviews, and team discussions. Prompt owners for updates, identify stalled actions or unclear ownership, escalate blockers, and confirm that outcomes are documented and communicated before closing items.
•    Coordinate operational communications. Partner with communications and workstream owners to prepare reminders, readiness updates, action summaries, and process guidance. Ensure the right stakeholders receive clear, timely information and can find current materials in agreed shared locations.

jobs.description:
Overview
The Commercial Solution Area (CSA) and Cloud and AI Platforms (CAIP) Solution Area are pivotal in driving innovation and delivering comprehensive solutions to our customers. Our mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more by providing cutting-edge cloud and AI technologies. We are committed to enhancing customer engagement, optimizing business processes, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

The CAIP Sales Strategy, Planning & Excellence team’s mission is to drive world-class operational rigor through strategic planning and actionable insights, enabling the Field, GTM, and GBB organizations to shape strategy, simplify execution, and accelerate business growth. Within that team, the Planning, Operations & Insights group owns the annual planning cycle, the CAIP operating rhythm, and the business insights that inform executive decision-making.

Annual planning is the cross-functional process for aligning GTM, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and E&O around a cohesive annual strategy for CAIP. The CAIP Planning Lead owns all-up planning orchestration for the solution area, ensuring business priorities, product positioning, MPF, execution of motions, investment decisions, blueprint and RolEx, compensation, territory design, and operational readiness are connected into one integrated approach before the new fiscal year begins.

Leading through influence, the CAIP Planning Lead sets the strategic direction and governance for integrated planning across the solution area. This leader aligns cross-functional priorities, connects interdependent choices, and creates the conditions for timely, high-quality decisions across GTM, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and E&O. Workstream owners remain accountable for their recommendations and outcomes, while the Planning Lead challenges assumptions, resolves competing priorities, and elevates material trade-offs to executive sponsors to ensure the final plan reflects a coherent strategy and positions CAIP for growth.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end annual planning cycle for CAIP: translate company and commercial planning guidance into the CAIP planning approach, and define workstreams and ownership across strategy, revenue and investments, resource design, blueprint and sales model, territories, compensation, GTM motions, partner strategy, Marketing, tooling, and landing.
- Build and maintain the master workback, converting central planning milestones, CAIP milestones, executive review dates, Finance deadlines, and operational cutoffs into a single source of truth for cadence, deliverable timing, and stakeholder engagement.
- Create and run planning pods and working groups that bring BA owners, GTM leads, Marketing, Finance, and Operations together, each with clear ownership, deliverables, timelines, and escalation paths.
- Coordinate stakeholder input and reviews through recurring forums planning lead reviews, GTM working sessions, Marketing alignment, Finance and territory reviews, and executive readouts to collect input, pressure-test assumptions, surface trade-offs, and land decisions.

Do you want to shape how privacy and data protection work across one of the world’s largest commercial businesses?

The Trust and Integrity Protection (TrIP) organization enables Microsoft’s commercial business to grow with trust by translating privacy and data protection requirements into clear decisions, durable controls, and measurable outcomes. We are seeking a senior individual contributor to serve as the Privacy Program Owner and architect for the business spanning global sales, consulting, and technical support.

You will set the strategy and target state for the privacy and data protection program, assess whether it is operating effectively, and lead the management of systemic and emerging risk. This is a lead individual-contributor role—not a people-manager position—with broad influence across business, legal, engineering, compliance, and privacy teams.

This opportunity is ideal for a privacy leader who combines deep subject-matter expertise, strong business judgment, and an architect’s mindset. You will create clarity in ambiguity, modernize how the program operates, and help the business move faster while protecting data and earning trust.

jobs.title: Integrated Planning and Scheduling Program Manager
jobs.description:
Overview
Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) powers the global infrastructure behind Microsoft's cloud platforms. Within CO+I, Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) is responsible for delivering hyperscale datacenter programs that enable continued growth of Microsoft's cloud services worldwide.

We are seeking an experienced Integrated Planning & Scheduling Program Manager with deep practical expertise in planning, scheduling, and Primavera P6 EPPM. The role requires someone who can develop and challenge complex, integrated schedules; apply Critical Path Methodology and bottom-up planning; assess schedule quality and risk; and translate project data into realistic, defendable Plan of Record schedules. In addition to technical planning capability, this person will help design, document, implement, and continuously improve planning processes that support the successful delivery of Microsoft’s global Data Centre portfolio.

The candidate will combine advanced planning and scheduling judgment with strong process-development and communication skills. They will champion industry-leading scheduling practices, establish clear standards and workflows, produce high-quality technical documentation, and communicate complex planning requirements effectively to regional teams, cross-functional partners, and senior leaders. They will also support the organizational change needed to embed new planning and schedule-risk processes consistently across the business.

Culture & Team Fit
- A collaborative planning and scheduling professional who can build trusted relationships with Regional Planning Leads, project teams, and cross-functional stakeholders

- A clear and influential communicator who can explain technical scheduling concepts, facilitate alignment, and support adoption of new processes in a fast-paced global environment

- Committed to schedule quality, practical process improvement, standardization, and the disciplined implementation of high-quality planning outcomes

This role is based in Redmond WA.
Relocation support will be provided, and successful candidates will work in the hub office 3 days per week.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
- Planning Process Development & Management: Lead the design, development, documentation, and continuous improvement of global planning and schedule-management processes that strengthen schedule quality, governance, predictability, and consistency across EPC Project Controls programs. Partner with Central Project Controls Estimating, Cost, Risk, regional planning leadership, and cross-functional teams to translate global strategy into practical, scalable processes that meet regional execution needs.

- Planning & Scheduling Subject Matter Expertise: Apply deep expertise in Primavera P6 EPPM, integrated master scheduling, Critical Path Methodology, and bottom-up planning to shape effective planning standards and processes. Support the development of Plan of Record and Integrated Master Schedules, validate durations and assumptions, align schedules with the Basis of Estimate, and embed repeatable methods for schedule integration, benchmarking, and portfolio performance analysis.

- Technical Writing, Data & Reporting: Produce clear, precise, and high-quality process documentation, procedures, standards, guidance, and executive communications. Work closely with the Reporting and Analytics Team to translate complex schedule, risk, and performance data into actionable leadership insights and to develop reporting solutions and KPI frameworks that support schedule health, performance tracking, process adoption, and governance.

- Organizational Change Management & Governance: Own the organizational change management required to introduce, embed, and sustain new planning processes across a global organization. Develop stakeholder, communication, training, adoption, and reinforcement plans; assess change impacts and readiness; manage feedback and resistance; and establish governance, ownership, and controls that drive consistent implementation and measurable improvements in planning maturity.

- Schedule Risk: Support the development, documentation, piloting, and global rollout of the schedule risk management process, including clear roles, workflows, standards, training materials, and adoption measures. Use strong written and verbal communication skills to align stakeholders, present recommendations and program updates to Director-level audiences, build trusted relationships across Project Controls and cross-functional teams, and drive consistent execution across regions.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field AND 4+ years of experience in program management, project controls with advanced Primavera P6 EPPM (planning, scheduling and governance) OR equivalent experience.
- 2+ years of experience developing and managing complex, large-scale project schedules and leading cross-functional programs or change initiatives with multiple stakeholders across regions, business units or large portfolios.

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
- Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

- Experience managing programs across multiple regions, business units, or large portfolios.
- Executive level communication and technical writing skills with experience presenting to senior leadership / Directors.

Drives conversations with clients to present the strategic value of Microsoft solutions and acts as a trusted technology advisor both internally and externally with technical and/or business decision-makers. Gathers insights about client business and leverages existing architecture approaches to achieve Microsoft’s agreed commitments to clients. Leverages executive sponsorship, global resources, and leads the overall strategy development.
Synthesizes business insights and orchestrates global teams across the organization to deliver alternative solutions while applying deep expertise and thought leadership. Acts as a "virtual Chief Technical Officer" to provide Account Thought leadership, leverage deep knowledge of Microsoft's solutions, industry, and customer needs, and acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and team. Leads technology strategy formulation by leading alignment of customer needs and technology solutions, execution of technology strategy/digital transformation, creation of mid- to long-term technical roadmaps, and translation of customer business objectives. Develops and drives opportunities, presents opportunities to the customer, and creates demand. Coaches peers on how to create and maintain an opportunity initiation and how to map Microsoft priorities to opportunities. Leads digital transformation using corporate and cross-industry resources, and partners with line-of-business leader or senior executive to articulate the benefits of Microsoft technology over competitor solutions. Helps customer technical specialists sell Microsoft offerings. Maps technical customer requirements and business scenarios to Microsoft technology platforms. Orchestrates necessary teams and partners to ensure demand generation and establishes best practices for account planning. Delivers regular industry/technology briefings to customer technology senior decision-makers technical teams. Uses readiness resources and demonstrates expertise in creating enablement plans.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Brings in business and industry insights to address the broader business challenges for the customer and deliver solutions.
Differentiated Value Proposition
Acts as the customer's Technology Mentor in established relationships with a line-of-business leader or senior executive within a large-scale or high-impact customer organization senior leaders, including technical decision makers (TDMs) and/or Business Unit leaders at the C-level (e.g., HR, Risk, Finance leadership). Delivers regular (e.g., quarterly, monthly) industry/technology briefings to customer technology senior decision-makers technical teams.

Establishes best practices and standards around account planning for budgeting, quota attainment, consumption goals, and customer consumption gaps to inform quarterly and fiscal objectives. Coordinates highly complex extended account teams (e.g., spanning complex technologies, geographies, functions) and drives forecasting and tracking of the business. Orchestrates internal teams and local partners (inclusive of global systems integrators and consultancy partners) to ensure sufficient technical resources for demand generation, when appropriate.
Technology Sales: Demand Generation and Orchestration

Leads the customer journey into the era of AI and Industrial Metaverse by creating a targeted approach tailored to their current business requirements and positions Microsoft as a leader for the future, both for accelerating productivity as well as helping the customer create new capabilities to support their business. Technology Strategy Formulation

Challenges and validates the strategy and plan with customer stakeholders and drives envisioning and articulates business and program changes in the roadmaps around new and groundbreaking capabilities. Leads the translation of the customer's business objectives in conjunction with Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays (including consumption-heavy workloads and cloud services) to develop an effective Industry Technology Architecture to plans for and drives consumption and adoption of Microsoft cloud and a higher share of customer potential and propensity (CPP).
Leads analysis of overall customer needs, outcomes, and blockers. Determines key stakeholders for driving execution on the largest and/or most complex accounts. Partners with global executives to lead overall strategy development (e.g., blocker identification, partner strategy) to identify and address gaps and drive end-to-end solutions. Leads the adoption of technologies by plotting the long-term vision of the customer's business strategy and driving action to bring to fruition.
Trusted Advisor
Creates security thought leadership with the customer's executives (e.g., technical decision maker [TDM]/business decision maker [BDM]) using the Microsoft Security and Zero Trust narratives and engages TDM and BDM stakeholders to position security as a business enabler and instill a security mindset in all aspects of the customer's technology landscape. Uses their understanding of the customers' technology and security needs to establish Microsoft’s security credentials and to build opportunities to improve the customer's security posture and orchestrates execution through security specialists.
Leverages a broad knowledge of Microsoft's product landscape, solutions, and strategy to address customer's needs. Proactively coordinates with internal and external network of industry experts (e.g., Regional Experts, industry-specific partners) to build strong knowledge of the industry and the competitive landscape. Drives and leverages leaders from the partner ecosystem to bridge process gaps. Leverages deep understanding of their customer to share knowledge with extended team and leverages advanced knowledge of competitors to promote customer business perspectives. Partners with others (e.g., enterprise-channel managers) to provide sponsorship and increase impact.
Acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and internal advocate by providing insights, feedback, and challenges from the customer to internal teams (e.g., product groups, engineers) across all levels of the organization. Drives action to ensure that internal teams understand and respond to insights. Articulates the business opportunity for Microsoft based on product gaps.
Provides Account thought leadership inclusive of information technology (IT), business strategy knowledge, and technology landscape, and shares best practices internally while providing coaching to subsidiary resources. Leverages account thought leadership in partnership with account executives to set strategy, own accountability for outcomes, and lead extended teams. Provides technical guidance to internal teams to position technology while using customer landscape knowledge. Creates connections and feedback loops with Product and Engineering teams.

jobs.title: Account Technology Strategist - Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG)
jobs.description:
Overview
Microsoft’s Enterprise Account Teams focus on empowering customers on their AI Transformation journey. This team is responsible for envisioning new possibilities for our customers, delivering solutions that result in targeted business outcomes, and driving revenue growth for Microsoft.

As an Account Technology Strategist (ATS) supporting a strategic customer in the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry, you will lead the translation of the customer’s business priorities into a comprehensive technology strategy and roadmap across Microsoft’s portfolio. You will serve as an account CTO and trusted technology advisor , developing deep relationships with the customer’s Chief Information Officer (CIO), Chief Technology Officer (CTO), Chief Digital Officer (CDO), Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and other senior technology and business leaders.

A critical focus of this role will be helping the customer define and execute its Data and AI strategy . As AI becomes increasingly central to enterprise transformation, the ATS must understand how data platforms, data architecture, governance, analytics, generative AI, and agentic AI come together to create secure, scalable, enterprise-ready solutions. You will help the customer connect its data estate and AI ambitions to a broader technology strategy that enables innovation and measurable business outcomes.

In collaboration with the Account Team, you will orchestrate Microsoft and partner resources to bring technology leadership and industry expertise to the customer. You will combine a deep understanding of the customer’s business, technology landscape, Data and AI strategy, and CPG industry priorities with expertise across AI, data, cloud, security, applications, and enterprise technologies to help the customer securely adopt and embrace AI and accelerate its transformation.

This opportunity will allow you to apply your technology and industry expertise at enterprise scale, influence long-term technology strategy, and lead a broad virtual team of Microsoft specialists, engineering resources, services, and partners. You will help the customer connect technology investments to business outcomes while positioning Microsoft as a strategic technology partner.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
Customer Data, AI and Security Strategy Leadership
Understand, document, and articulate the customer’s business objectives, technology landscape, data estate, Data and AI strategy , and security priorities. Lead strategic conversations that help the customer translate business priorities into an actionable enterprise technology roadmap, with particular emphasis on using Data and AI to enable transformation and new business capabilities.

Account CTO and Trusted Technology Advisor
Develop and nurture trusted relationships with C-level technology executives and senior business leaders. Serve as an account CTO, bringing technology thought leadership, industry insights, and an informed point of view to help executives navigate strategic technology decisions. Engage credibly across Data and AI, security, cloud, applications, and emerging technologies and connect these capabilities to the customer’s long-term business strategy.

Data and AI Strategy
Help the customer develop a cohesive strategy connecting its enterprise data estate with its AI ambitions. Bring perspectives across data platforms, data architecture, analytics, governance, security, generative AI, and agentic AI to help create the foundation required to operationalize AI at enterprise scale. Partner with customer technology leaders and Microsoft specialists to identify data and platform opportunities and barriers that may accelerate or constrain AI transformation.

AI Transformation
Bring credible AI technology leadership and anunderstanding of modern AI architectures, generative AI, agentic AI, and enterprise AI platforms to customer conversations. Help the customer evaluate, securely adopt, and operationalize AI technologies while connecting AI innovation to business priorities and measurable outcomes.Engage senior customer leaders on  both the strategic and technical implications of AI, helping distinguish experimentation from capabilities that can be securely governed, integrated, scaled, and operated within a complex global enterprise.

Technology Strategy and Roadmap
Lead the translation of the customer’s desired business outcomes into a cohesive enterprise technology strategy and roadmap. Bring together Data and AI, cloud, security, applications, infrastructure, and other Microsoft capabilities to help the customer modernize its technology estate and achieve its desired future state.

Technical Leadership and Orchestration
Orchestrate Microsoft specialists, engineering, customer success, services, partners, and other technical resources around the customer’s priorities. Establish clarity and alignment across the virtual team to deliver a consistent end-to-end technology strategy and customer experience.  Act as the technical leader of the account team, connecting specialist expertise and individual technology initiatives to the customer’s broader architecture, Data and AI strategy, transformation priorities, and business outcomes.

Customer and Industry Insights
Develop a deep understanding of the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry, including relevant business and technology trends, opportunities, threats, and barriers to growth. Apply these insights to challenge assumptions and bring new perspectives to customer conversations.
Identify opportunities where Data and AI can transform areas such as supply chain, manufacturing, R&D, consumer engagement, commercial execution, productivity, and other core CPG business processes.

Operational and Commercial Excellence
Engage deeply with the customer using consultative selling skills to identify and develop new opportunities, remove technical barriers, drive adoption and usage, and help ensure the customer realizes value from Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions. Connect the technology strategy to execution by helping prioritize technology investments, identify transformation opportunities, and align Microsoft resources around the customer’s most important business and technology priorities.

Qualifications
Required/minimum qualifications
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 7+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, practice building, or related technical/sales/industry experience  - OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications
- Experience developing and leading enterprise technology strategies and roadmaps across large, complex organizations.
- Demonstrated experience with Data and AI, including enterprise data platforms, data architecture, analytics, governance, artificial intelligence, generative AI, and agentic AI.
- Understanding of the relationship between an organization’s data estate, cloud platform, security architecture, and AI strategy, and the ability to translate these technologies into enterprise architecture decisions and business outcomes.
- Demonstrated experience helping organizations evaluate, adopt, and operationalize AI technologies at enterprise scale, including considerations across architecture, data, security, governance, integration, and responsible AI.
- Experience with Microsoft Azure AI, Microsoft Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, or equivalent enterprise Data and AI platforms.
- Experience building trusted relationships with CIO, CTO, CDO, CISO, business unit leaders, and other senior technology and business decision-makers and influencing strategic technology decisions.
- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and emerging technologies to both technical and non-technical executive audiences and connect technology decisions to business strategy and measurable outcomes.
- Experience or knowledge of the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry, including an understanding of industry business priorities, technology trends, and transformation opportunities.
- Experience operating in complex enterprise environments and orchestrating cross-functional technical teams, engineering organizations, partners, and services organizations around a common technology strategy.
- Relevant Data and AI technical certifications or equivalent demonstrated expertise are strongly preferred. Examples include: - Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-901)
- Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103)
- Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Cloud Developer Associate (AI-200)
- Equivalent industry-recognized Data and AI certifications
- Candidates with demonstrated real-world experience designing, advising on, or leading enterprise Data and AI transformation may be considered in lieu of specific certifications.

Microsoft's Azure and AI businesses are experiencing unprecedented growth and investment. As business models, infrastructure requirements, customer demand patterns, and product strategies continue to evolve, leaders require increasingly sophisticated planning frameworks and financial insights to guide decision making.

We are seeking a Senior Finance Manager to lead Integrated Financial Planning across Azure and AI. This role will serve as a key connector across Finance teams threading investment decisions, business performance, and long-range strategic priorities into a cohesive planning framework.

The successful candidate will operate across organizational boundaries to synthesize complex and often disparate inputs into actionable recommendations for senior leadership. Success requires exceptional business judgment, systems thinking, strategic perspective, and the ability to connect financial outcomes to underlying business drivers.

This role is ideal for a finance leader who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, building structure where none exists, and influencing executive decisions through insights.

- Frame complex issues into clear recommendations for leadership discussions.

As Microsoft’s Silicon and Cloud Hardware Infrastructure (SCHIE) business continues to grow, efficient management of engineering investments is essential to deliver silicon and hardware solutions on time, at scale, and with high quality. The SCHIE Product and Procurement Optimization (SPPO) team drives portfolio optimization, governance, and execution controls that support the successful delivery of silicon development and cloud fleet hardware programs across Microsoft’s infrastructure portfolio.

The SPPO (SCHIE Product and Procurement Optimization) team is seeking a Senior Program Manager, Silicon & NPI Portfolio Optimization to drive portfolio strategy, investment governance, and operational execution across complex silicon design, platform development, and New Product Introduction (NPI) programs, including both internally developed silicon and third-party engineering engagements. This role requires a strong understanding of hardware product development spanning silicon, systems, and platform technologies, combined with strategic thinking, business acumen, and a bias for action.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and builds strong partnerships across engineering leaders, technical leads, Finance, Procurement, Global Workplace Services (GWS-lab), Supply Chain, and external partners. Leveraging deep program management expertise, engineering operations, financial acumen, procurement knowledge, and portfolio judgment, this individual will drive portfolio assessments, investment decisions, resource optimization, and data-driven decision making across CAPEX, OPEX, and COGS investments. The role serves as a key bridge between Engineering, Finance, Procurement, and Operations, ensuring engineering investments are optimized to maximize business value, execution predictability, and portfolio outcomes.

Success in this role requires expertise in program management, engineering process optimization, vendor strategy, portfolio assessments, execution planning, and portfolio spend optimization across large-scale silicon and hardware development programs. The role connects engineering priorities with investment governance, TCO analysis, resource planning, and disciplined execution to drive predictable business outcomes.

#SCHIE

Responsibilities
Silicon & NPI Portfolio Management
- Lead portfolio planning, prioritization, and execution across the silicon development lifecycle and NPI programs including architecture, design, emulation, prototyping, validation, silicon and system bring-up.
- Drive portfolio assessments and investment tradeoff decisions by evaluating resource requirements, dependencies, execution risks and priorities across the portfolio.
- Partner with engineering leaders and technical leads to translate product roadmaps into actionable spending forecast and well-funded operational plans aligned with program priorities and business objectives.
- Establish portfolio metrics and escalation frameworks that improve visibility, accountability, and predictable delivery of silicon and NPI portfolio.

Engineering Optimization, Investment Governance & TCO
- Lead long range portfolio investment planning, forecasting, prioritization, and spend optimization across silicon and NPI programs including portfolio reviews, and variance management.
- Develop business cases and apply Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models, NPV to support make-versus-buy decisions, third-party development strategies, vendor selections, infrastructure investments, and long-range technology planning.
- Manage portfolio visibility across CAPEX, OPEX, COGS, NRE, and discretionary spend while ensuring alignment with capitalization policies, financial controls, and investment objectives.
- Identify engineering optimization opportunities across outsourced development, EDA tools, IP, emulation, compute, labs, prototypes, silicon and platform development to improve investment efficiency and engineering productivity.
- Establish investment guardrails and review processes that improve budget management discipline, resource allocation, and portfolio optimization.

Procurement, Vendor & Infrastructure Management
- Manage end-to-end procurement processes, including purchase orders, contracts, supplier commitments, invoicing, accruals, and budget governance across silicon and NPI programs.
- Partner with Engineering, Finance, Procurement, GWS, and suppliers to align infrastructure, lab, facility, and third-party development investments with program roadmaps and milestones.
- Drive vendor and outsourced engineering governance, monitoring performance, delivery commitments, financials, and contractual obligations.
- Identify opportunities for vendor optimization, cost avoidance, infrastructure efficiency, and improved spend visibility through effective governance and planning.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration
- Serve as a trusted advisor to Engineering Leaders, Technical Leads, Finance, Procurement, GWS, and external partners to influence portfolio priorities, investment decisions, and execution outcomes.
- Influence decision-making across organizations, drive clarity on ownership, dependencies, commitments, and escalation paths, and facilitate effective communication between senior leaders and engineering teams.
- Manage risks and recovery plans, provide data-driven recommendations, and deliver concise executive communications that highlight portfolio health, opportunities, key decisions, and recommended actions.

Data, AI & Operational Excellence
- Define and track KPIs for portfolio health, NPI readiness, forecast accuracy, investment efficiency, purchase-order execution, vendor performance, and optimization outcomes.
- Identify and implement AI and agentic AI solutions that improve portfolio planning, forecasting, spend governance, procurement operations, reporting, and executive decision support.
- Develop executive dashboards and reporting mechanisms that convert complex program and spend data into actionable insights.
- Establish scalable business rhythms, governance processes, and reporting mechanisms for portfolio reviews, investment decisions, risk management, and spend governance.

Qualifications

- Demonstrated ability to leverage data, AI, Copilot, and agentic AI capabilities to improve decision-making, automate business processes, optimize portfolio management, and enhance operational efficiency. Experience driving AI adoption and scaling AI-powered workflows across organizations.

jobs.title: Account Technology Strategist - Global Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Overview
Generates innovative business insights, orchestrates teams to develop insights, and applies expertise in customer business in alignment with customer goals. Acts as the "Virtual Technical Officer", provides technical guidance to teams, builds and maintains strong industry and client knowledge, and acts as the voice of the customer. Creates mid- to long-term digital transformation roadmaps while ensuring execution of technological strategy, providing analysis of customer needs, and translating the customer business objectives to develop technology architecture. Leads industry and digital transformation acceleration to identify, create demand, and deliver customer solutions. Drives new opportunities, leads internal teams to accelerate customer digital transformation, and drive conversations regarding value of Microsoft solutions over competitors. Helps customer technical specialists sell Microsoft solutions. Maps technical customer requirements and business scenarios to Microsoft technology platforms. Orchestrates internal teams and local partners to ensure sufficient technical resources for demand generation. Drives account planning to inform quarterly and fiscal objectives. Influences customer technology engagement by engaging technical resources of customer, partner and Microsoft towards customer’s digital transformation. Uses existing and new readiness resources to support enablement plans for customer technology adoption at the national and regional level.

Responsibilities
Customer and Industry Insights
