Challenges customers’ assumptions with constructive dialogue about their business and technology. Leverages industry trends to gather insights and develop an informed perspective on similar issues that may occur within their industry/industries.
- Generates business insights based on knowledge of the customer's technology landscape, engagement experience, and proactive collaboration with the customer, internal teams, and industry, to conduct forecasting and develop recommendations for managing accounts. Challenges customers to consider alternative business models to meet business and market needs, and adapts plans to insights. Orchestrates teams to gather information, collaborate on performance markers, and identify potential risks in customer accounts. Leads technical teams for driving opportunities with other teams, as necessary. Brings in business and industry insights to address the broader business challenges for the customer and deliver solutions.

Differentiated Value Proposition
- Acts as the customer's Technology Mentor in established relationships with senior leaders including technical decision makers (TDMs) and/or Business Unit leaders at the CIO or CIO direct-report level by researching organization charts, identifying and contacting TDMs/BDMs, and beginning to advise on solutions and position Microsoft capabilities to best meet the customer's needs. Leads new opportunities and orchestrates internal teams to accelerate the customer business transformations through digital technologies by understanding the customer industry and position, engaging with customers to lead strategic technology direction/transformation within assigned accounts, and ensuring line-of-business wins are captured (e.g., testimonials) for referencing.
- Drives conversations with enterprise customers that present the strategic relationship between Microsoft technologies, products, and services compared with the competitor's solution and the customer's overall business goals and objectives. Provides an outside-in perspective around compete or other solutions that are also a requirement for the customer.

Education and Thought Leadership
- Uses existing and new readiness resources to support enablement plans for customer technology adoption at the national and regional level. Contributes to innovations to accelerate meeting goals for customer capacity, maximize reach and impact, and drive long-term engagement and thought leadership on the Microsoft platform. Supports customer skilling initiatives and execution.
- Influences customer technology engagement by engaging technical resources of customer, partner, and Microsoft towards customer’s business transformation. Contributes to the delivery of regular (e.g., quarterly, monthly) industry/technology briefings to customer technology decision-makers and technical teams.

Mapping and Account Planning
- Orchestrates internal teams and local partners (inclusive of global systems integrators and consultancy partners) to ensure sufficient technical resources for demand generation, when appropriate.
- Helps customer technical specialists build the message to sell Microsoft offerings to other parts of their business. Creates stakeholder maps for accounts, and determines, and orchestrates a coverage plan.
- Drives account planning for budgeting, quota attainment, consumption goals, and customer consumption gaps to inform quarterly and fiscal objectives. Coordinates extended account teams and drives forecasting and tracking of the business. Owns the technical portion of the account plan and leads the customer plan delivery. Captures all Account Planning input in MSX D365 Account Plan.

Technology Sales: Demand Generation and Orchestration
- Leads Account Strategy Envisioning (ASE, formerly IDTA) with the extended account team, customer, and partner to deliver the outcomes for the customer through joint envisioning, as a vehicle for Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays. Creates new Stage 1 opportunities, both billed and consumed, with technical decision maker (TDM) customer stakeholders, managing consumption pipeline with extended team to maintain velocity, and unblocking issues.
- Identifies customer issues, creates demand, and creates opportunities to uncover new solutions. Creates and qualifies a set number of opportunities for product sales, solution sales, or consumption. Leverages partners to drive demand generation and capitalize on opportunities. Orchestrates efforts to drive MCEM lifecycle and stage progression. Works within a broader strategy to lead efforts with technical teams for driving opportunities including Specialist Team Unit (STU), Customer Success Unit (CSU), and others, as necessary. Contributes to efforts to reach out to key stakeholders to give customer-driven pitches and drives the appropriate customer reach together with the account executive to generate new demand. Uses technical knowledge of products to determine feasibility of technical customer requirements requests and works with core engineering teams to prepare solutions.
- Introduces the customer to benefits of AI and Industrial Metaverse to create interest and excitement about Microsoft's capabilities and shows them how Microsoft technologies can help accelerate their productivity as well as differentiate themselves in the market. Creates follow-up opportunities and orchestrates appropriate technical teams from the Specialist Team Unit (STU) to pursue and close.

Technology Strategy Formulation
- Creates mid- to long-term (e.g., 12 or more months) technology and business roadmaps for one or more accounts, to outline the digital transformation journey and core wins. Updates and articulates business changes in the roadmaps around foundational, traditional capabilities. Builds technical engagement or enablement plan, captures baseline, and drives envisioning to support mid- to long-term business plans. Discusses the strategy and plan with customer stakeholders. Translates an understanding of the customer's business objectives and scenarios in conjunction with Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays to develop technology architecture. Ensures that developed architecture influences cloud journey to position all Microsoft clouds and drives consumption, usage, and a higher share of customer potential and propensity (CPP).
- Ensures execution of technology strategy and/or digital transformation by identifying and resolving technical blockers that arise during strategy planning and implementation and driving technology adoption.
- Provides analysis of overall customer needs, outcomes, and potential blockers. Leverages understanding of business strategies and outcomes that technology can support to advise on gaps that would benefit from Microsoft solutions, and guides internal teams in overall strategy development (e.g., block identification, partner strategy) to identify and address gaps and drive end solutions.

Trusted Advisor
- Proactively builds and maintains a broad knowledge of Microsoft's product landscape, solutions, and strategy in the industry of assigned accounts, as well as of the business priorities and potential threats the customers face. Leverages leaders from the partner ecosystem to bridge process gaps. Coordinates with internal industry experts (e.g., Regional Experts) to gather industry data of assigned accounts and leverages knowledge of competitors to improve planning. Demonstrates a strong understanding of the customer's business strategy and the direction of the industry.
- Leverages account information technology (IT), industry, and business strategy to provide coaching to internal Microsoft teams on customer technology profiles and strategies. Provides technical guidance to internal teams to position technology while using customer landscape knowledge.
- Advises customer technical decision maker (TDM) and business decision maker (BDM) stakeholders on the benefits of embedding security throughout their technology landscape through the Microsoft Security and Zero Trust narratives. Establishes a sense of creating business value through implementing security and positions Microsoft's security credentials. Creates follow-up opportunities and orchestrates appropriate technical teams from the Specialist Team Unit (STU) to pursue and close.
- Acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and internal advocate by providing insights, feedback, and challenges from the customer to internal teams (e.g., product groups, engineers).

Qualifications
Required/minimum qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 4+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience OR equivalent experience.
Additional or preferred qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 8+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience OR equivalent experience.
4+ years experience in relevant customer industry.
4+ years experience in digital transformation, or using technology to drive customer business outcomes.
Business-level English communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage, influence, and present to senior business and technical stakeholders in global environments.

APAC Datacenter Delivery is evolving from a collection of high-performing processes, tools, and governance mechanisms into a fully integrated digital operating system. This role owns the long-term digital strategy, systems architecture, AI roadmap, and integration vision that enable APAC Delivery to operate through One Conversation, One System . jobs.title: AI Transformation - Continuous Improvement Lead
jobs.description:
Overview
The Frontier Transformation Framework helps our customers become Frontier Firms : organisations where AI is part of the operating system the business runs on, moving beyond isolated AI pilots and embedding AI into how the business operates, makes decisions, and delivers value.
The difference between a transformation and a one-off deployment is what happens after go-live. Without a deliberate improvement discipline, returns erode: adoption plateaus, agents drift, prompt libraries go stale, and high-value agents are starved while low-value ones persist. Continuous Improvement is the operating discipline that makes AI value compound over time rather than dissipate.
The Frontier Transformation team is how Microsoft's Frontier Company delivers this: a small, senior human-agent team in which each member brings one of the Framework's eight capabilities to the customer, directs a set of digital co-workers to deliver at a scale headcount alone could not, and is designed to transition capability to a customer counterpart who can carry the work forward.
We are seeking an AI Transformation & Continuous Improvement Lead to help strategic customers turn AI investments into measurable, sustainable business outcomes. In this role, you will establish and run the Continuous Improvement Framework as a permanent operating rhythm, grounded in strong facilitation and continuous improvement principles, that redesigns and optimises workflows to deliver business outcomes.
You will solve the last-mile challenge of AI transformation, embedding what gets built into how work actually gets done through standard work, clear ownership, and an execution cadence that makes new ways of working stick. Working directly with business owners, operators, champions, and the Value, Skilling, Change, and Engineering Leads, you will help customers realise ongoing value from AI-enabled workflows and agents.
This role is for people who are energised by making change stick rather than simply launching it, who can read performance and adoption signals and translate them into the next cycle of improvement, and who believe that a programme that ships once and leaves is a release, not a transformation.
Success in this role means helping customers build the capability to own and sustain their improvement rhythm long after the engagement ends. If you are excited by turning AI deployments into business value that compounds cycle after cycle, this role is for you.

Responsibilities
Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
- Gathers and propagates customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders as well as the main business sponsor that will help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Learns to identify and evaluate industry trends (customer industry verticals, information technology [IT] industry).

- Works with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach to determine if changes are needed to the business solution. Where the cost of change is accepted by the customer, shares this feedback with the project team and the broader account team to make the necessary adjustments using mechanisms such as updating the solution approach and projected costs in presales and change requests in delivery.

- Uses evidence-based approach to function as customer advocate and shares insights with Product Engineering teams and the business with a view to improving Microsoft technologies, products, services, and offerings such that they can better meet customer/partner needs.

Architecture Design and Deployment
- Leverages a structured approach to architecture projects using existing methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, Iterative) that make use of existing reference architecture and established architectural styles and design patterns. Builds and maintains an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to ensure the rationale for the business solution's Architecture is known and understood.

- Defines and documents the Architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Leads cost-based and technology-based discussions to explain the architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Uses a business-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer cost-savings over technical ease of execution.

- Collaborates with the Project Manager to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots. Works with customers to understand and demonstrate business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes.

- Works with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business Users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Manages and resolves ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Maintains the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the Architecture of the business solution. Drives development and execution of Test Plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer. Where there are defects, works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Customer to redress or accept and document the status of the test results.

- Collaborates with the Account Team and/or Bid Team to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer's priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations.

- Builds and documents a realistically costed Solution Approach with traceability of requirements, constraints, decisions, and tradeoffs that balances risk, technical credibility, and technical innovation to meet customer need, predominantly based on existing solution offerings and/or reference architecture.

- Jointly leads the implementation in close partnership with the Project Manager. Exercises oversight and governance and establishes quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Uses a cohesive build methodology with an agreed release schedule and timeline so the solution can be transitioned to live operations.

- Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre-sales value proposition. Works with the Project Manager to highlight where assumptions have proven false. Uses change requests to modify the solution/project approach when needed.

- As needed, collaborates with Subject Matter Experts to receive specialized advice that can help define the solution and project approach and increase the time to value for the customer.

- Identifies scenarios that could slow or impede pre-sales/delivery. Orchestrates the broader Microsoft team to address technical blockers and works with the account/project team to resolve non-technical issues. Reports significant problems to Microsoft management and escalates when needed.

- Plans a way forward in complex and ambiguous situations with an innovative approach and durable design. Delegates and uses specialist skills of others to drive technical alignment across internal/external teams. Coordinates disparate approaches into a single plan of action.

- Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur.

- When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary.

Practice Development
- Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property.

- Identifies which ideas should be culled.

- Drives the re-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre-sales and delivery.

- Participates and contributes to internal/external communities.

Trusted Advisor
- Develops a network of internal/external relationships to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest.

- Stays up to date on Microsoft's technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities.

- Uses evidence-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results.

- Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations.

- Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome.

- Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed.

- Understands competitor solutions and identifies how customer business value can be driven through Microsoft's offerings.

- Steers the customer/partner conversations to the benefits of the solution rather than the features and functionalities.

Thought Leadership
- Shares ideas, insight, and strategic, technical input with technical teams, internal communities across the field, and the larger virtual team across Microsoft using a thorough knowledge of specific Microsoft products and their context in the competitive landscape.

- Participates in external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, webcasts, blogs, hackathons) and shares learnings with internal team.

- Acts as a mentor to less experienced colleagues to educate them on technical and non-technical concepts.

Other
- Embody our culture and values.

Qualifications
Required/Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

OR
- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 4+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

OR
- Equivalent experience.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

OR

jobs.title: Intelligent Optimization Lead, Continuous Improvement
jobs.location: United States, Multiple Locations, Multiple Locations
jobs.description:
Overview
The Frontier Transformation Framework helps our customers become Frontier Firms: organizations where AI is part of the operating system the business runs on. The difference between a transformation and a one-off deployment is what happens after go-live. Without a deliberate improvement and optimization discipline, returns erode: adoption plateaus, agents drift, prompt libraries go stale, and high-value agents are starved while low-value ones persist. Intelligent Optimization is the operating discipline that makes AI value compound over time rather than dissipate. The Frontier Transformation team is how the Microsoft Frontier Company, the organization this role sits within, delivers this: a small, senior human-agent team in which each member carries one of the Framework's eight capabilities into the customer, directs a set of digital co-workers to deliver at a scale headcount alone could not, and is designed to fade into a customer counterpart who can carry the work forward.

We are seeking a Intelligent Optimization Lead, Continuous Improvement to make AI value compound across strategic customer engagements. In this role, you will establish and run the Intelligent Optimization Framework as a permanent operating rhythm, grounded in kaizen and strong facilitation, that redesigns and reruns workflows to outcomes. You will solve the last-mile problem, embedding what gets built into how work actually gets done through standard work, clear ownership, and an execution cadence that makes new ways of working stick, working directly with business owners, operators, champions, and the Value, Skilling, Change, and engineering leads.
This is a role for people who are energized by making change hold rather than launching it, who can read measurement signals and turn them into the next round of improvement, and who believe a program that ships once and leaves is just a release, not a transformation. You are designed to fade into a customer counterpart who owns the improvement rhythm after the engagement ends. If you are excited by turning AI deployments into value that compounds cycle after cycle, this role is for you.

Responsibilities
- Establish and run the Continuous Improvement Framework as a permanent, always-on operating rhythm rather than a one-off activity, grounded in kaizen and strong facilitation.
- Redesign and rerun workflows to outcomes, running structured improvement cycles in which each measurement cycle feeds and improves the next.
- Solve the last-mile problem by embedding new ways of working into standard work, clear ownership, and a disciplined execution cadence.
- Read the Copilot Dashboard and other measurement signals to find where usage is shallow, which roles are stuck, and where behavior change is or is not landing, and convert those signals into prioritized improvements.
- Continuously refine prompt libraries, enablement materials, and agent configurations based on usage data and Work IQ behavior signals.
- Detect and correct agent drift, retire or rework low-value agents, and direct further investment toward high-ROI agents.
- Establish standard work, ownership, and review cadences that make improvements durable and repeatable across teams.
- Facilitate improvement events and retrospectives that treat friction and feedback as inputs to the next cycle rather than one-off fixes.
- Capture reusable improvement patterns and playbooks that raise the quality and speed of every subsequent cycle.
- Transfer the continuous improvement discipline, cadences, and tooling to the customer's own people so the rhythm is sustained after the engagement fades.
- Recommend and drive the discontinuation of workflows, agents, and enablement assets that are not returning value (including work the engagement itself originally built) to ensure capacity flows to the most important value.

Success in this role looks like:
- AI value compounds cycle after cycle rather than plateauing after initial deployment.
- Adoption deepens, agents stay tuned and current, and prompt libraries and enablement stay fresh.
- New ways of working stick because they are embedded in standard work, ownership, and an execution cadence.
- Investment flows to high-ROI agents while low-value ones are reworked or retired.
- The customer runs the continuous improvement rhythm independently after the engagement fades.
- Low value work is deprioritized and stopped. Subtraction is accepted by the customer as a normal part of the improvement rhythm.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
- Master's Degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Information Systems, or related field AND 4+ years experience in continuous improvement, operational excellence, process improvement, or transformation delivery - OR Business, Engineering, Operations, Information Systems or related field AND 6+ years experience in continuous improvement, operational excellence, process improvement, or transformation delivery
- OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications
- Proven track record running continuous improvement or operational excellence programs that delivered sustained, measurable results.
- Hands-on experience with kaizen, Lean, or comparable improvement methodologies and facilitation of improvement events.
- Experience establishing standard work, ownership models, and execution cadences that make change durable.
- Experience with quality assurance or evaluation practices for production systems.
- Ability to read operational and adoption metrics and translate them into prioritized improvements.
- Strong facilitation and stakeholder-management skills across business and technical teams.
- Ability to work directly with operators and business owners to embed new ways of working into daily operations.
- Strong problem-solving skills in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
- Lean, Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt), or equivalent continuous improvement certification.
- Experience improving AI or automation solutions in production, including managing model, prompt, or agent performance over time.
- Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot adoption and the Copilot Dashboard in Viva Insights, and with using usage signals to drive improvement.
- Understanding of agent operations, including drift detection, evaluation, and lifecycle management.
- Experience linking improvement work to value and P&L outcomes.
- Industry depth in one or more sectors such as Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Energy, or Government.
- Experience transferring a continuous improvement capability into a client's own organization.

jobs.description:
Overview
Engages with customer stakeholders to develop partnerships, leveraging broad technical expertise. Drives customer satisfaction by engaging with customers stakeholders in a positive manner, reviewing and analyzing customer feedback, and leveraging trusted relationships with key internal resources to act as the voice of the customer. Adheres to project compliance standards and requirements of the contract and accommodates customer compliance standards. Drives project initiation for projects of medium complexity by delivering a workstream within a larger project/program. Facilitates contracting process for partner resources by briefing partners, coordinating partner candidate interviews, and identifying and acclimating partner resources to the team. Develops detailed project management plan to drive predictable delivery for projects of medium complexity or supports senior colleagues in projects of high complexity. Provides review of defined metrics, proactively monitors and tracks risks, ensures timely completion and quality of deliverables, and manages stakeholder communications. Drives timely project closure by ensuring completion of project sign off tasks. Applies advanced knowledge across project management principle areas, contributes at local team-wide level to share knowledge and support others, serves as a mentor colleagues to grow identified skill gaps, and participates in cross-border mentoring and peer alignment to share lessons learned on challenging projects.

Responsibilities
Account Delivery Management
- Drives and maintains obligations to customer across the delivery lifecycle including envisioning, solution development, delivery planning, cloud consumption and usage, delivery management while ensuring adherence to security best practices in partnership with Solution Area SMEs. Ensures that customer-required or market-required security certifications are active. Leads or participates in steering committee meetings with strategic customers to discuss progress toward delivery success.
- Contributes to consumption activities, through others (e.g., Customer Success resources), for customers by identifying blockers to consumption goals and enabling customers, through internal teams, to get the full value of their purchases. Holds accountability for project delivery forecast.
- Supports relationships with key stakeholders in the customer portfolio to ensure service delivery is on track and issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed. Communicates current view of delivery to customer stakeholders, as appropriate.
- Collaborates with Sales to support contract setup, signature, compliance, and execution from deal approvals to invoicing and closure. Manages areas of fiscal responsibility within project portfolio, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.

Business Growth
- Demonstrates accountability for the financial health of a project or program (e.g., revenue attainment, accurate forecasting, cost management, and utilization, skills, and capacity planning). Identifies opportunities to accelerate and drive consumption and delivery. Owns and drives backlog risk management. Drives incremental business on top of existing projects and programs through next step proposals, conducts customer discussions related to next stage proposal (NSP) and other opportunities. Engages in the pursuit cycle to ensure deals are structured appropriately. Supports and contributes to rhythm of business (ROB) and Chief Financial Officer (CFO) forecasting.
- Looks for or creates opportunities to maximize timely cloud consumption through current deliveries. Identifies new opportunities with customers and facilitates follow up conversations with customers on Consumption both strategically and operational, and to accelerate delivery or prevent delivery delays.

Closure
- Applies advanced knowledge across project management principle areas to execution and delivery, contributes at local team-wide level to share knowledge and support others, serves as a mentor to less experienced colleagues to grow identified skill gaps, and participates in cross-border mentoring and peer alignment to share lessons learned on challenging projects.
- Drives timely project closure by ensuring completion of project sign off tasks (e.g., system closeout updates, deletion of customer data, Deliverable Acceptance Form). Drives incremental process improvement by reflecting on and sharing lessons learned across teams, creating and suggesting improvements to intellectual property (IP), providing feedback to managers on team member performance, and conducting closeout interviews with team members.

Contracting
- Facilitates contracting process for customer and partner resources (e.g., contractors, vendors) by briefing partners, coordinating partner candidate interviews, and identifying and acclimating partner resources to the team. Supports negotiation and structuring of fixed-fee subcontractor contracts with oversight from senior colleagues. Monitors and initiates Amendments, Delivery Acceptance, Proof of Delivery, and Invoicing processes. Reviews contracts according to security and data governance standards.

Initiation
- Balances needs across projects in challenging situations (e.g., scarce technical resources), with support from senior colleagues as needed, and collaborates with other groups (e.g., resource managers, Global Delivery Center) on integrated planning and organization of projects.
- Drives project initiation for projects of medium complexity (e.g., multiple offerings, and/or supports projects of high complexity (e.g., tailored offerings, high visibility, high impact, market making) by delivering a workstream within a larger project/program, by driving commitment of delivery resources, assigning resources, assisting in sourcing and qualifying partner resources, and creating work breakdown structures (WBSs) with delivery team.

Intellectual Property (IP)
- Researches and proactively shares intellectual property (IP) and provides recommendations for improvement including submitting new IP. Holds others accountable for reusing appropriate IP and collective knowledge by enforcing use of processes and artifacts with team members.

Monitoring and Controlling
- Orchestrates and oversees a broad range of project metrics on midsize to large projects with high visibility (e.g., Vice President-level). Proactively ensures adherence to key performance indicators (KPIs) and provides strategic direction to drive success throughout project lifecycle.
- Discusses and confirms Microsoft change control processes at kickoff with customer. Anticipates changes and proactively addresses by probing to ensure change can happen smoothly early in the process. Tests process before initiating formal change.
- Ensures timely completion and quality of deliverables (e.g., documents) and tracking of agreed upon metrics for projects of standard complexity by applying quality management techniques (e.g., benchmarking, interviews) for collecting data. Uses analyses to identify solutions to systemic issues.
- Proactively manages risks (including security risks) and issues within projects of standard complexity, leveraging technical knowledge and previous experience to evaluate risks, perform qualitative analyses (e.g., probability, impact, urgency), create risk management plans, establish processes, and work with cross-functional groups and leaders to mitigate identified risks. Contributes to recovery efforts and ensures tools are updated. Manages issue closure as a high priority. Ensures that the mandatory Information Security Risk Assessment (ISRA) is completed during project initiation, is regularly reviewed, and is signed off by accredited InfoSec Delivery Compliance Leads during delivery. Reports Security and Data Compliance breaches in a timely manner (using ReportItNow and other pertinent customer reporting outlets as applicable), informing both internal and external stakeholders.
- Manages stakeholder communications on project health, issues, and financial performance for mid-size to large deals throughout entire project lifecycle, tailoring communications to the audience. Tracks and maintains customer deliverables.
- Manages finances for projects with mid-size to large scopes and budgets by balancing funding and resources across workstreams, performing analyses, and leveraging cost management experience and expertise. Aims to reduce cost and improve delivery margin without impact to quality or customer experience and understands impact of decisions on the broader business (e.g., profits and losses [P&L], accrual-based accounting).

Planning
- Develops detailed project management plan to drive predictable delivery for projects of medium complexity or supports senior colleagues in projects of high complexity, leveraging existing materials and experience to drive scope, resources, and Microsoft project schedule in alignment and collaboration with customer plan. Ensures use of baselining, resource load balancing, and application of work effort, dependency management, contingency planning, and utilization of software (e.g., Timeline).
- Establishes clear expectations and accountabilities (e.g., reconfirm scope, Responsible-Accountable-Consulted-Informed matrix) with all project team members (e.g., consultants) and stakeholders for teams of medium complexity by leading internal and external kick-off meetings (e.g., sales to delivery handoff, formal kick-off meetings). Integrates security-first mindset into expectations for self and others. Proactively engages broad set of internal and external stakeholders, including those who are impacted by project scope/outcome, but not directly involved (e.g., Enterprise Operating Unit, India Global Delivery, customer stakeholders) and engages subject matter experts in holistic planning activities, including team validation.

Presales

Participates in review of proposed scope and assists in developing Statement of Work (SOW), Work Breakdown Structures (WBSs), estimates, preliminary risk assessments, etc. Ensures that ISD consulting deal appropriately includes Delivery Compliance, Privacy & Security (DCPS) package to fund Secure by Default activities.

Relationship Development
- Engages with customer stakeholders to develop partnerships, leveraging broad technical expertise. Manages escalations or ensures resolution of escalations with customer stakeholders through tailored corrective action (e.g., education) and overcomes ambiguous situations as needed. Learns to leverage project sponsors and internal network to influence stakeholders and resolve situations.
- Drives customer satisfaction by engaging with customers stakeholders in a positive manner, reviewing and analyzing customer feedback, and leveraging trusted relationships with key internal resources to act as the voice of the customer. Manages expectations with political sensitivity by leading Success Expectation discussions with customer, and documenting, executing, and monitoring through customer and partner experience (CPE).
- Adheres to project compliance standards (e.g., confidentiality, privacy, security) and requirements of the contract and accommodates customer compliance standards, including managing compliance-related complexities (e.g., high sensitivity to confidentiality). Champions compliance by contributing to knowledge sharing across teams to build compliance capability of others.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in related field AND 3+ years experience in project management OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:
The successful candidate must have an active U.S. Government Top Secret Security Clearance . Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. Failure to maintain or obtain the appropriate clearance and/or customer screening requirements may result in employment action up to and including termination.

Overview
Join the Microsoft Devices Operations (MDO) team in Redmond, WA as a  Senior Channel Operations Manager,  where you'll lead end-to-end channel operations by driving data-informed decision-making, optimizing planning and execution, and enhancing partner performance. Orchestrate demand, supply, and sales alignment to deliver solid sell-in/sell-through outcomes, while improving channel efficiency, inventory health, and operational scalability. Champion continuous transformation through advanced analytics, automation, and AI-enabled insights. Build strategic partnerships and cross-functional alignment to deliver measurable business impact, drive innovation, and adapt to evolving market dynamics.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
Strategic Account Performance & Business Outcomes
- Defines and owns strategic account and channel health metrics spanning demand quality, supply alignment, inventory, fulfillment, partner experience, sell-in, and sell-through outcomes.
- Identifies forward-looking risks and opportunities from partner, market, financial, and industry signals and converts them into clear decisions and corrective actions.
- Drives data-informed strategy adjustments, root-cause analysis, and continuous reporting improvements through advanced analytics and AI-enabled insights.

Operating Model & AI Transformation
- Leads the transformation to proactive, outcome-based strategic account operations.
- Identifies, pilots, operationalizes, and scales AI and agentic solutions, measuring success through productivity, speed, quality, customer experience, and cost impact.

Commercial Strategy & Channel Growth
- Partners with Sales and Marketing while independently owning the operational outcomes required to deliver effective merchandising, sell-in, sell-through, and partner performance.
- Establishes differentiated engagement models and reciprocal accountability with strategic retailers, distributors, and channel partners.

Executive Insights & Decision Intelligence
- Translates complex and ambiguous data into account strategies, business trade-offs, executive recommendations, and measurable actions.
- Improves forecast quality, signal convergence, order adherence, and decision velocity through analytics, automation, and AI-enabled workflows.
- Builds organizational capability by coaching peers, establishing analytical standards, and embedding outcome-based reviews into the rhythm of business.

Strategic Partner Leadership & Joint Planning
- Builds strategic partner relationships and leads formal collaborative planning, forecasting, and replenishment processes for priority accounts.
- Leads recurring account-health and business reviews, reconciles partner and field signals at account and SKU level, and drives shared corrective plans before performance misses occur.
- Influences partner strategies and extends proven AI, automation, and innovation capabilities into joint operating processes.

Demand-to-Delivery & Inventory Optimization
- Optimizes end-to-end demand, supply, order, fulfillment, and inventory processes to improve customer outcomes and operational scalability.
- Balances customer demand, supply availability, revenue and margin commitments, and inventory risk to improve financial performance and cost to serve.
- Leads root-cause analysis and postmortems and converts regional learning into standardized, repeatable, and increasingly touchless global capabilities.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications:

Overview
The Travel and Card Operations Program Manager will support the delivery, operational governance, optimization, and continuous improvement of Microsoft’s global corporate Travel and Card programs, helping ensure consistent, scalable, and effective program operations across a complex global environment.

This role will focus on building scalable operational solutions across corporate travel and payments , including the development and optimization of corporate card and commercial payment solutions    that improve efficiency, financial controls, reconciliation, and employee experience.

The successful candidate will bring hands-on corporate travel and payments experience , strong operational program management capabilities, and an AI-first mindset . The role will identify opportunities to simplify processes, automate manual activities, improve service delivery, and build solutions that can scale across a complex global organization.

This role will partner closely with Procurement, Finance, Controllership, Human Resources, and business stakeholders, including Finance Controllers, HR Business Partners, Budget Managers, and Business Managers , to understand business requirements and translate them into practical, scalable Travel and Card solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong knowledge of corporate travel operations and commercial payment programs with a builder mentality, using data, AI, automation, and process improvement to solve operational challenges and continuously improve the employee experience.

Responsibilities
Scalable, AI-First Operations

- Apply an AI-first mentality to Travel and Card operations by identifying opportunities to automate repetitive work, improve decision-making, and simplify employee and operational experiences.

- Identify practical applications of AI, automation, analytics, and workflow capabilities across travel servicing, payment operations, employee support, reconciliation, compliance, and reporting.

- Design processes and solutions with scalability in mind, reducing reliance on manual activities and one-off operational support.

- Use experimentation, data, operational insights, and customer feedback to continuously improve Travel and Card processes.

- Support the adoption and operationalization of new tools and capabilities that improve program efficiency and employee experience.

- Balance business requirements with global program standards, financial controls, operational scalability, policy requirements, and employee experience.

Travel Operations & Governance

- Support the effective delivery and governance of Microsoft’s global corporate travel program, driving consistency, scalability, and operational excellence across markets .

- Monitor operational performance, service trends, employee feedback, and recurring issues to identify opportunities for program improvement.

- Support global and regional program changes, ensuring operational requirements, stakeholder needs, and employee experience are considered throughout implementation.

Global Card Program & Payment Solutions

- Support the operational management, optimization and continuous improvement of Microsoft’s global corporate Card Program .

- Support the design, implementation and ongoing management of corporate card and commercial payment solutions that improve employee experience, operational efficiency, financial controls and scalability.

jobs.description:
Overview
Are you passionate about contributing to a high-performing global team that values collaboration, process excellence, and innovation? Do you want to help improve payment experiences that prioritize stakeholder value through compliant, accurate, and scalable execution?
The Global Payout Solutions (GPS) team within Microsoft comprises experts in compliant and accurate payments to Microsoft suppliers and partners. We use digital technologies and data-driven insights to streamline payment processes and inform business decisions.

We are:
People Focused - The needs, well-being, and growth of the team are priorities.
Tomorrow-minded - We focus on innovation and scalability to drive business outcomes.
Data Driven - Decisions and actions are based on data insights.
Customer Obsessed - The needs of our stakeholders, partners, and payment recipients inform our decisions and actions.
Curious - We are passionate about learning, willing to take thoughtful risks, and committed to learning quickly from setbacks.
As a Royalty Operations Program Manager within Global Payout Solutions, you will manage and coordinate defined activities across the end-to-end administration of complex outbound royalty agreements for an assigned portfolio supporting a broad range of Microsoft businesses, including, but not limited to, Gaming, Azure, Advertising, Hardware, and third-party intellectual property. This Business Operations and Process Management role combines contract interpretation, operational execution, data analysis, controls, issue resolution, and cross-functional stakeholder management. You will translate contractual and commercial terms into clear, controlled, and scalable operating requirements; partner with business, legal, finance, engineering, outsourced/BPO operations, and internal operations teams; and help ensure royalty statements and payments are accurate, timely, compliant, and supported by complete evidence. You will use data, dashboards, and operating metrics to identify risk, investigate variances, improve controls, monitor outsourced operational performance, and advance standardization and automation across a high-volume global operation. This role is well suited to someone who combines process discipline, analytical rigor, sound judgment, attention to detail, ownership, and the ability to influence across teams.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

Responsibilities
- Support the end-to-end royalty agreement lifecycle, including administrability review, contract setup, operational requirements, system readiness, statement validation, payment execution, amendments, and termination activities.
- Interpret complex royalty and commercial terms and translate them into clear calculation, reporting, data, payment, evidence, and control requirements; identify terms that cannot be reliably administered and recommend practical alternatives.
- Partner with business development, legal, finance, engineering, outsourced/BPO operations, and internal royalty operations teams to clarify ownership, manage dependencies, resolve issues, and support timely launch and ongoing execution.
- Execute governance routines for outsourced operations, monitor quality and service performance, coordinate escalations, support standardization, and follow through on corrective actions and agreed outcomes.
- Oversee operational validation of royalty statements, payment inputs, adjustments, and supporting evidence to confirm completeness, contractual alignment, payment accuracy, compliance, and process readiness.
- Identify, investigate, document, and escalate material variances, control gaps, recurring defects, partner-impacting issues, and risks to payment accuracy, contractual compliance, partner experience, or timely delivery.
- Use data, and operating metrics to monitor accuracy, timeliness, automation, backlog, partner experience, cost, and service performance; translate findings into decisions, corrective actions, and process improvements.
- Maintain operational controls, standard operating procedures, decision records, training materials, and process documentation that support compliance, audit readiness, security, evidence retention, change management, and adoption.
- Recommend and implement standardization, simplification, and automation improvements within assigned royalty processes to reduce manual effort, improve scalability, strengthen controls, and enable exception-based operations.
- Communicate program health, key risks, decisions, tradeoffs, and recommended actions to stakeholders and leadership through concise written updates, business reviews, and presentations.
- Embody our  culture and values

Qualifications
Required/minimum qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 2+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR equivalent experience.
Additional or preferred qualifications
- Master's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 3+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 5+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR equivalent experience.
- Ability to interpret complex contractual and commercial terms and translate them into accurate, repeatable operational requirements.
- Strong analytical and operational validation skills, with the ability to evaluate large or complex data sets, identify variances, determine root causes, and make well-supported recommendations.
- Understanding of operational controls, compliance requirements, audit support, and evidence-based process execution; experience working in a controlled business environment is preferred.
- High attention to detail and demonstrated ability to verify the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of contracts, calculations, statements, payments, and supporting documentation.
- Strong ownership, judgment, and prioritization skills, including the ability to work through ambiguity, assess risk, manage competing priorities, and escalate issues with clear facts and recommended actions.
- Clear written and oral communication skills, with the ability to prepare effective emails, documents, reports, proposals, presentations, and leadership updates for different audiences.
- Demonstrated ability to build productive cross-functional relationships, influence without direct authority, and follow through with partners on agreed actions, timelines, and outcomes.
- Ability to adapt communication and work approach to different audiences, changing priorities, and an evolving program and operating environment.
- Experience using Excel to analyze operational and payment data and PowerPoint to communicate decisions and program status; experience with dashboards, workflow tools, royalty platforms, automation, or AI-enabled process improvements is preferred.
- Experience working with outsourced operations, BPO providers, managed service teams, or vendor-supported operational processes, including monitoring service quality, coordinating escalations, and following through on corrective actions, is preferred.

jobs.title: Platform Operations Manager - Digital Commerce & Marketing Technology
jobs.location: United States, Washington, Redmond; United States, California, Mountain View; United States, Georgia, Atlanta
jobs.description:
Overview
The Consumer eCommerce (CeC) organization is seeking a technically proficient, hands-on Platform Operations Manager  to administer, operate, govern, and continuously improve a growing ecosystem of enterprise SaaS platforms supporting digital commerce, content management, marketing, customer engagement, analytics, and related internal business operations.
This role will serve as the primary business-side technical administrator and operational owner for assigned SaaS platforms, ensuring employees, vendors, and external partners have secure, compliant, reliable, and efficient access to the technologies required to deliver business outcomes.
The ideal candidate combines practical, hands-on SaaS administration experience with expertise in identity and access management, platform configuration, security and privacy controls, operational excellence, vendor management, and cross-functional leadership.
As the organization modernizes its technology ecosystem, this individual will establish and execute standardized operating models, governance frameworks, administration practices, and lifecycle management processes that ensure enterprise SaaS platforms remain secure, scalable, compliant, reliable, and easy for internal customers to use.
The role requires someone comfortable working directly within platform administration consoles, configuring access and permissions, troubleshooting technical issues, supporting integrations, and implementing operational controls, while collaborating with Engineering, Security, Privacy, Product, Legal, Procurement, Finance, and external technology providers.

Responsibilities
Platform Administration & Day-to-Day Operations
- Serve as the primary business-side technical administrator for assigned enterprise SaaS platforms, directly managing day-to-day platform administration, configuration, user access, and operational maintenance.

- Configure and maintain platform settings, administrative roles, user permissions, security configurations, and supported integrations within established change-control boundaries.

- Monitor platform availability, operational health, service performance, utilization, adoption, and vendor-reported incidents.

- Troubleshoot platform configuration, authentication, authorization, provisioning, integration, and operational issues, resolving problems within administrative scope and escalating complex technical issues when necessary.

- Execute approved platform configuration changes, releases, upgrades, and maintenance activities, including testing, impact validation, and post-change verification.

- Maintain accurate platform inventories, configuration documentation, administrative procedures, operational runbooks, and knowledge resources.

- Establish and maintain support models, incident response procedures, service-level expectations, escalation paths, and clear operational ownership.

- Ensure consistent and reliable platform operations while identifying opportunities to reduce manual activities, increase automation, and improve service quality.

Identity, Access & RBAC Administration
- Define, configure, and maintain role-based access control (RBAC) models across supported SaaS platforms, including role hierarchies, permission boundaries, approval workflows, and separation-of-duties controls.

- Directly administer user accounts, groups, permissions, roles, and access entitlements across assigned platforms.

- Administer and govern employee, vendor, and external partner access  to supported SaaS platforms, including appropriate authorization, time-bound access, periodic reviews, and timely deprovisioning.

- Establish and execute standardized user provisioning, deprovisioning, access modifications, approval processes, and access lifecycle management.

- Partner with identity engineering teams to configure, implement, and maintain SSO, Microsoft Entra ID integrations, SCIM provisioning, group-based access controls, and automated provisioning capabilities.

- Investigate and resolve authentication, authorization, provisioning, and access-related issues.

- Lead quarterly user access certification reviews, identifying and remediating excessive privileges, inactive accounts, stale entitlements, and unauthorized permissions.

- Maintain audit-ready documentation of access approvals, administrative changes, certification activities, and remediation actions.

- Apply least-privilege principles and balance secure access controls with efficient internal user experiences.

Platform Governance & Cross-Functional Leadership
- Define, implement, and maintain a consistent operational governance framework across business-managed SaaS platforms within the digital commerce ecosystem.

- Establish platform operating standards, policies, controls, decision rights, accountability models, and administrative practices across multiple vendors and technologies.

- Develop and maintain platform-specific operating policies, administrative standards, and control procedures  aligned with enterprise technology, security, privacy, and compliance requirements.

- Lead cross-functional platform operations initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Security, Privacy, Legal, Procurement, Finance, business stakeholders, and external vendors.

- Establish and maintain operational governance forums, decision-making structures, escalation mechanisms, and recurring operating rhythms.

- Define clear roles and responsibilities across business owners, platform administrators, Engineering teams, enterprise technology functions, and SaaS providers.

- Drive operational readiness for new platform implementations, vendor onboarding, integrations, and major capability launches.

- Maintain operational risk registers, mitigation plans, key decisions, action tracking, and escalation records, ensuring issues are addressed with clearly accountable owners.

- Drive measurable improvements in platform governance maturity, operational consistency, security, reliability, and efficiency.

Security, Privacy & Compliance Operations
- Partner with enterprise Security, Privacy, Legal, and Compliance organizations to ensure supported SaaS platforms meet applicable enterprise standards and regulatory requirements.

- Implement and maintain approved platform security configurations, administrative safeguards, and operational controls aligned with enterprise policies.

- Support security assessments, privacy reviews, risk assessments, audit activities, and compliance certifications.

- Maintain accurate inventories and documentation of sensitive data, platform data flows, integrations, administrative access, and control ownership.

- Monitor operational control effectiveness, identify gaps, and drive remediation activities with accountable teams and vendors.

- Support evidence collection, documentation, and validation required for internal audits, compliance reviews, and security assessments.

- Champion secure-by-design and privacy-by-design operational practices, including least-privilege access, appropriate separation of duties, and controlled administrative changes.

- Balance enterprise security and governance requirements with platform usability, accessibility, and business productivity.

Platform Integrations, Change Management & Lifecycle Operations
- Support the operational administration of platform integrations, connectors, authentication configurations, data exchange mechanisms, and related technical dependencies.

- Work with Engineering, Data, Identity, and vendor teams to troubleshoot integration failures, connector errors, access-related issues, and configuration problems.

- Maintain operational visibility into integration health, ownership, monitoring, dependencies, and escalation procedures.

- Establish and execute standardized intake, prioritization, change-management, testing, deployment, and rollback processes for platform enhancements and operational requests.

- Coordinate platform releases, configuration changes, integrations, incidents, maintenance windows, and operational readiness activities with internal teams and technology providers.

- Support the technical and operational onboarding of new SaaS vendors , including administrative setup, access controls, identity integration, support arrangements, and operational handover.

- Ensure new platforms and capabilities have documented administration models, access controls, configuration standards, support procedures, and operational handover before production adoption.

- Maintain platform lifecycle documentation, including technical configurations, operational dependencies, change histories, and administration procedures.

- Assess operational impacts and risks associated with technology upgrades, vendor changes, new integrations, and platform capability expansions.

Vendor, Licensing & Platform Portfolio Management
- Serve as the operational lead for assigned business-managed SaaS platforms, coordinating vendor support, service performance, operational governance, and technical escalations.

- Manage day-to-day operational interactions with SaaS vendors, including technical support cases, incident resolution, service commitments, and escalation management.

- Coordinate vendor operational business reviews, governance discussions, service performance assessments, and renewal readiness activities.

- Monitor software utilization, licensing allocations, administrative privileges, vendor service levels, and operational spend.

- Identify and drive opportunities to optimize licensing, reduce unnecessary costs, improve software utilization, and increase operational efficiency.

- Provide operational insights and recommendations to Product, Procurement, Finance, and technology leaders to support vendor evaluations, technology planning, and renewal decisions.

- Conduct periodic assessments of platform capabilities, operational risks, service maturity, technology dependencies, and improvement opportunities across the SaaS portfolio.

- Ensure consistent vendor accountability and operational standards across multiple SaaS providers and technologies.

Internal Customer Experience, Support & Enablement
- Serve as a technical and operational point of contact for internal platform users, administrators, business teams, vendors, and partners.

- Resolve user access, provisioning, permissions, configuration, and operational support requests within the defined support model.

- Develop and maintain streamlined onboarding and offboarding experiences, user enablement resources, training materials, and self-service capabilities.

- Establish clear support processes, response expectations, escalation channels, and knowledge-management practices.

- Simplify operational processes for platform users and administrators to improve productivity and reduce unnecessary administrative effort.

- Drive platform adoption, usage best practices, and internal customer satisfaction across supported platform communities.

- Partner with business and Product teams to identify recurring user challenges, improve platform usability, and prioritize operational improvements.

- Champion secure-by-design, accessible user experiences that balance business productivity with governance discipline.

Operational Excellence, Automation & Reporting
- Establish and maintain consistent operational processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), administration standards, and service management practices across supported SaaS platforms.

- Identify and implement opportunities to automate repetitive administrative activities, including user provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews, support workflows, monitoring, and operational reporting.

- Establish KPIs and reporting mechanisms for platform health, access compliance, utilization, adoption, incident resolution, service levels, governance effectiveness, and internal customer experience.

- Measure governance effectiveness  through access review completion, remediation closure, policy adherence, control exceptions, and operational accountability.

- Develop executive-level dashboards and provide structured inputs into quarterly business reviews (QBRs), platform governance discussions, and leadership operating rhythms.

- Track operational risks, mitigation plans, decisions, escalations, and improvement initiatives through resolution.

- Monitor operational trends, recurring incidents, service performance, and control effectiveness to identify opportunities for optimization.

- Lead continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual effort, strengthen security and compliance, improve service reliability, and enhance operational efficiency.

- Drive consistent operational standards and measurable outcomes across the enterprise SaaS portfolio.

Qualifications
Required/minimum qualifications
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS administration, platform operations, enterprise application operations, IT operations, identity management, or a related technical discipline, OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications
- Demonstrated hands-on experience administering enterprise SaaS applications, including platform configuration, user administration, permissions management, operational support, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

- Practical knowledge of identity and access management concepts, including RBAC, SSO, user provisioning and deprovisioning, least-privilege access, and permission lifecycle management.

- Experience troubleshooting platform configuration, authentication, authorization, integration, or operational issues in an enterprise technology environment.

- Experience implementing or maintaining standardized operational procedures, platform controls, and technical documentation.

- Experience collaborating with Engineering, Security, Privacy, Product, IT, or business stakeholder teams to maintain secure and reliable technology operations.

jobs.title: Program Manager (CRADA) - CTJ - TS/SCI
jobs.location: United States, North Carolina, Raleigh; United States, North Carolina, Durham; United States, North Carolina, Morrisville
jobs.description:
Overview
Microsoft is seeking a  Program Manager to serve as the on-site representative of Microsoft engineering to a strategic government partner. The role exists because what matters most in this partnership cannot be learned at a distance: what the partner needs and what it will need next surface in hallways, in after-action reviews, and in the ordinary course of a workday spent alongside its people.
You will therefore work from the partner's site five days a week, and you will own the rhythm of business that keeps our Cooperative Research and Development Agreement (CRADA) healthy — coordinating across internal and external stakeholders to schedule, plan, and execute the meetings and decision forums the partnership depends on.
While approximately 95% of the role follows a predictable schedule, there are occasional periods when the organization shifts into crisis-response mode and requires extended support. During these infrequent events, flexibility and a willingness to support mission-critical activities outside of standard working hours are important.

Responsibilities
The work follows a straightforward mission: identify partner needs, translate those needs into actionable requirements, and help deliver capabilities that make a real impact.  At any given time, you will guide multiple efforts through that lifecycle, helping each move forward while building trusted relationships across Microsoft and our partner organization.

A significant part of the role focuses on customer requirements discovery. Using a user-centered and human-centered design framework, you will work closely with users to understand their environment, challenges, and goals. Through interviews, structured observation, and day-to-day engagement, you will identify who the users are, how they operate, what capabilities they need, and why those needs matter. You will then translate those insights into clear technical requirements that engineering teams can build against. As you develop a deep understanding of partner priorities, you will maintain a living body of knowledge that helps shape future innovation and informs strategic decision-making.
Where a documented requirement meets a partner need, addresses a gap in the market, and draws on a Microsoft core competency, it becomes a candidate for an Individual Work Plan (IWP) — the vehicle through which this partnership turns a requirement into committed, funded work. Beyond requirements discovery, you will help drive a portfolio of IWPs from concept through delivery.  The CRADA governs the broader relationship between Microsoft and the partner; IWPs nest beneath it and define the specific work and its scope. You will run a portfolio of IWPs at once — translating qualified requirements into IWP form, shepherding each through Microsoft's internal approval process, and, once approved, project managing it from creation through completion: standing up execution, sequencing dependencies, tracking progress and risk, and seeing the resulting capability through to delivery and adoption.

Success in this role comes from collaboration. You will work across Microsoft business units, including engineering, legal, trade compliance, finance, and security, to align priorities, remove obstacles, and ensure successful outcomes. You will also play a key role in sustaining the long-term health of the partnership, including leading the CRADA renewal process during its five-year lifecycle.

Communication is woven throughout every aspect of the role. You will synthesize partner feedback, emerging requirements, market opportunities, sources of friction, and urgent needs into clear, actionable insights for executive leaders. Whether communicating through written reports, presentations, or in-person discussions, you will help ensure leaders have the context they need to make informed decisions and respond quickly when priorities evolve.  Done well, this role places you at the center of a unique strategic partnership, where your ability to connect customer needs with Microsoft's expertise directly influences the capabilities we build, the value we deliver, and the strength of a relationship that drives innovation forward.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development - OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:
Security Clearance Requirements: Candidates must be able to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

- The successful candidate must have an active U.S. Government Top Secret Clearance with access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) . Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required pre-offer and post-hire for this role. Failure to maintain or obtain the appropriate U.S. Government clearance and/or customer screening requirements may result in employment action up to and including termination.
- Clearance Verification : This position requires successful verification of the stated security clearance to meet federal government customer requirements. You will be asked to provide clearance verification information prior to an offer of employment.
- Microsoft Cloud Background Check : This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Citizenship & Citizenship Verification:  This position requires verification of U.S. citizenship due to citizenship-based legal restrictions. Specifically, this position supports United States federal, state, and/or local United States government agency customer and is subject to certain citizenship-based restrictions where required or permitted by applicable law. To meet this legal requirement, citizenship will be verified via a valid passport, or other approved documents, or verified US government Clearance .

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience supporting or operating within a national security, defense, or special operations environment.
- Familiarity with defense acquisition pathways and an understanding of how they compare to processes used across the broader defense enterprise and commercial industry.
- Understanding of the distinct roles and considerations associated with enterprise technology and operational technology environments.
- Knowledge of the regulations, security practices, and operational norms common within national security and defense organizations.
- Experience applying user-centered design frameworks in a product engineering environment.
- Experience designing products, services, or capabilities for extreme users operating at the edge of a product's intended envelope.
- Ability to apply user insights and operational context to inform product, capability, or solution development.

jobs.location: United States, Multiple Locations, Multiple Locations
jobs.description:
Overview
Cloud Operations + Innovation (CO+I) is the team behind one of the World’s largest Cloud Infrastructures, responsible for powering all Microsoft online Products and Services as well as powering Microsoft’s “Cloud First” mission. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide, and we are looking for Senior Lease Delivery Program Manager, Datacenter Portfolio Management to help achieve our mission.

If you want to have fundamental impact on how Microsoft’s Cloud is deployed and operated, want to be involved with one of the most strategically important teams at Microsoft, possess effective technical and business acumen, leadership, creativity, and out of the box thinking then this job is for you!

We are looking for an experienced Senior Lease Delivery Program Manager, with deep technical and business effectiveness, trusted leadership and demonstrated large-scale program management success. You should be a program leader who can integrate delivery, project controls, procurement, contracts, and enterprise stakeholders to remove execution friction, strengthen commercial and operational outcomes, and support delivery teams through clear governance, commercial escalation leadership, and portfolio-level risk visibility.

In this role, the successful candidate will partner closely with key portfolio leaders to drive programs focused on transforming how we deliver data centers to our customers. These programs will be on the leading edge of innovation and will include driving pilots and other first of kind programs that shape ongoing strategy in delivering data centers efficiently and on schedule. You balance effective analytical and technical skills with the ability to influence decision makers within the CO+I leadership and execution teams spread across the rest of Azure. You will also partner closely with related teams including our design engineering, construction, networking and data center project management teams.

The Lease Delivery Program Manager enables predictable AMERS lease delivery through commercial compliance, strategic execution governance, change control, and cross-functional decision acceleration.
This role aligns delivery, project controls, procurement, contracts, engineering, and lease-provider stakeholders to turn risks, changes, and compliance issues into clear priorities, decisions, and accountable actions.

Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
- Lead LDPM program operations for AMERS Lease delivery, establishing priority forums, action tracking, and executive-ready escalation paths that convert controls reporting into timely decisions and measurable outcomes.
- Drive commercial compliance across lease delivery by interpreting contract obligations, milestone commitments, notice requirements, rights, remedies, and performance expectations in partnership with legal, contracts, procurement, and delivery stakeholders.
- Own commercial escalation mechanisms, including escalation logs, alignment records, decision narratives, action owners, due dates, and closed-loop resolution tracking with lease providers and internal stakeholders.
- Lead strategic execution alignment by connecting commercial strategy, procurement readiness, contract actions, RFS commitments, project controls signals, and delivery milestones to a common execution plan.
- Operate change control governance for design, technology, scope, procurement, and commercial changes; ensure intake, review, impact assessment, escalation, approval routing, and implementation decisions are consistently documented and governed.
