jobs.location: United States, Multiple Locations, Multiple Locations
jobs.description:
Overview
Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. The Microsoft Office of the CISO aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world.

The Customer Security Management Office, which is part of the Office of the Chief Information Security Officer (OCISO), is seeking a skilled and experienced Sr. Program Manager - Cybersecurity Incident Communications to join our team.

This role is pivotal in managing and supporting customer-facing and other external communications related to cybersecurity incidents. During a security incident, customers need accurate information to understand the scope and impact of the issue. This role will help ensure that Microsoft can offer our customers and partners critical details about what happened, what data or services are affected, and what steps are being taken to mitigate and remediate the issue. How we communicate this guidance enables our customers and partners to make informed decisions and take necessary actions to protect their own systems and data. This role will need a background in communications, a understanding of cybersecurity, and the ability to navigate complex, high-stakes situations with confidence and clarity.

This Sr. Program Manager - Cybersecurity Incident Communications will also be able to prioritize competing, time-sensitive demands and help manage a diverse set of organizational stakeholders and ensure key stakeholders are informed and aligned, while navigating and balancing the needs and expectations of different teams. Organizational skills, project management, and critical thinking skills are keys to success in this role.

If you enjoy a dynamic work environment, where you will support a global team and are focused on your role as a communications professional – we’d like to learn more about you!

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

Responsibilities
- This role does require you to be available/online outside of typical business hours/weekdays, given the crisis management aspect of our team's support for cybersecurity incidents at least one per month.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including incident coordinators, security operations, threat intelligence, product engineering, legal, marketing, issues management/PR, etc. to coordinate and align messaging and respond to customers with timely, actionable information about security incidents or security-adjacent events at Microsoft.
- Serve as a primary point of contact to other incident response workstream leaders and stakeholders concerning customer communications during cybersecurity incidents, providing clear and concise written and verbal daily updates on the progress of communications content.
- Support Microsoft security-aligned executives by preparing executive talk tracks, FAQs and other information about security incidents in preparation for customer engagement and to respond to customer inquiries and escalations.
- Track, manage, monitor, oversee, and orchestrate the development and finalization of external-facing communications collateral (e.g., customer notifications, Talking Points, responses to customer escalations and inquiries, blogs, etc.).
- Draft, edit, and approve security incident communication contents and help drive consensus with other communications stakeholders.
- Learn about and document the end-to-end process of supporting and communicating with customers about security incidents so that you can help identify solutions to improve and better instrument/automate these processes.
- Meticulously review content to avoid errors, ambiguities, and miscommunication; ensure accuracy and consistency in all communications; and assess content from the customers' perspective.
- Ability to be available outside of typical business hours/weekdays, given the crisis management aspect of our team's support for cybersecurity incidents.

Other:
- Embody our culture and values

- 5+ years experience in program management, digital content publishing/management, or experience in a writing or editing role - OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:

Candidates must be able to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
- - Microsoft Cloud Background Check:  This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Overview
Microsoft is built on trust and Azure is committed to being the most trusted cloud for its customers, including its regulated customers across the Europe. As Azure expands services, certifications, and regions for its global customers, we require increased support for our regulatory engagement and examination experience efforts. The Azure Compliance team is seeking an enthusiastic and dedicated Principal Program Manager - Customer Experience Program Management to manage examinations conducted by the European regulators.
The Principal Program Manager - Customer Experience Program Management will manage the work with multiple internal stakeholders within Microsoft, as well as external stakeholders within European regulators, to understand regulatory examination requirements and operationalize solutions that scale and maintain a consistently high-quality, well-coordinated experience throughout examinations and ongoing oversight activities. The role will define how to execute and manage regulatory examination engagements (including scoping, evidence gathering, stakeholder coordination, and response management) across multiple Azure service offerings, ensuring European regulators have a seamless and transparent experience working with Azure.

Our Azure Compliance team manages the external audits and regulatory examinations that Azure supports. We partner with engineering, security, legal, and compliance teams, as well as external regulators and auditors, to ensure that regulators and customers have a trusted, well-managed experience when engaging with Azure. We are a passionate group with a true customer-first mindset, enabling regulators and customers to effectively and confidently engage with Azure Cloud. Come join our team and help shape how Azure delivers a best-in-class experience to regulators and customers!
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

jobs.title: Intelligent Optimization Lead, Continuous Improvement
jobs.description:
Overview
The Frontier Transformation Framework helps our customers become Frontier Firms: organizations where AI is part of the operating system the business runs on. The difference between a transformation and a one-off deployment is what happens after go-live. Without a deliberate improvement and optimization discipline, returns erode: adoption plateaus, agents drift, prompt libraries go stale, and high-value agents are starved while low-value ones persist. Intelligent Optimization is the operating discipline that makes AI value compound over time rather than dissipate. The Frontier Transformation team is how the Microsoft Frontier Company, the organization this role sits within, delivers this: a small, senior human-agent team in which each member carries one of the Framework's eight capabilities into the customer, directs a set of digital co-workers to deliver at a scale headcount alone could not, and is designed to fade into a customer counterpart who can carry the work forward.

We are seeking a Frontier Intelligent Optimization SME to make AI value compound across strategic customer engagements. In this role, you will establish and run the Intelligent Optimization Framework as a permanent operating rhythm, grounded in kaizen and strong facilitation, that redesigns and reruns workflows to outcomes. You will solve the last-mile problem, embedding what gets built into how work actually gets done through standard work, clear ownership, and an execution cadence that makes new ways of working stick, working directly with business owners, operators, champions, and the Value, Skilling, Change, and engineering leads.

This is a role for people who are energized by making change hold rather than launching it, who can read measurement signals and turn them into the next round of improvement, and who believe a program that ships once and leaves is just a release, not a transformation. You are designed to fade into a customer counterpart who owns the improvement rhythm after the engagement ends. If you are excited by turning AI deployments into value that compounds cycle after cycle, this role is for you.

Responsibilities
Core Responsibilities

- Establish and run the Intelligent Optimization Framework as a permanent, always-on operating rhythm rather than a one-off activity, grounded in kaizen and strong facilitation.
- Redesign and rerun workflows to outcomes, running structured improvement cycles in which each measurement cycle feeds and improves the next.

jobs.title: Account Technology Strategist - Public Sector
jobs.description:
Overview
日本マイクロソフトの公共部門（Public Sector）は、中央省庁、地方自治体、教育機関、医療機関など、日本の社会基盤を支える幅広いお客様を担当しています。
国の重要な行政機関から全国47都道府県の自治体、大学・研究機関、病院・医療機関に至るまで、多様なお客様とともに、日本社会のデジタルトランスフォーメーションを推進しています。

現在、日本の公共分野は大きな変革期を迎えています。少子高齢化や労働人口の減少、行政サービスの高度化、医療・教育の質の向上、サイバーセキュリティへの対応など、社会全体が直面する課題に対して、クラウドやAIを活用した変革への期待が高まっています。特に生成AIやAI Agentの進化により、従来の業務効率化にとどまらず、行政サービスのあり方、医療従事者の働き方、教育・研究の進め方そのものを変える新たな可能性が広がっています。

Microsoft Public Sectorは、Azure、Microsoft 365、Microsoft Security、Dynamics 365、Copilot、AI Agentなど、幅広いテクノロジーとプラットフォームを活用し、お客様の課題解決を支援しています。私たちの役割は、単に製品やサービスを提供することではありません。お客様の経営・政策・業務上の課題を深く理解し、複数のテクノロジーを組み合わせながら、構想策定から技術検証、導入、利活用の拡大までをパートナーとともに推進することです。
公共分野のビジネスには、民間企業とは異なる複雑さとスケールがあります。大規模な組織、多様なステークホルダー、厳格なセキュリティやコンプライアンス要件、既存システムとの連携など、高度な技術力と課題解決能力が求められます。一方で、一つのプロジェクトが数万人規模の職員の働き方を変え、数百万人の住民サービスの向上につながるなど、社会に対して非常に大きなインパクトを生み出すことができます。

また、日本の公共市場では、SIer、ISV、地域に根差したITパートナーなど、多様なパートナー企業との協業がビジネスの重要な柱となっています。Microsoftのテクノロジーとパートナーが持つ業界知識、システム構築力、地域のお客様との関係を組み合わせることで、単独では実現できない大規模かつ複雑なソリューションを提供しています。

このような環境において、技術営業は極めて重要な役割を担います。お客様のビジネス課題を技術的な観点から理解し、最適なアーキテクチャやソリューションを提案するとともに、社内の専門チームやパートナーを巻き込みながら、技術的な意思決定とプロジェクトの成功をリードします。特定の製品領域に閉じるのではなく、Cloud、AI、Security、Modern Workなど複数の技術領域を横断し、お客様の変革を支えるTrusted Technical Advisorとしての活躍が期待されます。

Microsoft Public Sectorは、テクノロジーを通じて日本社会の未来を形づくることができる、非常に大きな可能性を持つビジネスです。最先端のAI・クラウド技術に触れながら、大規模で複雑な課題に挑戦し、多様なパートナーとともに新しい価値を創造する。そして、自らが関わった仕事の成果が、行政、医療、教育、研究などを通じて社会全体に広がっていくことを実感できる環境です。
私たちは、技術への好奇心とGrowth Mindsetを持ち、お客様やパートナーとともに学び、挑戦しながら、日本の公共分野の変革をリードしていく仲間を求めています。

Responsibilities
日本マイクロソフトの公共部門における技術営業は、中央省庁、地方自治体、教育機関、医療機関など、日本の社会基盤を支えるお客様に対して、Microsoftの最先端テクノロジーを活用し、 DX（Digital Transformation）およびAX（AI Transformation）を通じた組織・業務の変革を技術面からリードする 重要な役割を担います。

お客様が直面する経営・政策・業務上の課題を深く理解し、単なるITシステムの刷新や業務効率化にとどまらず、AIやクラウドを活用した新しい業務プロセス、組織の働き方、行政・医療・教育サービスのあり方をお客様とともに構想し、その実現を支援します。
特に、生成AIやAI Agentの進化によって生まれる新たな可能性を捉え、従来の業務をデジタル化するDXから、AIを前提として業務や組織を再設計するAXへの進化を推進します。

その実現に向けて、Azure、Microsoft 365、Microsoft Security、Copilot、AI Agent、Business Applicationsなど、幅広いMicrosoftのテクノロジーを理解し、お客様の既存システムやデータ基盤、セキュリティ・ガバナンス要件を踏まえながら、複数のソリューションを組み合わせた最適な技術戦略やアーキテクチャを提案します。
技術的な専門性を発揮するだけでなく、お客様の経営層、IT部門、業務部門など多様なステークホルダーと対話し、技術投資がもたらすビジネス価値や社会的価値を明確にすることが求められます。

また、大規模かつ複雑な公共分野のお客様に対して、構想策定、技術検証（PoC）、ソリューション設計、導入計画、利活用の拡大まで、変革の各段階に継続的に関与します。
特にAIの活用においては、技術導入そのものをゴールとするのではなく、業務プロセスの変革、生産性の向上、職員・従業員のエンパワーメント、住民・患者・学生へのサービス向上など、具体的な成果につなげることを重視します。

公共分野特有の高いセキュリティ、プライバシー、コンプライアンス、データガバナンスの要件に対応しながら、お客様が安心してクラウドやAIを活用できる環境の実現を支援することも重要な責任です。
AIの利活用を拡大するうえでは、Responsible AIの考え方を踏まえ、セキュリティとイノベーションを両立させた持続可能な技術基盤の構築を推進します。

さらに、SIer、ISV、地域のITパートナーなど、多様なパートナーエコシステムとの協業をリードします。Microsoftのテクノロジーとパートナーの業界知識、技術力、導入・運用能力を組み合わせ、お客様に最適なソリューションを共同で提案します。
お客様とパートナーの間に立って技術的な課題や役割分担を調整し、複雑なプロジェクトを成功に導くとともに、新しいAIユースケースやビジネス機会の創出にも貢献します。

社内においては、Account Team、Solution Specialist、Cloud Solution Architect、Customer Success、Engineeringなど、さまざまな専門チームと連携し、One Microsoftとしてお客様の変革を支援します。個々の製品や組織の枠を越え、お客様の長期的な成功を共通のゴールとして、技術的な意思決定をリードし、案件の創出・推進から導入後の価値実現までを支えていきます。

このポジションに期待されるのは、単にMicrosoftの製品やサービスを深く理解していることではありません。 お客様の未来の姿をともに描き、テクノロジーによって何を変革できるかを考え、その実現に向けて社内外の関係者を動かすことができるTrusted Technical Advisor としての役割です。

AIが社会や組織のあり方を大きく変えようとしている今、公共分野のお客様のDX・AXを推進し、その成果を日本社会全体の価値創造につなげていくことが、このポジションのミッションです。

Qualifications
1. Enterprise Account Management & Complex Solution Selling
大規模なEnterprise Accountにおいて、複雑な組織構造や多様なステークホルダーを理解し、お客様の経営課題・業務課題に対して、複数のソリューションを組み合わせた提案やプロジェクト推進をリードした経験。
求める経験・スキル
- 大規模顧客の担当経験
大企業、中央省庁、地方自治体、医療機関、教育機関など、組織規模が大きく、意思決定プロセスが複雑なお客様を担当した経験。

- 複数ステークホルダーとの合意形成
経営層、IT部門、事業部門、調達部門、セキュリティ部門など、異なる立場の関係者を巻き込み、利害関係を調整しながら案件を推進した経験。

- Consultative Selling
単なる製品・サービスの紹介ではなく、お客様のビジネス課題を深く理解し、課題解決に向けた提案を行った経験。

- 複数Solutionを組み合わせた提案
単一製品の販売にとどまらず、Cloud、AI、Security、Modern Work、Business Applicationsなど、複数のテクノロジーを組み合わせた統合的な提案経験。

- 複雑なプロジェクトの推進力
長期にわたる案件や大規模導入プロジェクトにおいて、社内外の関係者をリードし、課題解決、リスク管理、意思決定を推進した経験。

お客様の経営層や意思決定者との信頼関係を構築し、中長期的なビジネス機会を創出した経験。

2. Partner Ecosystem & Co-Selling
SIer、Technology Partner、ISVなど、多様なパートナーとの協業を通じて、お客様への価値提供とビジネスの成長を実現した経験。単にパートナーへ案件を紹介するだけでなく、共同で案件を創出し、提案から導入・展開までを推進できること。

SIer、クラウドパートナー、ISVなどと協力し、お客様の課題に対する共同提案やソリューション構築を推進した経験。

パートナーと役割分担を行い、双方の強みを生かしながら案件の発掘、提案、受注に結びつけた経験。

- 技術的・商務的な調整力
お客様の要件とパートナーの技術・サービス提供能力を理解し、ソリューション構成、導入体制、責任分担などを調整した経験。

- Partner Ecosystemの活用
単一のパートナーに依存せず、案件特性に応じて複数のパートナーを組み合わせ、最適なソリューションやデリバリー体制を構築した経験。

- 新しいビジネスの共同創出
既存案件へのパートナー参加だけではなく、新たなユースケースやソリューション、サービスモデルをパートナーと共同で開発・展開した経験。

お客様への価値提供とパートナーのビジネス成長を両立させ、中長期的な協業関係を構築した経験。

3. Microsoft Culture & Leadership Attributes

自分の経験や知識に固執せず、新しいテクノロジー、ビジネスモデル、業界知識を積極的に学び続ける姿勢。

jobs.location: United States, Multiple Locations, Multiple Locations
jobs.description:
Overview
At Small Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C), we are leading a high-growth, AI-powered global sales team—one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry’s most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth and innovation.
SME&C is more than a sales organization—it’s a culture of innovation, opportunity, and inclusivity. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, high-performing, and customer-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do.
If you thrive in a fast-paced, digital-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME&C can be the next step in your career. Together, we are shaping the future of business.
As the Senior Director, Business Process Sales Leader you will own the end-to-end sales performance and strategy for your domain worldwide: setting the vision and priorities for all regions, then empowering and guiding regional CSA (Cloud Solution Architect) Leads to execute against them. You will drive AI Business Process revenue and D365/Copilot Studio consumption growth across every territory in scope, anchoring customer conversations in the Frontier Transformation narrative — "Agentify your business processes" — with executive-level leaders (CxO) and business decision makers, and sponsoring the highest-impact executive relationships that open doors for your field teams. You will lead the AI Biz Process Digital Solution Specialist community — coaching Individual Contributors (ICs) and Managers (M1s), setting execution and skilling standards, and running deal clinics and inspection rhythms that lift capability everywhere — while orchestrating a full vendor team of Digital Account Executives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and co-sell partners to build pipeline, progress opportunities through Microsoft Customer Engagement Methodology (MCEM) with rigorous Microsoft Sales Experience (MSX) discipline, and land measurable adoption. Leveraging data and insights from across markets, you will act as the conduit between field reality and corporate strategy, ensuring local wins scale worldwide and global programs land effectively in every area.
This opportunity will allow you to operate at a strategic level, influencing a worldwide sales organization while developing deep business and technical acumen in AI Business Process; hone your leadership skills by managing through influence — coaching managers and sellers around the world; and become adept at orchestrating large-scale, AI-led sales initiatives that span multiple markets — all while building mastery of the Microsoft AI business applications portfolio (D365, Copilot Studio, and agents) and becoming a true "Customer Zero" practitioner of agentic AI in your own selling motion.
The Microsoft Cloud is the most comprehensive and trusted cloud platform in the industry – spanning cutting-edge solutions in Security, Workplace AI, AI Business Process, and Azure. At Small Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C), we harness this full Microsoft Cloud portfolio to drive digital transformation for organizations of all sizes. Our high-growth, AI-powered sales team is customer-obsessed and partner-driven, unlocking innovation from secure infrastructure to collaborative AI-powered productivity and intelligent business applications. Join us and lead the charge in empowering customers with the Microsoft Cloud, working smarter, collaborating seamlessly, streamlining business processes, and staying protected on a global, trusted platform.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
- Worldwide AI Business Process Strategy & Revenue Ownership: Define and drive the worldwide sales strategy, quota coverage, and revenue and consumption targets for AI Business Process across both Core — the Dynamics 365 install base, including Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Finance & Supply Chain — and Frontier: Copilot Studio, agents, and Line of Business (LOB) or pre-built D365 agents. Set clear billed revenue and consumption goals for every region, coordinate with regional CSA and AI Biz Process specialist leads so each operating unit meets its targets, hold the field to 2–3x quota coverage with Qualified Pipeline Coverage (QPC) and Committed Pipeline Coverage (CPC) green for the current and next quarter, and analyze performance across markets to keep quarterly and full-year billing forecasts on track.
- Frontier Transformation & Executive Engagement: Anchor every account conversation in the FY27 AI Business Process narrative, “Agentify your business processes,” framing the opportunity in business outcomes rather than features. Engage CxO, Business Development Manager (BD)M, and line-of-business leaders outside IT, sponsor the highest-impact executive relationships worldwide so territory sellers get through the door, own competitive escalations and win-backs, and drive Dynamics 365 and Copilot Studio upsell and net-new wins at renewal and mid-term. Be Customer Zero in agentic AI — use Copilot, Copilot Studio, and first-party agents daily in your own selling motion, and bring that lived proof into community conversations as evidence rather than theory.
- Microsoft Customer Engagement Methodology ( MCEM) Execution Excellence — Create, Commit, Complete: Set and enforce the worldwide standard for  Microsoft Sales Experience (MSX) discipline across the full cycle: Create, where pipeline is generated from digital signals such as Account-Based Marketing
(ABM), and Highly Engaged accounts against the Low Code, Sales, Service, and ERP solution plays; Commit, where Digital Solution Engineers and co-sell partners deliver technical validation and close plans reflect real milestones; and Complete, where Usage Intent milestones, FastTrack, CSU, and partner delivery turn wins into consumption. Hold the field to SLA response times, lead a consumption planning culture in which sellers forecast usage-intent milestones and engineers build structured consumption plans with defined use cases and estimates, and keep pipeline data clean, current, and correctly staged.

- AI Business Process Community Leadership & Skilling: Lead the worldwide AI Biz Process Digital Solution Specialist community through coaching, deal inspection, and deal clinics, applying Model, Coach, Care principles and partnering with first-line managers to set uniform role expectations. Own the skilling bar — L200 technical and L400 consultative depth, current Skills Profiles, active quarterly development plans, and demonstrated Frontier narrative and agent demo capability for every specialist. Centralize best practices globally, host community sessions, capture win wires and field insights, and identify Advanced Cloud Expert ( ACE) and community leads and the top talent for the next wave of the business.
- Partner Co-Sell at Scale: Develop the worldwide co-sell strategy for AI Business Process with the Global Partner Solutions organization and embed a leverage-first mindset: a co-sell partner attached to every viable deal, validated partner plans on every opportunity, and Frontier-badged partners and Agent Factory engaged for pre-sales, solution design, and delivery. Drive partner-led delivery with FastTrack attach to land consumption and adoption, monitor partner-influenced pipeline and wins across all areas, and feed competitive blockers and partner capacity gaps back to worldwide partner teams to shape program design.
- Business Representation, GTM Alignment & Rhythm of Business: Orchestrate the SME&C Integrated Account Reviews and Monthly Business Reviews for AI Business Process at a worldwide level, and represent the specialist community in leadership Rhythm of Connection, forecast calls, and Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) with Impact and Return on Investment (ROI) Key Performance Indicator (KPIs) that justify investment and demonstrate business value. Serve as the voice of the field to Worldwide GTM and Sales Enablement & Operations (SE&O) — aggregating regional signal into a global view, escalating systemic blockers to engineering, and shaping campaigns, offers, and incentives so they land in every market — then drive adoption of those programs through regional leads, championing modern sales tools and a culture of coaching, customer obsession, and compliant selling.

Key Business Partners
You will work across a broad v-team: AI Biz Process specialist managers and individual contributors, AI Business Process Digital Solution Engineers, Digital Account Executives, Commercial Executives, AI Workforce Digital Specialists and Copilot Digital Solution Engineers, cross-solution specialists, Customer Success Account Managers, Cloud Solution Architects and Digital CSU teams on Unified accounts, FastTrack managers and FastTrack Ready partners, Partner Solution Sales and Partner Solution Architects, co-sell partners across Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Systems Integrators (SIs) and CSPs, SME&C operating unit and worldwide AI Business Process Specialized Team Unit (STU) leads, and Sales Enablement and AI Business Solutions (ABS) Go-To-Market ( GTM) activation teams.
Measures of Success
- Revenue and Consumption Growth: Consistently achieve revenue, consumption, and business performance objectives across the assigned territory, while maintaining accurate forecasting and strong execution throughout the fiscal year.
- Consumption Acceleration: Drive adoption and expansion of AI Business Process solutions by increasing customer usage, identifying new opportunities, and advancing customer value realization.
- Pipeline and Sales Execution Excellence: Maintain a healthy pipeline, strong forecasting discipline, timely customer engagement, and effective territory management to support sustainable business growth.
- Community Capability Development: Foster a high-performing sales community through continuous learning, coaching, and skill development, achieving strong completion rates in both  L200 technical proficiency and L400 consultative selling depth . Ensure specialists maintain readiness to articulate business value, customer outcomes, and AI-driven transformation scenarios with confidence.
- Partner-Led Scale: Leverage strategic partnerships and co-sell motions to expand market reach, accelerate pipeline creation, and drive customer success.
- Executive Engagement and Business Leadership: Lead strategic customer conversations, represent business insights to leadership, communicate impact and business value, and proactively address organizational challenges.
- AI Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Demonstrate effective use of AI-powered tools and best practices, champion innovation within the team, and share learnings that improve sales effectiveness and customer outcomes.

Qualifications
Required/minimum qualifications
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field AND 7+ years of technology-related sales or account management experience OR 9+ years of technology-related sales or account management experience.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications (PQs)
- 6+ years of experience in solution, services, or technology sales with a demonstrated track record of driving business growth and customer success.
- Growth Mindset: Thrives in dynamic environments by approaching challenges with resilience, adaptability, continuous learning, and a solutions-oriented mindset.
- Disciplined Operator – Maintains excellence in pipeline management, forecasting and driving integrated territory and budget achievement planning. - Technical breadth: Enterprise customer level experience with cloud, hybrid infrastructures, productivity and security technologies, and industry standards recommended. Experience in competitive platforms and certifications preferred.
- Proficient experience with complex sales training (e.g., Miller Hyman, Spin, Michael Bosworth, Holden, etc.) and sales methodologies
- Competes to win new market share.

- 5+ years of experience selling or leading the sale of business applications, ERP, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), low-code platforms, AI solutions, or agent-based technologies, including Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, or comparable solutions, to C-suite executives and line-of-business leaders.
- Influential Sales Leadership: Experience leading, coaching, and enabling distributed sales communities across multiple geographies, driving consistency and execution through influence and collaboration.
- AI-First Seller: Demonstrated use of Microsoft Copilot and AI agents in day-to-day sales activities, including territory planning, account strategy, pipeline management, forecasting, and customer engagement. Able to confidently showcase AI-driven business scenarios to executive audiences.
- Executive Stakeholder Engagement: Experience partnering with worldwide or corporate go-to-market teams, translating field insights into strategic recommendations, and presenting business impact, performance metrics, and ROI outcomes to senior leadership.

jobs.title: Customer Success Account Manager
jobs.description:
Overview
The CSAM (IC1) is an early-in-career Customer Success Account Manager who supports the delivery of standardised customer success activities across Customer Health, Cloud Adoption, AI Transformation and Unified Success .

Working alongside more experienced CSAMs who lead executive customer relationships and overall account strategy, the CSAM IC1 contributes to the successful execution and orchestration of agreed customer success priorities and activities.

Reporting to an M1 Manager, the CSAM IC1 operates as part of a defined pod or industry team supporting a shared portfolio of customers. The role provides an opportunity to build customer success capability and experience while contributing to measurable customer outcomes across Customer Health, accelerating Cloud Adoption, AI Transformation, and the health and growth of customers’ Unified Success engagements.

Responsibilities

Success Plan Execution

- Customer Success Planning: Support customers across three core Customer Success Plan priorities: Customer Health, Cloud Acceleration and AI Transformation . The scope and depth of each plan will vary according to the customer’s needs, priorities and maturity.

- Plan Execution and Co-ordination: Support the execution, co-ordination and ongoing management of activities within Customer Success Plans, working under the guidance of experienced CSAMs and management.

- Delivery Excellence: Complete assigned activities accurately and within agreed timescales, proactively raising risks, blockers or exceptions and seeking appropriate guidance where required.

- Milestone and Delivery Tracking: Support experienced CSAMs in tracking delivery progress, milestones, insights and actions across engagements involving ISD, partners, CSAs and other members of the customer virtual team.

- Virtual Team Orchestration: Help co-ordinate and bring together relevant virtual teams to maintain alignment, address customer health concerns and support remediation or acceleration activities.

- Progressive Unified Ownership: As capability and experience develop, the CSAM will take increasing ownership of Unified activities, including bookings, scoping conversations and value capture. The expectation is that, by approximately three months in role, the CSAM will begin to take a more leading role in these activities with appropriate support and guidance

Portfolio-level intelligence and preparation

- AI-Powered Account Insights: Leverage AI and available account signals to identify and summarise actionable insights to experienced CSAMs.

- Delivery and Milestone Visibility: Maintain visibility of upcoming customer deliveries, including resourcing, bookings, scoping activities and key milestones. Ensure relevant account information and progress updates are accurately captured and maintained.

- Develop Account Understanding: Build knowledge and context across the assigned customer portfolio over time, enabling increasingly valuable insights and recommendations to support customer success priorities.

- Customer Meeting Planning: Apply a strong, structured planning approach to support experienced CSAMs in preparing for customer meetings.

- Identify Trends and Themes: Analyse information across the portfolio to highlight recurring themes, risks, blockers or opportunities that may require remediation, escalation or acceleration.

- Progressive Customer Engagement: Support the preparation of customer meetings through relevant insights and materials. As capability and experience develop, and under the guidance of an experienced CSAM, take increasing ownership of defined customer-facing activities, such as standard scoping calls and delivery of standard customer presentations.

- Customer Success Insights: Consolidate relevant data and insights to support customer conversations across the core Customer Success Plan priorities:

- Customer Health: product retirements, service alerts and relevant reactive insights.

- Cloud Acceleration: delivery progress, milestones, identify risks and acceleration opportunities.

- AI Transformation: programme updates, adoption and usage insights, and progress against agreed AI priorities.

Operating model

- The CSAM will work across a defined portfolio of customer accounts, aligned where possible by industry and team, providing the opportunity to progressively build industry expertise and a strong understanding of customer priorities.

- Reporting to an M1 Manager, the CSAM will receive ongoing guidance, coaching and support as they build their customer success capabilities and take on increasing responsibility.

- The role will work in partnership with experienced CSAMs who retain ownership of customer strategy and key customer relationships. Depending on the portfolio, the CSAM may partner with several experienced CSAMs, providing exposure to different customers, scenarios and approaches while developing towards greater ownership over time.

Example Activities

Activities below are illustrative, not exhaustive.

Strengthen Customer Health

- Maintain a clear view of high-priority customer health recommendations across the aligned portfolio, identifying key offerings that can support agreed follow-up actions.

- Consolidate insights and prepare materials to support customer health conversations and meetings

- Maintain awareness of priority product retirements, end-of-support considerations and associated risks across the portfolio, together with the relevant customer follow-up actions and available offerings.

- Synthesise incident and service information to identify recurring patterns, themes and potential systemic drivers

- Support preparation for internal and customer-facing Customer Health plan reviews, ensuring plans, insights, recommendations and actions are accurate and up to date.

Accelerate Cloud Adoption

- Support the tracking of Unified deliveries and associated customer value, maintaining visibility of progress, actions and outcomes.

- Track customer milestones, maintain accurate milestone notes and work with experienced CSAMs to ensure appropriate MSX data quality and hygiene.

- Where agreed with the experienced CSAM, proactively gather insights and progress updates from delivery partners, CSAs and other virtual team members relating to deliveries, milestones and Customer Success Plan activities.

- Consolidate delivery and milestone insights to support internal and customer-facing Cloud Acceleration plan reviews, highlighting progress, risks, blockers and areas requiring action.

Advance AI Transformation

- Support the tracking of AI Transformation milestones and agreed activities, maintaining accurate and timely updates and working with experienced CSAMs to ensure appropriate MSX data quality and hygiene.

- Gather relevant insights and progress updates from delivery partners, CSAs and other virtual team members to provide visibility of progress against agreed AI Transformation priorities.

- Consolidate programme, adoption and milestone insights to support AI Transformation plan reviews and customer conversations.

- Support preparation for internal and customer-facing meetings, ensuring relevant progress, insights, risks and agreed next actions are clearly represented.

Unified Growth and Health

- Develop the capability to independently manage standard Unified operational activities, including submitting resource booking requests, dispatching Success Programmes and supporting scoping activities.

- Within approximately three months, and subject to appropriate experience and readiness, take increasing ownership of standard scoping calls, clearly capturing customer objectives, intended outcomes and value.

- Support the proactive management of Unified consumption and contract health, working with experienced CSAMs and relevant teams to address areas such as over-consumption, package utilisation and SKU changes to maximise customer value and support RBI attainment.

- Capture and maintain evidence of the value delivered through Unified, ensuring outcomes and supporting evidence are accurately recorded.

- Consolidate Unified value and outcome insights into clear materials that support executive-level customer value conversations, working alongside experienced CSAMs.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Analytics Lead - Minecraft
jobs.description:
Overview
At Mojang Studios, the creators of Minecraft, we are on a mission to build a better world through the power of play.

Why play? Well, play is at the heart of everything we do. It’s the blocky backbone of our games, the core of our development philosophy, and even the origin of our name. From the relentless experimentation of our endlessly inspiring community to the classrooms where Minecraft has become an essential teaching tool, play is the bedrock of our existence.

We enable millions to create and play together, connect people across the globe, and foster a community that is among the most active and passionate in the world. Our community is global and incredibly diverse. When we are developing anything within our franchise, we keep this in mind. We want everyone to not only feel included in Minecraft, but also to see themselves in what we make. Our goal is for the Mojang Studios team to be as diverse as our community.

The Player and Data Insights team is seeking a Marketing Analytics Lead to shape how Mojang Studios measures, optimizes, and grows the impact of its marketing investments. You will partner closely with Marketing and Data Science teams to develop measurement strategies, evaluate marketing performance, and identify opportunities to drive player acquisition, engagement, retention, and revenue. This role combines marketing analytics, business intelligence, measurement strategy, and executive storytelling to connect campaign performance with player and business outcomes. You will develop scalable reporting, trusted measurement frameworks, and AI-enabled analytics capabilities that help teams make faster, more informed decisions.

In the end, it’s the people of Mojang Studios that make this place truly special. When you join, you’ll find yourself in the company of incredibly bright, warm, and creative individuals – all united and working toward a single goal. Come help us reach it!

- Partner with Marketing leaders to define success metrics, measurement plans, and key performance indicators for campaigns, channels, and strategic initiatives.
- Develop and maintain executive scorecards, dashboards, and reporting solutions that provide a trusted view of marketing performance.
- Analyze campaign, channel, and player behavior data to uncover actionable insights and opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness.
- Translate complex marketing and player data into clear recommendations that influence planning, prioritization, and investment decisions.
- Partner with Data Science teams to evaluate marketing performance, understand key business drivers, and measure the impact of marketing initiatives.
- Establish consistent metrics, reporting standards, and measurement frameworks that improve trust and alignment across marketing reporting.

- Evaluate emerging analytics and AI capabilities that improve reporting, insight generation, and access to data-driven decision making.

If you are excited by the opportunity to shape how Microsoft plans for hundreds of billions of dollars in commercial business, this role offers a unique seat at the center of that process.

The Microsoft Customer and Partner Solutions (MCAPS) Finance team is looking for a Senior Finance Manager to lead Reporting & Analytics for the Central Revenue Planning team. Working across Microsoft’s commercial portfolio, our team translates growth ambitions into the targets and budgets that guide business and sales organizations around the world.

Our highly visible team is on a mission to transform revenue planning, making it simpler, more efficient, more insightful, and increasingly enabled by technology, automation, and AI.

As our Reporting & Analytics lead, you will shape the data, analytics, and reporting foundation behind revenue planning and budget setting. You will lead the evolution of our reporting ecosystem, including Power BI solutions, Excel analytics, and executive presentations that enable hundreds of Finance and business stakeholders to make better, faster decisions.

Beyond reporting, you will be a key analytical thought partner, helping uncover budget drivers and identify pockets of risk and opportunity across the business. This is a unique opportunity to reimagine historically complex and manual processes through data, technology, automation, and AI, creating solutions that can unlock impact for hundreds of people across the company.

What We Value
We are looking for someone who combines strong financial and analytical capabilities with the curiosity and leadership to challenge how things have traditionally been done.
You will thrive in this role if you bring:
•             Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with complex datasets and translate them into meaningful business insights.
•             Strong data and reporting capabilities, with an understanding of how to design effective analytical experiences and decision-support solutions.
•             AI, automation, or technology fluency, along with excitement about using emerging capabilities to transform Finance processes.
•             Strong cross-team partnership, with the ability to influence and bring together stakeholders across Finance, Engineering, Sales, and business organizations.
•             Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to turn complexity into clear, compelling narratives for senior leaders.
•             A growth mindset and change orientation, with a desire to continuously improve processes, challenge the status quo, and deliver meaningful impact at scale.

jobs.description:
Overview
The Global Compensation Consulting team partners with Microsoft leaders to design and deliver compensation strategies that attract, retain, and motivate talent while advancing business priorities. The team brings deep compensation expertise, data-driven insights, and enterprise perspective to help leaders navigate complex talent decisions and evolve compensation programs across Microsoft.

As Director, Head of Xbox & Corporate Functions Compensation, you will lead the team responsible for shaping and executing compensation strategy for Xbox and Microsoft’s Corporate Functions. You will translate business and talent priorities into competitive, equitable, and scalable compensation solutions; advise senior executives on complex and high-impact decisions; and strengthen the frameworks, insights, and operating rhythms that enable consistent delivery. You will also lead, coach, and develop a team of compensation professionals while fostering a culture of accountability, inclusion, learning, and partnership.

This opportunity will allow you to influence compensation strategy across Xbox and Microsoft’s Corporate Functions, strengthen critical talent outcomes, and evolve the consulting model through data, technology, automation, and AI-enabled ways of working.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
Responsibilities
·        Lead the Global Compensation Consulting team supporting Xbox and Microsoft’s Corporate Functions, and own the compensation strategy, operating model, priorities, and delivery standards for these organizations.
·        Serve as a senior compensation advisor to executives, HR leaders, and cross-functional partners, translating business strategy, talent priorities, market dynamics, and financial considerations into integrated compensation strategies and decisions.
·        Direct compensation work from strategy and analysis through program design, implementation, and ongoing evaluation; make or escalate high-impact decisions involving significant financial, legal, employee, reputational, or execution risk.
·        Lead through complexity and ambiguity across Xbox and Corporate Functions, establishing clear governance, decision rights, operating rhythms, and accountability across Compensation, Finance, Legal, HR, business leadership, and other enterprise partners.
·        Anticipate emerging business, market, regulatory, and talent trends; use data, external insights, technology, automation, and AI to evolve the Global Compensation Consulting capability and influence broader compensation program design.
·        Model, coach, and care as a people leader by attracting, developing, and retaining a high-performing compensation consulting team; setting clear expectations; building succession and capability plans; and creating an inclusive environment where employees can deepen their expertise, partner effectively, and do their best work.

Qualifications

·        Master’s Degree in Human Resources, Business, Data Analytics, Mathematics, or related field AND 6+ years of experience in compensation, data analytics, human resources, finance, business, or related field OR Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business, Data Analytics, Mathematics, or related field AND 8+ years of experience in compensation, data analytics, human resources, finance, business, or related field OR equivalent experience.

·        Demonstrated experience leading complex, high-impact global compensation initiatives and advising senior executives on business, talent, financial, or organizational decisions.
·        Experience managing multiple concurrent compensation priorities or programs with significant financial, legal, employee, and reputational implications.

jobs.title: Sr. Site Procurement Manager
jobs.location: United States, Iowa, Des Moines; United States, Virginia, Boydton; United States, Virginia, Manassas
jobs.description:
Overview
Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO&I) is the team behind the cloud.  Within CO&I, the Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC) team is responsible for delivering core datacenter infrastructure for Microsoft’s cloud business. The MS portfolio consists of complex, multi-disciplinary, large scale, multi-year datacenter construction and lease projects. We are looking for a passionate, high-energy individual to help build the cloud datacenters that power the world’s largest online services.  In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.
We are seeking a Senior Site Procurement Manager for the OFCI Site Execution Team. This leader will provide strategic sourcing, contracting, supplier-management, compliance, and functional direction across regional datacenter projects, ensuring optimal cost, capacity, quality, and delivery outcomes.
- Work is required from site/hybrid, 3 days per week

In alignment with Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment where employees can positively impact our culture every day.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
This role will be located on-site at one of the following Data Center Campuses: Boydton, VA; Blue Ridge, VA; Des Moines, IA.
Relocation assistance is being offered for these roles.

Responsibilities
These roles are responsible for partnering with the broader Global Supply Chain teams including Planning & Analytics, Supplier Quality and overall Site Projects team to meet the on-time delivery for large, complex datacenter construction project(s).  This role is responsible for managing post-award activities in support of Capital Equipment procurement and project execution.  This includes managing supplier performance and leading cross-functional teams.
Functional Management:
- Provide functional direction and dotted-line management to Site based Procurement Managers to ensure compliance with Microsoft and CO+I Contracting/Procurement policies.

- Responsible for onboarding and development of Site Procurement Managers: (Lead, coach, mentor).

- Responsible for developing, planning, and executing training for Site Procurement Managers and Cross-Functional stakeholders

Contracts and Sourcing
- Executes and manages Equipment contracts for large, complex data center construction projects and/or purchasing opportunities to ensure optimal cost and time to delivery for Microsoft customers.

- Collects relevant internal and industry data to understand business requirements, benchmarks data against relevant markets, and shares industry and category expertise across stakeholder teams to execute and/or develop strategies.

- Integrates business specifications for complex purchasing areas into Request for Information (RFI) and/or request for proposal (RFP) processes. Collaborates cross-functionally to define and manage supplier scorecard criteria (e.g., key performance indicators [KPIs], Service Level Agreements [SLAs]), coordinates supplier performance/recovery reviews, and drives corrective actions.

- Actively partners with suppliers to identify and drive continuous improvement and risk management opportunities by evaluating procedural, operational, and/or environmental factors, analyzing root causes of issues, sharing insights with key stakeholders, and influencing the adoption of needed improvements.

- Manages contract and price negotiation activities for equipment categories (including labor) cross-functionally and ensures that both price and capacity needs are met while also reflecting Microsoft's cross-functional engagement with suppliers. Identifies cost reduction opportunities and works closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders to drive cost competitiveness.

- Understand construction industry contracting norms and Microsoft contracting requirements; participate and/or lead negotiation of contracts that meet business goals.

- Identifies risks and roadblocks to contract execution and drives action internally and/or externally to resolve and/or escalate, as appropriate.

- Monitors and mitigates the impact of change orders to the underlying business case, and partners cross-functionally to adjust impact models.

Change Order Management:
- Monitor and mitigate the impact of change orders to the project, and partners cross-functionally to resolve/escalate accordingly.

- Attend cost/change management meetings to ensure any change orders of additional equipment and labor are executed promptly and timely.

- Act as the commercial Subject Matter Expert and prescribe the appropriate entitlement and justification for all change orders.

- Negotiate Claims with the detailed understanding of the contractual conditions and partner with regional claims to settle or escalate.

Compliance:
- Ensures adherence to policy, educates stakeholders and suppliers on policy compliance, and manages the remediation and resolution of sourcing issues. Identifies opportunities to adapt policy as needed to mitigate risk and better enable suppliers to meet business requirements.

- Ensures consistency, timeliness, quality, and accuracy of deliverables, and ensures Procurement stakeholders are aware of Service Level Agreement (SLA) and/or defined milestones and deliverables terms. Communicates delay to Procurement stakeholders and independently proposes and executes contingency measures.

Stakeholder Collaboration:
- Develops pricing and negotiation strategies on contract changes for multiple purchasing categories, ensures that strategies clearly articulate the tradeoffs, roles, and responsibilities across parties, and gains senior executive support for strategies both internally and externally. Identifies negotiation setbacks and takes action to mitigate contract disagreements. Drives early business engagements for complex business areas or purchasing categories with cross-functional leadership including planning, strategic sourcing, cost, engineering, quality, construction, project managers, to define and drive action on supply solutions and strategies, business requirements, optimal sourcing on spend/budget and align on priorities.  Shares expertise to advise cross-functional teams on sourcing decisions.

Partners:
- Internal: Engineering, procurement, planning, quality, construction, cost management, finance, safety, legal, risk management and other groups as needed.

- External: Equipment Suppliers, Architectural Engineering, Commissioning Agents, consultants, and industry groups.

Management of Original Equipment Manufacturers’ (OEM) Field Service Technician/Engineer:
- Manage and oversee Supplier labor management in coordination with General Contractor, Scheduling Teams, and Internal Planning Teams to align schedules and deliverables.

- Manage schedule compliance and escalations from field team to support installation and Commissioning (Cx) activities as required to drive efficiencies between Supplier and General Contractor

- Negotiate and manage any change orders for overtime, schedule compression and acceleration as needed.

Owner Furnish Contractor Installed (OFCI) Management & Quality Assurance:
- Help facilitate the Mechanical Engineer and Plumbing (MEP)/Owner Furnished Contractor Installed (OFCI) equipment once delivered to site, including inspections and appropriate sign offs.

- Address quality-related issues as they arise and report to the quality team and category management as appropriate.

- Coordinate post-IFC design changes and deliver aligned project specifications, compliance documents, and technical submittals across procurement, engineering, and stakeholders.

Qualifications
Qualifications:
- Master's Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, Business, Finance or related field AND 4+ years experience in data science/analytics, finance, project management, supply chain, and/or operation OR Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, Business, Finance or related field AND 6+ years experience in data science/analytics, finance, project management, supply chain, and/or operation OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Master's Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, Business, Finance or related field AND 8+ years experience in data science/analytics, finance, project management, supply chain, and/or operation OR Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, Business, Finance or related field AND 12+ years experience in data science/analytics, finance, project management, supply chain, and/or operation OR equivalent experience.

Background Check Requirements:
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
- Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

jobs.description:
Overview
Microsoft Procurement group is part of Finance Operations (FinOps) organization and has a mission to deliver business value through proactive global supplier solutions that are innovative, compliant, and cost effective.

Our group is a global team of 215+ employees across 30 countries supporting 100+ geographies and facilitating billions of US dollars in annual purchases worldwide. Our team fosters a culture of innovation, operations excellence and provides great career growth opportunities with a rewarding work environment. We deliver impact by leveraging corporate supplier strategies with a business aligned compliant supplier ecosystem.

We are looking for future business leaders to join our Procurement Solutions group as a Senior Sourcing Manager to support purchasing indirect services and primarily supporting the commercial business organization. This is a fantastic opportunity to learn about one of Microsoft’s businesses in a dynamic environment. The successful candidate will lead sourcing strategies and contract negotiations for complex purchasing categories, integrating business requirements into RFI/RFP processes and ensuring alignment with pricing, capacity, and policy compliance. They will collaborate cross-functionally within Microsoft and with suppliers to drive early engagement, define supply solutions, and execute contracts that meet business needs. Success in this role requires relationship management and cross-group collaboration to influence business decisions, driving innovation and achieving cost savings.

Come join a world class team surrounded by a diverse array of peers from various industries and backgrounds where you’ll unlock opportunities in Microsoft’s procurement of indirect services.
Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and organization on the planet to achieve more. That’s what inspires us, drives our work and pushes us to challenge the status quo every day. Through our Cloud-first strategy, we strive to deliver solutions that are optimized for the world and enable customers to drive their business more successfully.

Responsibilities
Sourcing

- Defines, maintains, and executes sourcing strategies for one or more complex projects and/or purchasing opportunities to ensure optimal cost and sufficient continuity of supply and/or service, collects relevant internal and industry data to understand business requirements, benchmarks data against relevant markets, and shares industry and category expertise across stakeholder teams to develop and execute sourcing strategies.

- Integrates business specifications for complex purchasing areas into request for information (RFI) and/or request for proposal (RFP) processes. Collaborates cross-functionally to define and manage supplier scorecard criteria (e.g., key performance indicators [KPIs], Service Level Agreements [SLAs]), coordinates supplier performance reviews, and drives corrective actions.

- Manages contract and price negotiation activities for a single purchasing category cross-functionally and ensures that both price and capacity needs are met while also reflecting Microsoft's cross-functional engagements with suppliers. Identifies cost reduction opportunities and works closely with suppliers to drive cost competitiveness.

Compliance

- Applies an end-to-end understanding of the tradeoffs between Microsoft and key suppliers to drive business impact by influencing senior managers cross-functionally, or cross-regionally to apply market intelligence and adopt practices that enable execution with consistency, accuracy, quality, and timeliness of delivery.

- Ensures adherence to policy, educates stakeholders and suppliers on policy compliance, and manages the remediation and resolution of sourcing issues. Identifies opportunities to adapt policy as needed to mitigate risk and better enable suppliers to meet business requirements.

Stakeholder Collaboration

- Drive early business engagement across complex business areas and  purchasing  categories, partnering with cross-functional leadership (product design, quality, and business teams) to define and act on supply strategies, business requirements,  optimal  sourcing spend, and priorities.

Overview
The CSAM is an  early-in-career Finnish-speaking Customer Success Account Manager who delivers standardized customer success outcomes spanning executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration activities. These CSAMs act within a pod model and support customers across Finland and other Nordic markets where applicable.
Working under the direction of senior CSAMs and a Manager, the CSAM operates within a defined pod covering a shared portfolio of accounts. The role contributes to portfolio-level intelligence, execution orchestration, and reactive signal aggregation, reducing context-switching for senior CSAMs and accelerating customer outcomes.
As a customer-facing professional, the CSAM builds trusted relationships with stakeholders in Finnish and English, helping customers realize value from their Microsoft investments, accelerate cloud adoption, and achieve their business objectives.
This is a talent-engine role: CSAMs are AI-first, customer-facing from month three, and grow through structured cohorts, mentoring, and community-based learning. Native or fluent Finnish language skills, combined with strong communication and collaboration capabilities, are essential to success in this role.

Responsibilities
Executive partnership and execution
- Execute standardized executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration tasks under direct guidance from senior CSAMs or CSU leaders.
- Support agent and Copilot adoption motions across assigned pod accounts.
- Complete assigned activities accurately and on time; escalate exceptions rather than independently diagnose them.

Portfolio-level intelligence and preparation
- Maintain deep, current account context across the pod’s defined portfolio.
- Synthesize account signals into “what’s changed / what matters now”
- Detect risks, upcoming deliveries, upcoming milestones, and open threads.
- Detect portfolio patterns such as recurring blockers across multiple accounts.

Execution orchestration (not delivery)
- Track delivery and milestone progress with partners and CSAs on behalf of senior CSAMs.
- Map dependencies across workloads and milestones.
- Proactively flag drift before the customer raises it.
- Coordinate remediation follow-ups across internal teams.

Reactive signal aggregation
- Monitor reactive support signals – case volume, aging, repeat drivers – across the pod portfolio.
- Aggregate reactive trends into portfolio-level views and surface early warnings of escalation risk.
- Track follow-through on Support, IM, and Service Manager commitments; chase stalled internal owners.
- Distill reactive noise into CSAM-ready insights, not raw data.

Operating model
- Operate within a pod model covering a shared portfolio of accounts.
- Work under direct oversight of the Manager and senior CSAMs assigned to the pod.
- Limit interactions to task execution and information capture; executive partnership and account governance is led by the senior CSAM.

Example Activities
Activities below are illustrative, not exhaustive. The same executive priorities apply because the role is still a CSAM.
Strengthen Customer Health
- Maintain running summaries of reactive health per account for CSAM pre-briefs.
- Surface repeat incident patterns and systemic drivers.
- Translate reactive trends into Customer Health Recommendation inputs.
- Flag candidates for proactive Success Programs and remediation focus.

Accelerate Cloud Adoption
- Track deliveries that support adoption milestones and usage signals across pod accounts.
- Coordinate with delivery partners and CSAs on adoption commitments.
- Prepare adoption inputs for CSDRs and executive discussions.

Advance AI Transformation
- Monitor agent and Copilot adoption velocity across the pod.
- Aggregate AI transformation blockers and opportunities into portfolio views.
- Support readiness for AI-related Success Program intake.

Earn Customer Trust Every Day (Executive Partnership & Planning)
- Reduce CSAM context-switching by owning “what needs attention this week” across pod accounts.
- Drive follow-up actions after reports, reviews, and assessments.
- Keep execution honest on dates, owners, and readiness.
- Participate or support CSP or CSDR activities.

Qualifications
Required
- Bachelor’s degree (any discipline) or equivalent early-career experience. - 0–2 years of professional experience in program management, customer-facing operations, technology delivery, or analytics.

- Legally authorised to work in the location where this role is based - Finland (Legally authorised = you hold citizenship or have been granted a valid visa or work permit.)
- Strong written and verbal communication in English plus the language(s) required for the assigned hub, Finnish.

Preferred
- Coursework or experience in program management, business operations, or an MBA in progress or completed.
- Exposure to enterprise software, cloud platforms, or B2B customer success.
- Experience working in pod, squad, or matrixed team structures.

The Payment Fraud Operations (PFO) team plays a critical role in protecting Microsoft customers and the broader payment ecosystem from payment fraud. The team combines fraud risk decisioning, operational controls, data-driven insights, and customer remediation to manage emerging payment risks while maintaining a secure and trusted customer experience.

We are looking for a  Risk Manager, Payment Fraud Operations, based in Redmond, to lead fraud risk management and operational strategy across complex payment and customer scenarios. This role is responsible for identifying and analyzing fraudulent transaction and usage patterns, making risk-based accept/reject decisions, improving fraud prevention controls, and providing robust feedback loops to payment risk models, policies, and detection strategies.

The role requires strong risk management expertise, sound judgment, analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across Operations, Engineering, Data Science, Customer Support, and other business teams.
Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We foster a culture of growth, innovation, collaboration, respect, integrity, and accountability where everyone can thrive.

Responsibilities
Fraud Risk Decisioning

- Analyze incoming transactions, customer, and usage signals to identify fraudulent behavior and make accurate, risk-based accept/reject decisions.

Risk Insights & Emerging Pattern Clustering:

Customer Remediation:

- Partner with Customer Support to resolve complex escalations and improve customer remediation strategies.

- Support incident management, root-cause analysis, and remediation for payment-fraud issues.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence:

Operations Strategy & Process Improvement:

- Develop preventative measures, process enhancements, and scalable solutions to address emerging risks and operational gaps.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication:

- Partner with Engineering, Data Science, Customer Support, and Operations to drive root-cause analysis and implement risk solutions.

Risk Governance & Communication:

Capability Development:

- Embody our  culture  and  values

Overview
We are seeking a  Web Compliance Manager to help lead and operationalize Microsoft’s enterprise Web Compliance program, with a primary focus on Accessibility compliance, program management, stakeholder engagement, reporting, and operational excellence .
The Web Compliance program helps protect Microsoft’s legal, regulatory, brand, and reputational interests across approximately 1,300 externally facing Microsoft websites . The program brings together Accessibility, Privacy, Cookies, Security, governance, compliance scanning, automation, and reporting to provide a consolidated view of compliance health across Microsoft’s external web estate.
Each quarter, the team consolidates compliance results across major Microsoft businesses, including Windows, Azure, Microsoft 365, Copilot, Gaming/Xbox, Security, Microsoft AI, and Marketing , providing executive leadership with enterprise-level visibility into compliance health, material risks, and remediation progress.
This role will serve as the primary Accessibility compliance lead for Marketing , partnering with CELA, Accessibility teams, website owners, engineering teams, and business stakeholders. Accessibility will be the primary area of ownership, with an expectation that the candidate is familiar with, or open to learning, adjacent Web Compliance areas including Privacy, Cookies, Security, reporting, governance, and audit readiness.
This is a highly matrixed role requiring someone who is diplomatic, collaborative, pragmatic, and a strong communicator . The ideal candidate can navigate organizational friction, competing priorities, and ambiguity while influencing without direct authority and maintaining strong partnerships.
An interest in AI and automation is strongly preferred. Experience with Copilot, agentic workflows, and low-code/no-code solutions is a plus, not a requirement. We are looking for someone who can identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and partner with engineering or vendor resources to bring those solutions to life.

Responsibilities

Accessibility Compliance Leadership
- Serve as the primary Accessibility compliance lead for Marketing, including reporting, consultations, assessments, and remediation coordination.
- Partner with CELA (Legal), website owners, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to drive compliance outcomes.
- Coordinates letter-grade tracking, dashboard, and leadership reporting.
- Drives follow-through with accountable teams.
- Monitor emerging Accessibility requirements and determine potential impacts to processes, reporting, guidance, and technology.

Web Compliance Program Management & Reporting
- Help operate Microsoft’s enterprise Web Compliance program across Accessibility, Privacy, Cookies, Security, governance, reporting, and audit readiness.
- Coordinate priorities, milestones, dependencies, risks, requirements, and cross-functional execution.
- Support quarterly enterprise compliance scorecards, QBR/MBR reporting, audits, evidence collection, remediation tracking, and stakeholder communications.
- Translate complex compliance requirements and program data into clear risks, insights, actions, and recommendations for business and leadership audiences.
- Maintain familiarity with the broader Web Compliance operating model and provide program ownership or support across adjacent areas as business priorities require.

Stakeholder Leadership & Collaboration
- Build trusted relationships across CELA (Legal), Compliance leaders, Privacy, Security, Engineering, Marketing, website-owning teams, vendors, and leadership.
- Navigate complex matrixed environments, organizational friction, and competing priorities while maintaining positive working relationships.
- Bring stakeholders together around shared outcomes and facilitate constructive resolution when perspectives or priorities differ.
- Communicate complex compliance and technical topics clearly to business, Legal, technical, and leadership audiences.
- Influence without authority, establish clear ownership and next steps, and exercise good judgment around when issues require escalation.

Automation & Operational Improvement
- Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve Web Compliance workflows, reporting, remediation, stakeholder support, and audit readiness.
- Explore practical use of AI, Copilot, agentic workflows, and low-code/no-code automation to improve operational efficiency and self-service.
- Translate business problems into automation requirements, lightweight solutions, or prototypes where appropriate.
- Partner with engineering and vendor teams on more complex platform, reporting, integration, and automation needs.
- Ensure solutions maintain appropriate human judgment, quality controls, documentation, and accountability.

Experience with technologies such as Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, or Azure DevOps is beneficial. The priority is a strong Accessibility and program leader who understands how technology can improve operations.

Qualifications
Required/minimum qualifications
- Bachelor's Degree in Legal, Finance, Science, Business, Engineering, or related field AND 4+ years experience in business, legal/regulatory, compliance, audit/consulting firm OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of experience in program management, Accessibility, compliance, governance, business operations, or a related discipline.
- Experience supporting digital Accessibility programs, assessments, reporting, remediation, or governance.
- Strong program management and operational execution skills in complex, matrixed environments.
- Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
- Demonstrated ability to navigate friction, ambiguity, competing priorities, and cross-functional dependencies.
- Collaborative and diplomatic working style with strong judgment and organizational awareness.
- Ability to influence without direct authority and build alignment across business, Legal, compliance, and technical stakeholders.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate complex requirements into practical actions.

- Familiarity with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines, Microsoft Accessibility Standards, Accessibility Insights, Accessibility reporting, and remediation practices.
- Experience with executive compliance reporting, scorecards, audits, governance, or other digital compliance disciplines.
- Familiarity with Privacy, Cookies, Security, or broader Web Compliance programs.
- Experience improving manual processes through automation or operational redesign.
- Familiarity with AI, Copilot, agentic workflows, low-code/no-code solutions, or Microsoft automation and reporting technologies.
- Experience partnering with engineering teams or managing vendor-supported technical delivery.

Microsoft is on a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. You can help us achieve our mission.
The Azure Core & Infrastructure Business Development team drives strategic partnerships, inorganic growth opportunities, and new business models across the foundational infrastructure that powers the Microsoft Cloud. We work closely with product and engineering leaders to determine where Microsoft should build, buy, partner, or invest to accelerate the roadmap, close critical product gaps, improve platform economics, and create differentiated customer value.
We are seeking a Senior Business Development Manager - Azure Dedicated & Networking to lead strategic partnerships and initiatives for Azure Networking . Azure Networking spans the physical and software-defined infrastructure, platform capabilities, and customer-facing services that connect, secure, deliver, monitor, and manage workloads at global scale. Its portfolio includes network foundations, hybrid and multicloud connectivity, application delivery, network monitoring, container networking, AI infrastructure networking, and the global network technologies that underpin Azure.
In this role, you will: (1) develop a deep understanding of cloud networking, AI infrastructure, customer requirements, and the industry landscape; (2) identify external technologies and partnerships that can accelerate Azure Networking priorities; (3) work with senior product and engineering leaders to formulate build, buy, partner, and invest strategies; and (4) structure, negotiate, and execute partnerships that deliver measurable product, business, and customer outcomes.
You will focus on strategic opportunities across areas such as multicloud and hybrid connectivity, AI and high-performance networking, network observability and intelligent operations, application delivery, container and cloud-native networking, network infrastructure and supply chain, and emerging capabilities that improve Azure’s performance, resiliency, security, cost efficiency, and global reach.
This role requires a pragmatic strategist and deal leader who can operate across technical, commercial, and organizational boundaries. You will translate complex infrastructure needs into clear partnership theses, influence senior stakeholders, design innovative commercial structures, lead negotiations, and establish governance that converts signed agreements into delivered product outcomes.
The Senior Business Development Manager - Azure Dedicated & Networking  role offers a unique opportunity to shape the networking foundation of the Microsoft Cloud and help make Azure the most efficient, reliable, secure, and differentiated infrastructure platform for AI and enterprise workloads.

Microsoft Customer & Partner Solutions accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win competitively, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions. Are you passionate about helping customers accelerate business transformation through technology, cloud, and AI? Do you thrive in complex environments that require leadership, orchestration, and customer advocacy?

As a Customer Success Account Manager (CSAM), you serve as the primary customer success leader responsible for orchestrating customer outcomes across Microsoft and partner teams. You engage stakeholders, align on strategic priorities, and lead Customer Success Planning to help customers strengthen operational health, accelerate cloud adoption, and advance AI transformation initiatives. By connecting customer goals to Microsoft capabilities, Success Programs, and Success Management Services, you drive coordinated execution and measurable value realization. You proactively manage customer risks, guide governance and delivery rhythms, and help ensure customers achieve durable outcomes that strengthen trust and expand the value of their Microsoft investments.
