Overview
Develops and drives go-to-market sales strategy and execution to ensure success within their market based on Microsoft's and customer/partner needs. Leads the and aligns business within the segment, driving strategic direction across teams. Defines ongoing and long-term customer value realization and satisfaction strategies contributing to net-new revenue and business growth. Leverages industry and market expertise, proactively leading teams to identify solutions to drive new opportunities and strategies in alignment with customer needs. Leads and coaches teams on the development and implementation of scalable go-to-market for maximizing revenue, consumption, and growth across solution areas. Defines expectations and sets strategies for teams to leverage drivers of Digital & Artificial Intelligence transformation relevant to their customers and partners across business units. Fosters and defines a culture of inclusion, learning, mentorship, coaching, customer-centricity, accountability, collaboration, and achievement of bold goals. Leads business planning and alignment beyond fiscal year boundaries across segments, partners, and teams to drive growth and transformation, define expectations for sale execution, and holds teams accountable for results. Builds and maintains a broad executive network inclusive of partners. In addition, this role has people management responsibilities including driving employee growth and development, executing projects, and managing performance.

Responsibilities
Accelerating Growth
Leverages industry and market expertise, proactively leading teams to identify solutions to drive new opportunities and strategies in alignment with customer needs. Establishes a technology-driven professional presence in the market and represents Microsoft as a thought leader who can articulate connections between Microsoft solutions to relevant business contexts with industry and market leaders (e.g., speaking at external events, sitting on boards). Pursues industry of choice to create more strategic relevance and value with customers. Coaches teams to consider global perspectives in practices in local trade, regulatory, and policy environments across geographic areas. Coaches managers and teams to tailor customer engagement for specific industries with relevant customer references and socializes practices across their organization. Identifies and creates customer references for landmark successes in one or more strategic industries to develop a advantage and to articulate ability to deliver customer value to achieve outcomes. Leverages experiences and expertise with customers across industry to influence the development of programs that help scale and accelerate successful engagements.

Leads and coaches teams on the development and implementation of scalable go-to-market for maximizing revenue, consumption, and growth across solution areas. Shares practices and holds managers and teams accountable for leveraging market-specific insights and highlighting solutions that solve business and technology challenges. Coaches teams to identify and proactively engage influencers to drive Microsoft's perspective across accounts and to utilizing available programs to drive customers to expand budget. Sets the expectations for and enables teams to be self-sufficient in leveraging digital assets and data insights, and exhausting all opportunities to develop relationships with new and existing customers.

Defines expectations and sets strategies for teams to leverage drivers of Digital & Artificial Intelligence (AI) transformation relevant to their customers and partners across business units, promoting the power of the AI within the Microsoft ecosystem, promoting the power of the AI within the Microsoft ecosystem. Drives communicating the importance of security, governance, and responsible use of AI as part of enterprise transformation. Acts as a thought leader in optimally leveraging transformation across solution areas. Consults with customers and internal/external Partners to ensure successful and secure value realization in delivery of solutions to customers. Drives and coaches teams to orchestrate across units and Partners to leverage and accelerate innovative transformation opportunities. Coaches managers to ensure internal partners are educated on industry trends and solutions. Develops and shares strategies for expanding relationships across customers' lines of business that enable innovative solutions, deliver business value, and create market growth. Coaches and supports teams to leverage industry experts within Microsoft to identify and execute on transformation opportunities.

Driving Success with and Through Others
Fosters and defines a culture of inclusion, learning, mentorship, coaching, customer-centricity, accountability, collaboration, and achievement of bold goals. Influences and inspires managers and teams across the organization to motivate, engage, and bring teams together. Leads a diverse and inclusive workforce, creates and hires diverse teams, and fosters an inclusive working environment via well-established inclusive behaviors. Develops and rewards high-performing individuals and teams, hires diverse talent, prioritizes development, leads by example, and prepares people for more positions in other parts of the organization.

Builds and maintains a broad executive network inclusive of partners. Cultivates an ecosystem of customer and external partners and defines where there is a need for partners to act in Microsoft's market to accelerate consumption and/or growth. Inspires and influences engagements between partners and executives on long-term business planning, development of scalable strategic partnerships, and influencing customer needs and outcomes across one or more industries. Ensures teams across their organization maintain relationships with an ongoing long-term focus that looks past quarterly and annual targets. Models and creates a rhythm of business (RoB) with customers and partners that enables continuous engagement and future strategic planning.

Leads business planning and alignment beyond fiscal year boundaries across segments, partners, and teams to drive growth and transformation, define expectations for sale execution, and holds teams accountable for results. Defines where orchestration is needed for success, creates new points of entry for integration and collaboration, sets the tone for an organizational culture of inclusion. Shares practices and a global perspective across the organization for managing competing priorities, reducing complexity for customers, and mitigating execution challenges, while maintaining a high level of accountability. Drives clarity when leading engagements across the organization by defining mutual and shared priorities across lines of business to drive impactful outcomes. Leads and coaches teams on engagements with key stakeholders to develop clear short- and long-term, execution strategies that meet customers' and Microsoft's objectives. Defines practices across teams for developing go-to-market strategies based on mutual business needs and scaling across markets and globally.

Leading and Transforming the Business
Leads the and aligns business within the segment, driving strategic direction across teams to enable revenue growth by proactively addressing business and needs. Drives orchestration amongst internal teams and holds others accountable, incorporating security adherence into accountabilities. Leads and influences across segments, partners, and internal leaders to drive growth and transformation across accounts. Aligns and gains buy-in from leaders and functions across the organization to ensure success of mutual plans and objectives. Influences the adoption of change based on breakthrough discoveries to drive impact (e.g., new operating model, improving collaboration). Drives teams to deliver success for business accountabilities while maintaining secure operations, adhering to compliance and data security standards through opportunity development. Leads teams across an organization to consistently leverage customer/partner insights and market strategies to act on opportunities to drive consumption, new solutions, and annuity business. Leads and coaches team and/or managers to maintain a growth and customer/partner mindset in response to the business environment. Empowers teams to enable Digital & Artificial Intelligence (AI) transformation for our customers and realize value from solutions that drive impactful market share growth. Directs teams to strategies and expectations for leveraging established systems, programs, and tools that enable consistent customer planning and a rhythm of business (RoB) to align end-to end solutions with go-to-market priorities across the customer portfolio and Microsoft solutions lifecycles.

Defines ongoing and long-term customer value realization and satisfaction strategies contributing to net-new revenue and business growth. Holds teams accountable for customer value realization satisfaction, and coaches them on practices and semi-annual survey results. Ensures teams safeguard sensitive customer information by embedding Secure Future Initiative principles into daily sales execution (e.g., least?privilege access, secure collaboration, disciplined data sharing, and proactive risk reduction to protect customer trust). Ensures internal and external executives are aligned on key areas of improvement to further impact increasing customer value realization and satisfaction. Manages and leverages key executive relationships across customer stakeholders (business and IT) to understand drivers of business value, satisfaction, and sentiments. Maintains a strategic perspective on customers and partners to business models and helps them evolve to achieve growth and realize greater alignment between the partner and Microsoft's business models and needs. Understands portfolio of strategic partners (Global Systems Integrator (GSI), Independent Software Vendor (ISV) and drives engagement across teams.

Develops and drives go-to-market sales strategy and execution to ensure success within their market based on Microsoft's and customer/partner needs. Develops strategies and coaches managers to align teams with customer, compete, and market strategies that drive sales, consumption, and Digital & Artificial Intelligence (AI) transformation solutions. Leads, collaborates with, and empowers managers to execute on strategic initiatives, achieve targets and build and manage pipelines that achieve growth and accelerate customer/partner value realization. Develops talent internally and attracts needed talent to Microsoft. Leads teams by example, driving high-value engagements and creating trusting relationships with customers and partners. Coaches teams on, and drives the execution of go-to-market based on customer, partner, and Microsoft needs, and scaling business across markets. Oversees and directs actions to drive balance in business, financial, and people outcomes. Manages customer planning across accounts to ensure that teams across organizations drive end-to-end orchestration for customer value realization and outcomes. Defines long-term expectations and goals across teams to consistently leverage opportunities and effectively develop, align, and execute on market sales strategies.

People Management
Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring. Model: Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles. Coach: Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn. Care: Attract and retain people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

Business Relationship Management
The ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships with supervisors, staff, managers, customers, and vendors. This includes expressing empathy and compassion when dealing with the needs and problems of others, being approachable, taking time to address the concerns of coworkers, and treating others with respect and dignity.
Customer Advocacy
Knowledge of Customer Advocacy, a continuing focus on the requirements of the company’s customers, anticipating their needs, remaining sensitive to customers while performing services for them, being responsive to customer requests, generally working on their behalf.

Executive Relationships
The ability to interact confidently with leaders of the organization in order to present/defend/clarify concerns or issues regarding an existing project, program, or solution. This includes the ability to confidently address difficult questions, handle push back from a high-level audience, and maintain an executive demeanor while engaging in difficult or sometimes high-pressure situations.
Trusted Advisor
The ability to build trusted advisor status and deep relationships across stakeholders (e.g., technical decision makers, business decision makers) through an understanding of customer needs and technologies.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
- 12+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, business development, account leadership, or public sector sales leadership.
- Proven track record of leading and growing large-scale customer businesses within a technology, cloud, software, or digital transformation environment in Malaysia. Experience serving Public Sector customers.
- Demonstrated success managing and developing high-performing sales teams with accountability for revenue, pipeline, business outcomes, and talent development.
- Experience engaging and influencing C-level executives, including CIOs, CTOs, CEOs, government leaders, and other business decision-makers.
- Strong strategic account management experience across complex enterprise organizations and/or public sector institutions.
- Ability to drive business growth through executive relationship building, consultative selling, and long-term customer strategy development.
- Experience leading large, complex sales motions involving multiple stakeholders across sales, technical, services, partner, and customer organizations.
- Demonstrated ability to effectively orchestrate resources and influence stakeholders across a highly matrixed organization to achieve strategic business objectives.
- Strong business acumen with demonstrated ability to manage forecasting, pipeline health, operational rigor, and business performance.
- Proven growth mindset with strong learning agility, adaptability, and resilience. Ability to innovate under constraints, embrace ambiguity, and lead teams through business and technology transformation.
- Strong people leader and culture role model with a track record of fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture, developing talent, and leading teams with integrity, accountability, and empathy.
- Excellent communication, leadership, negotiation, stakeholder management, and executive influencing skills.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience within cloud, SaaS, enterprise software, consulting, or digital transformation industries.

jobs.title: HR Director, Microsoft AI
jobs.description:
Overview
The AI era is being built here. Come help us shape how it gets built by one candidate at a time. Microsoft AI (MAI)'s mission is to use AI responsibly to make everyone more informed, capable, and supported. We are creating unique and powerful products that will change lives, we are proud of what we build and how we build it, and our products will define the AI era. None of it happens without the people, and the people do not arrive by accident. The landscape is shifting faster than anyone predicted, and this role puts you right at the center of it.
As an HR Director supporting the Microsoft AI (MAI) organization, one of Microsoft's fastest-growing businesses, you will lead and execute people strategies that enable organizational growth, talent excellence, and business impact. As a trusted advisor to leaders, you will serve as the strategic integrator across HR Business Partners, Recruiting, and Centers of Excellence to deliver coordinated people solutions that accelerate business outcomes.

Operating within MAI's agile, mission-driven environment, where cross-functional squads work in rapid planning cycles, you will help leaders navigate growth, organizational change, and evolving business priorities. This role requires strategic thinking, business acumen, and operational excellence to deliver outcomes at speed while leading a team and supporting a rapidly evolving organization.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
Leadership:

- Lead, coach, and develop a team, ensuring delivery of high-impact people solutions that support business growth, organizational effectiveness, and employee success.

- Support leaders through organizational growth, change, and transformation by providing strategic guidance, change management expertise , and people solutions that enable business agility and execution.

- Influence and hold leaders accountable for creating high-performing teams while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Organizational Effectiveness:

- Assess organizational health, team effectiveness, leadership capability, and operating rhythms, identifying opportunities to improve business performance and organizational outcomes.

- Partner with leaders to design organizational structures, workforce strategies, and operating models that enable business growth, organizational agility, and execution of evolving priorities.

- Anticipate organizational risks and proactively recommend solutions that strengthen execution, employee experience, and long-term business success.

Talent:

- Lead strategic talent planning efforts that align workforce needs, hiring plans, succession strategies, and talent investments with business objectives .

- Partner with business leaders, Talent Management, and Recruiting to identify critical talent needs, close capability gaps, and build high-performing talent pipelines.

- Leverage data and workforce insights to identify talent risks, improve retention, and inform talent decisions that strengthen organizational performance.

Transformation:

- Lead complex people initiatives that support organizational growth, workforce transformation, organizational changes, and evolving business priorities.

- Partner across HR to shape, adapt, and implement enterprise programs and people strategies to meet the unique needs of the MAI organization.

- Leverage employee feedback, organizational insights, and workforce trends to identify opportunities to improve culture, engagement, inclusion, and the overall employee experience at scale.

Other:

Embody our culture  and values

Qualifications
Required qualifications:

- Bachelor's Degree in Business, Human Resources, or related field AND extensive experience in human resources or related processes (e.g., hiring, performance management) OR equivalent experience.

- Demonstrable people management experience.

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience influencing executives and leading through ambiguity in fast-paced, continually evolving environments.

- Experience partnering with technical, product, engineering, or AI-focused organizations.

- Demonstrated success building and leading high-performing HR teams.

Ability to work from the London office three days per week.

jobs.description:
Overview
Microsoft Advertising empowers advertisers around the world to reach their goals through digital advertising solutions across Microsoft Advertising platforms. We are seeking a sales and business development leader to lead our Channel Partner business across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), helping partners expand their impact and enabling more small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) to benefit from Microsoft Advertising solutions.
As Director of EMEA Channel Partner Sales , you will lead a regionally distributed organization accountable for revenue, sustainable growth, partner performance, and greater density across the SMB advertiser ecosystem. You will set the EMEA partner strategy, translate it into clear market and partner priorities, and operate with a P&L mindset. Success requires sales and people leadership, disciplined business planning, and close collaboration with product, engineering, marketing, support, legal, finance, and sales excellence teams.
You will cultivate executive relationships with channel partners across diverse EMEA markets and strengthen partner capabilities in performance media while supporting expansion into programmatic, connected TV and video, and retail media. You will coach with rigor and empathy, create clarity through change, and balance partner needs with Microsoft business objectives.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize shared goals. We build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least three days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Responsibilities
- Deliver or exceed EMEA revenue expectations, including revenue ex-TAC, while driving sustainable growth and profitability through disciplined portfolio management, incentive investment, and revenue-adjust budgets.
- Set and execute the EMEA Channel Partner strategy, translating regional priorities into market, partner, and product plans that grow and diversify SMB demand and improve partner performance.
- Lead, coach, and develop a distributed EMEA team with clear expectations, solid performance management, inclusive leadership, and a culture of trust, accountability, collaboration, and psychological safety.
- Build and deepen executive relationships with strategic channel partners across EMEA, including business and technical leaders, and establish joint plans that improve customer acquisition, retention, product adoption, and long-term partner value.
- Bring deep search and performance media knowledge into the business and partner with product, engineering, marketplace, and support teams so EMEA partner requirements inform platform, tooling, measurement, and optimization priorities.
- Collaborate across SMB sales, marketing, product marketing, business planning, finance, legal, and sales excellence to strengthen the regional partner value proposition, improve segmentation and governance, and reduce channel conflict.
- Represent the EMEA Channel Partner business in relevant industry forums and contribute regional insights to global Channel Partner strategy, long-range planning, operating rhythms, and One Microsoft sales motions.

- Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Engineering or related field AND partner management, sales, business development, platform ecosystem/network, or partner channel development in the technology industry  - OR partner management, sales, business development, platform ecosystem/network, or partner channel development in the technology industry
- OR equivalent experience.

- Experience with planning, budgeting, and other project management activities.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Engineering or related field AND partner management, sales, business development, platform ecosystem/network, or partner channel development in the technology industry - OR partner management, sales, business development, platform ecosystem/network, or partner channel development in the technology industry
- OR equivalent experience.

- Experience with planning, budgeting, and other project management activities.
- Experience leading revenue growth through partner, indirect, or multi-tier sales motions, with accountability for business planning, partner performance, and cross-functional execution.
- Experience working across multiple EMEA markets and collaborating effectively across countries, cultures, and time zones.
- Experience across direct sales, partner sales, technical sales, business development, or digital advertising, including leadership through complex sales cycles.
- Experience managing strategic partnerships and delivering revenue, profitability, productivity, and timely business outcomes, including within SMB or scaled partner motions.

jobs.description:
Overview
Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As AI transforms every product, service, and industry, access to world-class AI infrastructure has become one of Microsoft's most critical strategic priorities. The scale, efficiency, and flexibility of our AI capacity investments directly impact our ability to serve customers, accelerate innovation, and maintain leadership in the AI era.
The Azure Core & Infrastructure Business Development organization drives strategic partnerships, ecosystem development, and new business models across the infrastructure that powers Microsoft's cloud and AI platforms. We work closely with engineering, product, finance, supply chain, and strategy leaders to determine where Microsoft should build, buy, partner, or invest to accelerate growth, improve economics, expand capacity, and deliver differentiated customer value.
We are seeking a Director, AI Capacity Business Development to lead Microsoft's external strategy and partnership ecosystem for AI capacity. This leader will shape how Microsoft sources, acquires, deploys, and optimizes AI infrastructure capacity across a rapidly evolving market that includes hyperscalers, neocloud providers, GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS) platforms, model developers, datacenter operators, and emerging AI infrastructure companies.
This role sits at the intersection of technology strategy, capacity planning, business development, and executive decision making. The successful candidate will help define Microsoft's long-term AI capacity strategy, manage key ecosystem partnerships, evolve Microsoft's approach to neoclouds and alternative infrastructure providers, and influence some of the company's most important decisions regarding where and how AI workloads should be deployed.
In this role, you will:
- Develop a deep understanding of AI infrastructure markets, capacity constraints, emerging technologies, customer demand signals, and indusrty dynamics.
- Shape Microsoft's multi-year AI capacity sourcing and partnership strategy.
- Drive strategic assessments of build, buy, partner, and invest opportunities across the AI ecosystem.
- Lead complex commercial negotiations involving infrastructure capacity, compute platforms, and strategic partnerships.
- Influence executive decision making related to AI infrastructure deployment, capacity optimization, supply management, and ecosystem strategy.
- Ensure Microsoft makes the best possible decisions regarding how AI capacity is deployed internally and made available to customers.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of Microsoft's AI infrastructure strategy and help determine how the company scales the next generation of AI services globally.

Responsibilities
AI Capacity Strategy
- Develop Microsoft's strategic roadmap for external AI capacity acquisition and ecosystem engagement.
- Create and maintain a comprehensive view of the global AI infrastructure landscape, including hyperscalers, neoclouds, GPUaaS providers, model companies, datacenter operators, infrastructure startups, and hardware vendors.
- Evaluate capacity supply, technology trends, cost structures, performance characteristics, and partner capabilities to inform executive decision making.
- Drive strategic recommendations regarding how Microsoft should allocate AI workloads across internal and external infrastructure environments.
- Develop frameworks for assessing long-term capacity requirements, market opportunities, and infrastructure investment priorities.
- Partner with executive leaders to shape Microsoft's AI capacity and ecosystem strategy.

GPUaaS and Strategic Partnerships
- Co-develop Microsoft's business development strategy for GPUaaS and external AI infrastructure providers.
- Manage relationships with strategic AI infrastructure partners and emerging ecosystem players.
- Evaluate partnership opportunities that improve Microsoft's access to capacity, increase operational flexibility, reduce costs, or accelerate deployment timelines.
- Develop innovative commercial structures that align partner incentives with Microsoft's long-term strategic objectives.
- Establish and execute multi-year partnership roadmaps with key ecosystem participants.
- Identify opportunities to leverage external capacity providers while maintaining Microsoft's leadership position in cloud and AI infrastructure.

Neocloud Strategy
- Co-lead Microsoft's strategy and engagement model for neocloud providers.
- Assess the role that specialized AI cloud providers should play within Microsoft's broader capacity strategy.
- Evaluate opportunities for strategic partnerships, commercial relationships, investments, and ecosystem development.
- Analyze industry dynamics and emerging business models across the AI infrastructure landscape.
- Develop recommendations regarding Microsoft's approach to specialized AI infrastructure providers and alternative capacity sources.
- Partner with engineering and planning teams to determine optimal integration and engagement models.

Build, Buy, Partner, and Invest Analysis
- Lead strategic assessments across the AI infrastructure value chain.
- Identify capability gaps and evaluate options including internal development, partnerships, acquisitions, and investments.
- Conduct comprehensive technical, financial, operational, and strategic diligence.
- Develop executive-level recommendations supported by market analysis, financial modeling, and market intelligence.
- Partner with Corporate Development, Finance, Strategy, and Engineering organizations to evaluate major strategic opportunities.
- Influence investment decisions that impact Microsoft's long-term AI infrastructure position.

Commercial Negotiation and Deal Leadership
- Lead highly complex partnership discussions and commercial negotiations.
- Structure agreements involving capacity commitments, infrastructure utilization, strategic investments, joint development initiatives, and ecosystem partnerships.
- Drive alignment across Finance, Engineering, Supply Chain, CELA, Security, Product, and Executive stakeholders.
- Represent Microsoft in executive-level discussions with CEOs, founders, investors, and senior leaders across the AI ecosystem.
- Develop creative deal structures that balance strategic flexibility, economics, risk management, and long-term value creation.
- Lead transactions from opportunity identification through final execution and implementation.

Executive Influence and Cross-Functional Leadership
- Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives across Microsoft.
- Develop decision frameworks that help leadership navigate complex AI capacity tradeoffs.
- Translate technical and operational considerations into clear business recommendations.
- Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning Azure, AI Platform, Infrastructure, Finance, Supply Chain, and Corporate Strategy organizations.
- Build alignment among diverse stakeholders and drive decisions in highly ambiguous environments.
- Mentor and develop members of the broader Business Development organization.

Deal Governance and Operational Excellence
- Establish governance mechanisms for strategic partnerships and capacity agreements.
- Monitor partner performance against commercial, technical, and operational commitments.
- Ensure agreements deliver intended business outcomes and strategic value.
- Develop executive reporting and performance management processes.
- Identify emerging risks and proactively drive mitigation strategies.
- Continuously improve Microsoft's operating model for AI ecosystem management.

Other
- Embody Microsoft's culture and values.
- Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and inclusion.
- Contribute to the growth and development of the Azure Core & Infrastructure Business Development organization.
- Serve as a visible leader within Microsoft's AI and infrastructure ecosystem.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's Degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Sciences, or related field AND 10+ years of relevant experience in business development, strategy, product management, finance, engineering, consulting, venture capital, private equity, investment banking, corporate development, or related disciplines; OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications
- 8+ years of experience leading strategic partnerships, commercial negotiations, ecosystem development, or corporate strategy initiatives in the technology sector.
- Experience influencing executive-level decision making and driving strategic outcomes across large organizations.
- 12+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, AI, semiconductors, datacenter technologies, networking, or enterprise technology markets.
- Direct experience with GPUaaS providers, neocloud providers, hyperscalers, AI infrastructure companies, or semiconductor ecosystems.
- Deep understanding of GPU economics, AI training and inference workloads, cluster management, and capacity planning.
- Experience evaluating investment, acquisition, and strategic partnership opportunities.
- Track record of negotiating and executing large-scale commercial agreements.
- Experience working directly with CEOs, founders, investors, and executive teams.
- Proficient financial modeling, market analysis, and strategic planning capabilities.
- Understanding of emerging AI infrastructure architectures, capacity optimization techniques, and evolving AI deployment models.

jobs.title: Customer Success Account Management
jobs.description:
Overview
The CSAM is an early-in-career Customer Success Account Manager who delivers standardized customer success outcomes spanning executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration activities. These CSAMs act within a pod model.
Working under the direction of senior CSAMs and a Manager, the CSAM operates within a defined pod covering a shared portfolio of accounts. The role contributes to portfolio-level intelligence, execution orchestration, and reactive signal aggregation – reducing context-switching for senior CSAMs and accelerating customer outcomes.
This is a talent-engine role: CSAMs are AI-first, customer-facing from month three, and grow through structured cohorts and community.

Responsibilities
Executive partnership and execution
- Execute standardized executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration tasks under direct guidance from senior CSAMs or CSU leaders.
- Support agent and Copilot adoption motions across assigned pod accounts.
- Complete assigned activities accurately and on time; escalate exceptions rather than independently diagnose them.

Portfolio-level intelligence and preparation
- Maintain deep, current account context across the pod’s defined portfolio.
- Synthesize account signals into “what’s changed / what matters now”
- Detect risks, upcoming deliveries, upcoming milestones, and open threads.
- Detect portfolio patterns such as recurring blockers across multiple accounts.

Execution orchestration (not delivery)
- Track delivery and milestone progress with partners and CSAs on behalf of senior CSAMs.
- Map dependencies across workloads and milestones.
- Proactively flag drift before the customer raises it.
- Coordinate remediation follow-ups across internal teams.

Reactive signal aggregation
- Monitor reactive support signals – case volume, aging, repeat drivers – across the pod portfolio.
- Aggregate reactive trends into portfolio-level views and surface early warnings of escalation risk.
- Track follow-through on Support, IM, and Service Manager commitments; chase stalled internal owners.
- Distill reactive noise into CSAM-ready insights, not raw data.

Operating model
- Operate within a pod model covering a shared portfolio of accounts.
- Work under direct oversight of the Manager and senior CSAMs assigned to the pod.
- Limit interactions to task execution and information capture; executive partnership and account governance is led by the senior CSAM.

Example Activities
Activities below are illustrative, not exhaustive. The same executive priorities apply because the role is still a CSAM.
Strengthen Customer Health
- Maintain running summaries of reactive health per account for CSAM pre-briefs.
- Surface repeat incident patterns and systemic drivers.
- Translate reactive trends into Customer Health Recommendation inputs.
- Flag candidates for proactive Success Programs and remediation focus.

Accelerate Cloud Adoption
- Track deliveries that support adoption milestones and usage signals across pod accounts.
- Coordinate with delivery partners and CSAs on adoption commitments.
- Prepare adoption inputs for CSDRs and executive discussions.

Advance AI Transformation
- Monitor agent and Copilot adoption velocity across the pod.
- Aggregate AI transformation blockers and opportunities into portfolio views.
- Support readiness for AI-related Success Program intake.

Earn Customer Trust Every Day (Executive Partnership & Planning)
- Reduce CSAM context-switching by owning “what needs attention this week” across pod accounts.
- Drive follow-up actions after reports, reviews, and assessments.
- Keep execution honest on dates, owners, and readiness.
- Participate or support CSP or CSDR activities.

Qualifications
Required
- Bachelor’s degree (any discipline) or equivalent early-career experience.
- Legally authorised to work in the location where this role is based - Czech Republic (Legally authorised = you hold citizenship or have been granted a valid visa or work permit.)
- 0–2 years of professional experience in program management, customer-facing operations, technology delivery, or analytics.
- Strong written and verbal communication in English plus the language(s) required for the assigned hub, Czech.

Preferred
- Coursework or experience in program management, business operations, or an MBA in progress or completed.
- Exposure to enterprise software, cloud platforms, or B2B customer success.
- Experience working in pod, squad, or matrixed team structures.

Join CE&S and help us build a future where customers achieve their business outcomes faster with technology that does more.
Are you the tech-savvy, cloud loving person that has Cloud and IT Service Management blood running in their veins? Do you want to be that key person that helps our strategic enterprise customers to achieve the most with Microsoft products and services? Do you get your energy from helping your customers succeed in making their transformational cloud projects real?
As Customer Success Account Manager (CSAM), you are the primary delivery lead and a partner for our more strategic public sector customers , empowering them to achieve more by accelerating their value realization across our Digital Cloud platforms. By leveraging your technical expertise, business acumen and industry perspectives you will be responsible for the end-to-end post sales delivery and support orchestration across the Microsoft and Partner ecosystem to align the right resources at the right time to achieve customer business outcomes.
The CSAM role in the Customer Success Unit at Microsoft will allow you to accelerate your career growth, leverage your delivery management capabilities and deepen your cloud and industry expertise.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Please note the location for the position is Paddington, London.

Responsibilities
Our CSAM’s are positioned and aligned with our customers as Chief Operating Officers or Customer Success Consultants ensuring that we have the appropriate level of engagement to support and drive value and change. As such you will work with some of the world’s largest public sector organisations pursuing strategic activities, utilising Microsoft technologies to modernise their business and to deliver better services to citizens.

We create an environment where you can do your best work and build a career both in the CSAM role as well as the wider Microsoft. As your interests and goals evolve we will enable you to connect you with a diverse, thriving community that can help you grow.

As a CSAM your key areas of responsibility will be:

- Customer Relationship Management - You will nurture, establish, and expand relationships with key C-level customer stakeholders to enable clear understanding of customer priorities and goals to align quality solution planning, delivery execution and governance.

- Customer Success Leadership – Consumption Leadership

De-risk and accelerate the delivery of Microsoft solutions and take ownership of team orchestration and coordination that accelerates production level consumption and customer adoption across all three clouds. Ensure there is alignment to top customer priorities to help our customers get value from their Microsoft investments and leverage support agreement to achieve their goals.
- Customer Success Leadership – Customer Strategy and Growth - Engages with customers and demonstrates alignment between customer objectives and the current Microsoft portfolio of work in the customer account.
- Aligns with the account team to link Customer Success Plans (CSPs) with account plan priorities and develop bookable programs of work.

- Customer Success leadership - Delivery and program Management   - Leads the strategic execution of program planning and customer-facing program reviews, prioritization of engagements, and management of key stakeholder and executive expectations to address agreed-upon customer outcomes and account priorities to deliver ongoing customer success.

- Customer Success Leadership - Customer Health - You will identify and assess customers’ critical services across our cloud platforms and work with customers to ensure that these services are healthy and resilient.

- Technical Relevance - Develop technical competency across a breadth of Solution areas which supports customer advice, connecting their business goals to Microsoft solutions.

Qualifications
You will bring to us:

- A passion for technology, driving customer value, strategic outcomes, while working with the best people in the industry.
- A growth mindset to be a part of an elite team of diverse individuals focused on making our customers successful.
- A proven ability to partner with account teams to build and retain customer relationships, across business and technical functions within their organisation.
- A track record of providing leadership and orchestration of an internal delivery team.
- Demonstrable experience of driving decisions collaboratively, resolving conflicts, communicating successfully and being able to present confidently to large or small audiences including C-Level Executives.
- Active and creative participation in shaping our Customer Success community.
- Demonstrable experience  working in a customer-facing role, e.g. Customer Success,  Account Management or Service Delivery.
- Exceptional communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
- Demonstrable accountability, customer advocacy, conflict resolution, growth mindset, stakeholder influence, ability to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders and all levels of management.
- An ability to multi-task and work in a dynamic environment with constant change to address emerging challenges.
- An insatiable appetite for learning, curious, optimistic, empathetic and emotionally intelligent.
- A willingness and ability to travel (national) when required: 0-30%.

jobs.title: Principle Customer Success Account Manager
jobs.description:
Overview
We are looking for a Principal Customer Success Account Manager (CSAM) to join our team in Stavanger. The role is intended to work with one of our largest customers in the energy sector and be an integral part of the account team. Our focus as a Customer Success organization is straightforward: helping our customers succeed with the investments they have made in Microsoft technologies and services.As CSAM you are responsible for what happens after the customer has decided to invest. That means understanding their business priorities, agreeing on a plan for how cloud, data and AI should support them, and following through so the plan is actually delivered and the customer sees the value they expected. The Account Executive owns the commercial relationship; you own the delivery and value side of the same account.In practice, much of the job is coordination. You bring together Microsoft Unified services, consulting and partner resources, keep the overall picture across several parallel workstreams, and make sure risks and dependencies are raised early rather than late. You will spend time with both senior decision makers and the people doing the day-to-day work at the customer, and you need to be comfortable in both settings.This is a senior individual contributor role. We are looking for someone with solid experience from large, multi-year transformation programs, preferably from oil and gas or a similar industry, who lives in the Stavanger area and wants to work close to the customer.Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
The Principal CSAM's mission is simple to state and demanding to deliver: ensure the customer realizes the full value of what they have invested in with Microsoft. You do this as an integral part of the account team, complementing the Account Executive's commercial leadership with delivery and adoption leadership. Your responsibilities span three themes: owning the customer success engagement end to end, leading the planning and governance of large transformation programs, and orchestrating people across roles through a collaborative, composed leadership style.
Own customer success and value realization end to end
- Own the end-to-end customer engagement lifecycle for one or more strategic enterprise accounts — from listening and consulting through design, delivery, value realization and ongoing optimization — ensuring clean handovers and evidenced business outcomes at every stage.
- Ensure the customer is getting the most value out of their Microsoft investments, driving adoption and optimization of the cloud, data and AI services they have already committed to and connecting each engagement to measurable business results.
- Act as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders across business and technical functions, developing long-term relationships grounded in a deep understanding of each customer's business context, operating model and technology landscape.

Lead complex, multi-year transformation programs
- Lead the planning, orchestration and review of multi-year, multi-workstream cloud and data transformation programs with significant technical complexity and executive visibility on both the customer and Microsoft side.
- Develop and maintain customer success plans and strategic delivery roadmaps — in partnership with the Account Executive and account team — that align engagements to the customer's priorities, prioritize investments and set clear executive expectations on outcomes, risks and dependencies.
- Proactively anticipate, identify, mitigate and escalate delivery risks, blockers and customer concerns, applying disciplined program governance and structured communication.

Orchestrate and lead across the account team
- Partner with the Account Executive and the wider account team so that commercial strategy and customer success planning move as one, and orchestrate internal and partner delivery resources across sales, engineering and consulting functions with a natural reflex to share ownership across roles rather than defend role boundaries.
- Set the tone for cross-team collaboration through a calm, consensus-building communication style that absorbs pressure, de-escalates friction and maintains executive composure across a sustained, multi-year program horizon.
- Continuously improve delivery management methodology, processes and tools to strengthen operational health and the predictability of customer outcomes.

Qualifications
Required qualifications
- Master's Degree in Business, Sociology, Psychology, Computer Science, or related field AND several years customer success, solution delivery, practice management, customer-facing consulting, or portfolio management experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Sociology, Psychology, Computer Science or related field AND severa years customer success, solution delivery, practice management, customer-facing consulting, or portfolio management experience OR equivalent experience.
- Fluent in Norwegian and English, both spoken and written.
- Reside in the Stavanger area and able to be on-site with customers on a regular basis.
- Demonstrated track record of leading large, multi-year, multi-workstream cloud or data transformation programs for major enterprise customers.
- Understanding of cloud platforms, modern data and AI services, and the role of specialist ISV ecosystems in enterprise transformation programs.
-

Preferred qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, with decade plus years of experience in customer success, solution delivery, customer-facing consulting, practice management or portfolio management — or a Master's degree in a related field with decade plus years of equivalent experience, or equivalent professional experience.
- Proven ability to act as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders and to lead business value conversations at executive and board level.
- Proven communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with a steady, consensus-building style and the resilience to operate under sustained program pressure.
- Proven problem-solving skills and a structured approach to risk identification, escalation management and operational governance.
- Industry experience from the oil and gas sector is highly valued. Candidates without direct oil and gas experience are expected to demonstrate equivalent depth in another large-scale, asset-intensive or highly regulated industrial sector.
- Broader energy-sector experience beyond oil and gas, including upstream, midstream, downstream, renewables or new-energy domains is preffered.
- Formal project and program management experience, ideally evidenced by PMI, PRINCE2, MSP or equivalent certification.
- Service management certification such as ITIL Foundation, and relevant cloud platform certifications (e.g., Azure, AWS or equivalent).
- Change management qualifications such as Prosci, or equivalent practical experience leading large-scale organizational change.

Overview
Microsoft aspires to help our customers achieve their own digital transformation, leveraging the power of Microsoft Cloud solutions and support offerings. To this end, Microsoft invests in a dedicated Customer Success team that will help Microsoft customers successfully realize their business outcomes.

As a  Senior Customer Success Account Manager (CSAM),  you are the delivery leader in our account team and a strategic partner to our customers. You are responsible for execution against our Customer Success Contracts and orchestration of cross-functional programs that deliver customer value and enable transformational customer outcomes. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, leverage your delivery management capabilities and deepen your cloud and industry expertise.

We are currently looking for  Senior Customer Success Account Manager professionals to join our teams across various business groups, for varying customer sizes, in our enterprise, regulated, and partner services organizations. By applying to this role, you will be considered for multiple opportunities within Microsoft across the United States including locations beyond where the role is posted. This role is flexible in that you can work up to 50% from home. Travel percentages will very according to role.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
Customer Relationship Management
- Builds and coaches others on customer, partner, and internal stakeholder engagement strategy and models. Develops, maintains, and builds upon foundational relationships with key customer stakeholders and technical professionals to enable quality solution delivery and health using partnerships with other account team leaders and leads orchestration across internal/external stakeholders. Expands customer and partner relationships beyond the current Unified Support contract consumers with a focus on leading the definition of business outcomes and how to align Microsoft strategy to customer business priorities.
- Identifies, navigates, communicates, and influences key customer technical, business, and executive-level stakeholders (including partners). Guides and leads conversations to facilitate the achievement of customer business objectives by leveraging their investment in Microsoft. Maps internal roles to customer priorities to action the needs of customers and provides input into customer priorities. Holds, maintains, and nurtures internal stakeholder relationships. Influences and challenges senior/executive internal stakeholders. Leads business value conversations at customer executive levels.
- Initiates the gathering of information on the business and Information Technology objectives for customer organizations using partnerships with other account team leaders to identify customer priorities. Partners with Account Team to create a customer success plan and contribute to the shared customer account plan in support of customer objectives specific to the customer's business transformation programs and common to their industry.

Technical Relevance
- Understands, identifies, and aligns Microsoft solutions, and technical capabilities (e.g., Azure, Modern Work, Dynamics) to customer needs and priorities. Leverages broad foundational industry and technical expertise to enable customer success. Identifies complex customer scenarios (e.g., Independent Software Vendors [ISV], cross-cloud, partner) and aligns with technical specialists to identify relevant cross-cloud technology solutions. Strengthens Microsoft's position in the customers' cloud technology marketplace against competitors. Responsibilities
Business Leadership
-  Provides strategic leadership on value-based delivery of well-architected (e.g., secure, resilient, artificial intelligence [AI]-enabled) solutions to grow Azure consumption across the Federal landscape by emphasizing the importance of adoption economics and delivering true customer value.
- Provides leadership to define the execution plan to connect sales planning and execution through delivery planning and execution, aligned with customer and business priorities to achieve consumption and usage targets, ensuring robust security oversight.
- Drives collaboration across the US Federal team in delivering Customer Success for our customers, with the help of the broader team (e.g., Services, partners, CSU team, Account Team Unit, Solution Team Unit, Engineering), engaging with customers to elicit feedback and agreement, and ensuring integration with the broader account plan process.
- Cultivates an active, global network of partners through orchestration with Global Partner Solutions (GPS) to drive consumption, usage, and deliver customer value.
- Shares a vision to guide orchestration across Solution Areas and stakeholders (e.g., Specialist Team Unit [STU], Customer Success Unit [CSU], Account Team Unit [ATU], Global Partner Solutions [GPS] within the US Federal org) to drive usage and consumption outcomes.
- Ensures business financial performance realization across the Federal business through an emphasis on operational excellence and rigor (e.g., pipeline management, execution, ownership of customer journey).
- Facilitates the model and leads comprehensive integration of Services resources to deliver on comprehensive consumption execution model.

Technical Leadership
- Advocates to drive customer technical requirements with corporate product and engineering teams. Creates an internal feedback loop to drive broad, systemic continuous improvement for customers across Microsoft (e.g., security, product support).
- Builds and maintains a network with senior technical decision makers (e.g., Chief Information Officer [CIO], Chief Information Security Officer [CISO], Chief Technology Officer, Chief Architect, technical fellows) to provide technical and operational guidance on technology trends, bridge understanding of identity, security, compliance, operational and risk requirements and influence decision making across relevant teams (e.g., CIO, CISO), and accelerate continuous cloud adoption at scale.

Business Execution

- Assesses and prioritizes high-impact technical blockers, and coaches team to enable resolution.
- Drives consumption and usage rigor and discipline by developing and leading inclusive and regular rhythm of business (ROB) processes for the broader US Federal team.
- Drives customer engagement by ensuring implementation and growth of a predictable and scalable customer engagement model across all enterprise accounts (e.g., Strategic, Major) for the business, leveraging the Customer Success Unit (CSU) team, partners, and Microsoft Services.
- Leaders a large team of leaders to ensure customers achieve desired business outcomes and optimization of their investment with Microsoft. Ensures the organization expands learning on new adoption frameworks and new platform capabilities that cross both technical and business value conversations, including security and resiliency.
- Ensures the team identifies the right partners to delivery and execute on customer vision.

- Invests in the growth of others.

jobs.title: Campus LLE Procurement Execution Manager - Melbourne
jobs.description:
Overview
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
​​​​​​​Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO&I) is the team behind the cloud.  Within CO&I, the Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC) team is responsible for delivering core datacenter infrastructure for Microsoft’s cloud business. The MS portfolio consists of complex, multi-disciplinary, large scale, multi-year datacenter construction and lease projects. We are looking for a passionate, high-energy individual to help build cloud datacenters that power the world’s largest online services.  In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.
The Data Center “Campus LLE Procurement Execution Manager” is a site-based role accountable for post-award execution of LLE (Long Lead Equipment) and OFCI (Owner Furnished Contractor Installed) packages across assigned data-centre projects. The role leads Delivery, Site readiness, Supplier Mobilisation, Equipment Commissioning support, Risk management and Commercial governance from Equipment PO (Purchase-order) handover to DC Operations handover. Working across Strategic Sourcing, Project controls, Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Quality and Cost teams, the role drives Safe, Timely, Compliant and Commercially controlled outcomes

Success in the role requires Outstanding Procurement, Project Management/Execution, Supplier-management, Negotiation and stakeholder-leadership capability, together with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed project environment. The overall objective is to deliver OFCI equipment safely, on time, to the required quality standard and within approved commercial and governance controls.

Responsibilities
Compliance
•    Act as the compliance gate for post-award OFCI changes, by monitor Change Order and Provisional Change Order service levels, preventing After-the-Fact commitments, and escalate urgent cases with validated evidence, project impact and a recommended compliant path forward.
•    Own OFCI payment-compliance controls by verifying that each supplier's Payment Application is supported by contractual entitlement, maintain an auditable record of the assessment, and ensure payment claims align with approved cash-flow forecasts.
•    Identify emerging risks through data-driven approach and drive action to protect current project delivery schedule
•    Leads decision making around the execution and evolution of various workstream processes, identifies and seeks solutions to compliance gaps, and influences leadership to drive change internally and/or externally.
•    Ensures adherence to procurement policy, educates stakeholders and suppliers on policy compliance, and drives the remediation and resolution of any issues.
On Time Delivery:
•    Own the integrated post-award OFCI delivery plan for the Campus Data Center Projects from purchase-order handover through manufacturing at OEMs, Factory acceptance testing, logistics, site delivery, installation interfaces, commissioning support and final handover to operations team.
•    Maintain alignment between contractual delivery dates, supplier schedules, site-readiness milestones and the overall project program

Microsoft’s Cloud business is expanding, and the Cloud Supply Chain (CSCP) organization is responsible for enabling the hardware infrastructure underlying this growth including AI! The CSCP organization is responsible for traditional supply chain functions such as plan, source, make, deliver, but also manages supportability (spares), sustainability, and decommissioning of datacenter assets worldwide. Overview
Category Manager – Network Cabling

Role focus: This role focuses on the sourcing, contracting, and supplier management of structured cabling and physical network infrastructure within Microsoft's data center environment. The successful candidate will combine technical expertise in network cabling with experience in supplier, project, program, commercial, or contract management. In addition to leading the network cabling category, the role supports selected data center infrastructure, maintenance, operational, and service contract categories.

Although network cabling procurement is the core focus, the role will also manage other data centre contract categories, including selected IT, mechanical, electrical, maintenance, upgrade and operational service agreements.

Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end sourcing for network cabling, including technical specification review, supplier identification and qualification, tendering, commercial evaluation, negotiation and contracting for both cabling materials and installation labour.

Partner with engineering, design, construction and data centre operations teams to translate technical requirements into clear scopes of work, bills of materials, installation standards, acceptance criteria and supplier obligations.

Evaluate cabling contractors and manufacturers on technical capability, installation quality, safety, capacity, delivery performance, commercial value and compliance with applicable standards.

Manage network cabling contracts through delivery, including changes, risks, milestones, service levels, claims, cost controls and performance improvement.

Build strategic relationships with cabling manufacturers, distributors and installation partners, using KPIs and scorecards to improve quality, availability, cost and delivery.

Bring  Ability to apply technical expertise to sourcing and contracting decisions  to sourcing decisions, challenge specifications and supplier proposals constructively, and identify practical alternatives without compromising operational reliability.

Manage the financial and commercial aspects of contracts, including purchase orders, invoices, forecasts, benchmarking and cost-saving opportunities.

Prepare quarterly spend, supplier-performance and contract-management reviews for data centre stakeholders.

Support the tracking and commercial management of data centre maintenance, repair, upgrade and project activities.

Apply prior project-management or account-management experience to coordinate stakeholders, manage suppliers and drive work from scope definition through contract execution and delivery.

Identify and implement efficiency opportunities across technical systems, operational workflows and resource deployment to improve performance, reduce costs and support scalable data centre operations.

Capture local subject-matter expertise and promote consistent adoption of network cabling and contracting best practices.

Contribute to improvements in Operations and Service Level Agreement processes, services and solutions for CO+I.

Coordinate closely with data centre field operations and cross-functional teams to maintain alignment and support successful delivery.

Capabilities Important to Success

Network cabling expertise:   Strong knowledge of structured cabling system  of structured cabling systems, components, installation methods, testing, commissioning, quality requirements and the supplier landscape.

Technical-to-commercial capability: Ability to convert engineering and delivery requirements into procurement strategies, scopes, tender documents, evaluation criteria and contracts.

Stakeholder influence: Communicate credibly with technical specialists, suppliers, senior managers and operational leaders, including influencing without formal authority.

Flexibility and adaptability: Anticipate change, manage ambiguity and adjust plans, priorities and sourcing approaches as technical or operational requirements evolve.

Team contribution: Contribute technical insight and constructive challenge, then support agreed decisions and shared delivery outcomes.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications and Experience

- Experience in network cabling, telecommunications, physical IT infrastructure, or related technical environments.

We recognize that candidates may develop relevant skills through a variety of professional, technical, military, apprenticeship, or educational experiences. We encourage applicants who meet many, but not all, qualifications to apply

About the Role

As a Senior Real Estate Portfolio Manager for ANZ, Japan and Korea within Global Workplace Services (GWS), you will program-manage a medium-to-high complexity portfolio of regional and global real estate activities — evaluating, selecting, developing, and managing transactions across the portfolio.
You will oversee broker and project delivery, drive complex acquisition agreements, and partner with Finance, Legal, and senior stakeholders to ensure the portfolio efficiently supports Microsoft's business requirements. Why Join Us

- Work on high-visibility, high-value real estate decisions that directly shape where and how Microsoft's teams work across the region.
- Partner daily with senior leaders across Finance, Legal, and the business — building influence and visibility well beyond a typical portfolio management role.
- Join a collaborative, global GWS organization that invests in your growth, with clear paths to deepen expertise in real estate strategy, transactions, or project delivery.

Overview
UK GEO HR Lead

Microsoft is on a path to growing all its businesses around the world and the United Kingdom is a key part of that that plan.

Our presence in the UK encompasses the full complement of Microsoft business, including sales, engineering, gaming, support, consulting, marketing and much more, with approximately 6,000 employees in the geo.

The role has a team of 5 direct reports, who drive the people strategy across UK&I Global Enterprise Sales and EMEA SE&O and CCS businesses. You will also partner closely with all HR COEs to lift the One HR model for the UK&I.

Primary responsibilities include business partnership, leadership effectiveness, employee engagement, cultural stewardship, and driving talent and cultural (including diversity) focused strategies across the region. Developing, managing, implementing, and integrating these strategies in support of the region’s growth and success. The HR leader must be able to develop business relationships with the UK&I Commercial leadership team and inspire and lead the full HR function for the Geo. As Microsoft accelerates its AI transformation, this leader will help redefine how HR partners the business, embedding AI into HR workflows, workforce insights and decision-making to raise strategic impact, quality and productivity

Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end talent management processes and practices to identify and respond to gaps in building forward-looking talent capabilities all-up

- Organizational Effectiveness - Partner with and enable leaders to develop high-functioning orgs to achieve business goals and build inclusive culture. Act as a catalyst for building organizational effectiveness within the business. Educate the business on HR trends that affect the business. Acquire business sponsorship for people initiatives, in partnership with the HR Directors who report to this position. Design and implement well-thought through change plans that account for durable effect. Provide strategic leadership for operating model evolution and work transformation across the region, enabling clarity in roles, responsibilities and ways of working as portfolio components evolve.

Partner with leaders to diagnose, coach and provide solutions to enable our leaders and leadership teams to collaborate and continuously transform themselves and their teams/org to deliver business results. Build change leadership capability across the HR leadership bench and broader leader community to land transformation with consistency, care and speed across diverse countries and businesses.

Partner with country leadership teams to deliver crisis management as needed, including emergency response, risk management, communications, and disaster recovery/business continuity planning. Ensure readiness for rapid response in complex and geopolitically dynamic environments, with clear rhythms, escalation paths, and post-incident learning.

jobs.title: Risk Manager
jobs.description:
Overview
Do you enjoy bringing structure to complex business problems and helping teams make confident, risk-informed decisions? In this role, you will help build and operate the enterprise risk management framework for Microsoft Ireland Payment Services Limited, a newly created regulated payments institution based in Dublin. In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.
Microsoft’s Audit, Risk, and Compliance group identifies emerging risks and assesses the effectiveness of management’s response. As a Risk Manager, you will support the Chief Risk Officer for MIPSL by helping shape risk governance, risk reporting, oversight, and regulatory engagement for a new regulated entity. You will work in a hybrid model in Dublin and partner closely with ARC, MIPSL leadership, Operations, Technology, and FinCrime stakeholders.
Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
• Enterprise Risk Framework Execution: Support the MIPSL CRO in implementing and maintaining the MIPSL enterprise risk management (ERM) framework, aligned with CBI expectations and proportional to a regulated payments institution.
• Risk Identification & Assessment: Lead MIPSL risk assessments across key domains (operational, compliance, financial, strategic), ensuring risks are clearly articulated, measured, and documented using a consistent methodology.
• Risk Register & Governance: Maintain the MIPSL enterprise risk register, ensuring risks, controls, and mitigation actions are current, and support structured risk governance through committees and reporting forums.
• Second Line Oversight & Challenge: Provide independent oversight and constructive challenge to MIPSL first-line functions (Operations, Technology, FinCrime), ensuring controls are appropriately designed and operating effectively.
• Control Framework & RCSA: Facilitate MIPSL’s Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs), control testing, and validation activities, identifying control gaps and tracking remediation to closure.
• Key Risk Indicators (KRIs): Develop and monitor MIPSL’s KRIs and risk appetite metrics, ensuring breaches or emerging risks are identified early and escalated appropriately.
• Incident & Issue Oversight: Oversee MIPSL risk events, incidents, and near misses, ensuring root cause analysis is performed and lessons learned are embedded into the control environment.
• Third-Party & Outsourcing Risk Coordination: Work closely with MIPSL Operations and Technology oversight roles to ensure third-party risks are captured within the MIPSL enterprise risk view and aligned to outsourcing requirements.
• Stress Testing & Scenario Analysis: Support MIPSL risk scenario analysis and stress testing activities, particularly relating to operational disruption, financial crime exposure, or third-party failure.
• Regulatory Engagement Support: Prepare MIPSL risk materials for CBI engagement, including inspections, risk assessments, and ongoing supervisory dialogue.
• Risk Appetite & Policy Support: Support the development and periodic review of the MIPSL risk appetite statement and risk policies, ensuring alignment with the entity’s strategy and regulatory obligations.

Qualifications
Required qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree in Risk Management, Engineering, Government Intelligence, Security, Information Technology, or a related field
- Relevant experience in risk management, privacy, security, compliance, government intelligence, operations, auditing, and/or finance; OR equivalent experience.

Preferred qualifications:
- Master’s Degree in Risk Management, Engineering, Government Intelligence, Security, Information Technology, or a related field, with solid experience in risk management across operations, engineering, information technology, business analysis, consulting, auditing, privacy, security, compliance, government intelligence, and/or finance; OR Bachelor’s Degree in a related field, including Cybersecurity, with significant relevant experience; OR equivalent experience.
- Membership with a relevant risk domain association such as IAPP, ISC2, ISACA, CIA, SCCE, DRI, CBCB, COSO, or IIA.
- Experience supporting audits, regulatory reviews, inspections, or risk governance in a regulated environment.
- Experience with AI, AI-based analytical tools, AI governance, or AI governance frameworks.
